title: DSH Marketplace
license: Public API reuse terms; source attribution retained

description.en: Every release here was installed into a clean DeepSeek Harness profile in a throwaway sandbox before it was listed, and each is listed with the dsh versions it accepts.
description.zh: 这里每一版都先在一次性 sandbox 的干净 DeepSeek Harness profile 里实装过才列出来，并标明它接受哪些 dsh 版本。

title.zh: 作者在 LINUX DO 认证过

title.en: Older release — the latest one needs a newer dsh
title.zh: 旧版——最新版要更新的 dsh

description.en: Generate validated, self-contained interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from repositories or system descriptions.
description.zh: 从仓库或系统描述生成经过校验的自包含交互式架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图和生命周期图。

description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。

description.en: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用、创建新技能、删除进可恢复回收站。

description.en: Plugin manager tab in DSH Settings → Plugins: install from npm or git with progress, enable/disable switches effective at next startup, conflict reconciliation with undo, and one-click hand-off to a fix session.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件 分区里的插件管理 Tab：从 npm/git 安装带进度、下次启动生效的启停开关、安装冲突对账可撤销、失败一键转交修复会话。

description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.
description.zh: 侧边栏多列任务看板：卡片交给真实 DSH 智能体会话执行，支持 cron 定时（Host 侧到点执行，关浏览器也生效）。

description.en: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.
description.zh: 手机/PC 远程操控 dsh web 工作区：扫码配对、令牌门控通道、SSE 实时同步，提供移动端与完整桌面 GUI 两种远程形态。

description.en: SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.
description.zh: SSH 远程运维面板：Web 终端、SFTP 传输、本地端口转发与一条命令并发集群执行，Agent 与面板共用同一份主机配置。

description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header. Retired by the author in favour of the official workspace-changes plugin: the published npm package stays installable but is no longer developed.
description.zh: 输入框上方提供 Git 分支选择器，并把分支泳道与提交历史画成图谱，沿着时间线找到任意变更。作者已将其退役并改用官方 workspace-changes 插件；已发布的 npm 包仍可安装，但不再开发。

description.en: Cross-session memory and context recovery across forty-five other coding agents (45+) on this machine, reading session files they already wrote before install (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Antigravity, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Qoder, Cline, Zed, Magpie and more): six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall injected into runtime context. Local BM25 CLI/MCP index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆与上下文恢复：读取本机上其他四十五个（45+）编程智能体已经写下的会话文件，支持安装前历史找回与中断恢复（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Windsurf、Trae、Antigravity、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Qoder、Cline、Zed、Magpie 等）：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。共享本地 BM25 CLI/MCP 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索并安装社区插件，支持分类筛选、一键更新与停用，以及主题切换与配置备份。

description.en: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and CSV export, preview a deployment on its domain, and call the CloudBase MCP toolset (`mcp__cloudbase__*`) with device-code login.
description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content details, evolution trends, compaction/injection events, and stats.
description.zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。

description.en: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).
description.zh: 通过二维码或机器人凭据将 IM 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 WhatsApp 共 9 种渠道）。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux: 106 transparent animations in the browser overlay or a transparent always-on-top desktop window, throw-and-bounce drag physics with squash and particle scoring, a work-status bubble driven by live session events, self-talk and chat with persistent memory, balance display, meme-image bubbles, multiple pets on screen, and drop-in custom animations and pet packs.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端可用：浏览器浮层或透明置顶桌面窗口，106 个透明动画、带挤压与粒子的甩抛反弹物理、随会话事件实时联动的工作状态气泡、碎碎念与带持久记忆的对话、余额展示、表情包配图、多开同屏，并支持直接放入的自定义动画与宠物种类（pet pack）。

description.en: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.
description.zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。

description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.
description.zh: 由 Mnemon 驱动的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）跨 Agent、本地优先的持久记忆插件。它可在支持 Mnemon 的 Agent 之间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可检索项目档案、语义召回、知识图谱和 Sidebar UI。

description.en: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
description.zh: billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。

description.en: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 SillyTavern 类文字游戏 Agent，支持候选项生成、对话式人物卡编辑、剧本模式与素材抽取。
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 SillyTavern 类文字游戏 Agent，支持候选项生成、对话式人物卡编辑、剧本模式与素材抽取。

description.en: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.
description.zh: DSH 免费搜索插件：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、设置页 UI（API key 输入 + 官网链接）、web_fetch、引擎测试工具。

description.en: Node-based creation studio for DeepSeek Harness - script, storyboard, reference images and multi-shot video generation on an infinite canvas, drivable from the chat in batches; bring your own image/video/TTS providers (OpenAI-style endpoints or Seedance/Sora-style video APIs), and with none configured the pipeline runs offline in demo mode with placeholder media.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的节点式创作工作室——在无限画布上完成剧本、分镜、参考图与多镜头视频生成，可由对话批量驱动；图像/视频/TTS 需自带服务商（OpenAI 风格接口，或 Seedance/Sora 风格视频 API），未配置时整条流水线以离线演示模式运行、只产出占位素材。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

description.en: Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - update both before installing or updating this plugin. Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.
description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

description.en: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 会话与当日 API 费用统计、预算图框（已用%）、官方余额、历史看板，支持峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: 让 QQ Bot 接入 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的官方插件
description.zh: 让 QQ Bot 接入 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的官方插件

description.en: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models, CN and international alike, to DSH, reading each model's credit multiplier from the upstream catalog on every refresh, with per-model image input toggles, account switching backed by an auto-failing-over pool, manual daily check-in, and read-only credit overviews shown as compact pills on the card and in the composer.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，每次刷新按上游目录读取每个模型的积分倍率，支持逐模型图片输入开关、带自动换号的账号池、手动每日签到，以及卡片与输入框里的只读积分胶囊读数。

description.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.
description.zh: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App（PWA）。公网与局域网两个入口可随时切换；在手机上读会话、子代理、目标轮次、工作流、后台任务与待审批，和任意会话实时对话（流式回复、工具调用进度、随时停止、切换会话与模型），消息可排队并「立即发送」，支持上传与交付文件。另含 GUI 侧边栏面板；原名 dsh-taskwatch，npm 包已改为 dsh-in-hand。

description.en: Your AI learning companion: helping you plan your studies, understand concepts, and build projects to master a subject.
description.zh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

description.en: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppression. Prompt texts ship as per-language data files — the framework supports multilingual users.
description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 七层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic），首条消息缓存友好注入 + 每条消息关键词命中，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project 工具，空闲窗口自动整理记忆（dream，峰时抑制）。prompt 文案按语言数据文件加载——框架支持多语言用户。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and access to secrets such as SSH keys and .env files before a tool call runs.
description.zh: 执行前守卫，在工具调用运行前拦截破坏性 Git 与文件系统命令，以及对 SSH 密钥、.env 等机密文件的访问。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的场景化 Agent 预设，覆盖单人交付、团队委派、方案调研和优化实验。Scenario-focused DeepSeek Harness agent presets for solo delivery, team delegation, evidence-based research, and optimization experiments.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的场景化 Agent 预设，覆盖单人交付、团队委派、方案调研和优化实验。Scenario-focused DeepSeek Harness agent presets for solo delivery, team delegation, evidence-based research, and optimization experiments.

description.en: QQ official bot channel (enhanced fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): full agent chat in groups and DMs, rich media, an auto-tagged sticker library with AI image replies, join approval, mute and broadcast, scheduled wakeups, remote approvals over QQ, interactive cards, multi-account instances, extensions, member profiles, and token-saving value-scored wakeups.
description.zh: QQ 官方机器人通道（tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 的增强 fork）：群/私聊ai陪聊、富媒体收发、表情包打标入库+检索发图、入群审批/禁言/群发、定时唤醒、QQ 远程审批与提问卡、互动按钮卡、多账号多实例、扩展接口、群友记忆注入、按消息价值唤醒省token、上下文自动压缩、悬浮球设置面板。

description.en: DSH 预设编辑器插件, 支持一键破甲.
description.zh: DSH 预设编辑器插件, 支持一键破甲.

description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

description.en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.en: Provides six code quality skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, health dashboards, and remediation.
description.zh: 提供六个代码质量技能，涵盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、健康看板与修复。

description.en: Provides bash, PowerShell 7, and high-performance Rust tools for DSH on Windows to reduce token usage.
description.zh: 为 Windows 的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 及 Rust 高性能工具，减少 token 消耗。

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness — real Agent status, always on top on Windows.
description.zh: Desktop-native BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness — real Agent status, always on top on Windows.

description.en: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.
description.zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

description.en: Adds an animated DeepSeek Chan reasoning-effort slider to DSH's native model selector, following model-declared levels with a running animation that speeds up while dragging.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生模型选择器加入大肥鱼思考强度滑块，按模型声明的档位调节推理强度，拖动时奔跑动画随之加速。

description.en: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness提供持久化的项目级记忆。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目。文档与代码符号在读取时索引，无需全量预扫；针对不同语言的项目，支持可选功能增强。经验笔记自动去重，避免重复记录。所有数据召回附带出处可溯源。纯 JS、单依赖、静默运行、零操作成本。

description.en: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.
description.zh: 新增 deepseek-web provider，把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端模型接入 DSH：浏览器登录抓取、PoW 请求签名、SSE 流式传输与基于提示词的工具调用。

description.en: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
description.zh: 技能市场：一个页面管理本机所有 coding agent 的技能，一键收编进 DSH 用户库；内置 6600+ 技能市场，支持注入开销（≈token）统计与模型可见性治理。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: Proxies the loopback-only dsh web onto a LAN port so phones and other machines can reach it, with an optional access password that browsers type in and the bundled Android client unlocks with biometrics. Adds a LAN-access settings page with QR codes, inlines dsh-web-mobile (MIT, attribution kept) for the mobile layout, and the Android client in the same repository adds finish/approval notifications, voice input and a home-screen widget.
description.zh: 把只监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 转发到局域网端口，供手机等设备访问；可选访问密码——浏览器输入，同仓库的 Android 客户端用指纹或面部解锁。新增带二维码的「局域网访问」设置页，内联 dsh-web-mobile（MIT，保留署名）提供移动端布局；Android 客户端另加完成/审批通知、语音输入与主屏小组件。

description.en: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
description.zh: 失败恢复记忆库：从真实工程会话中搜索和记录失败恢复教训，支持 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和知识库管理。

description.en: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
description.zh: 以证据为准的研究用智能体预设：每一步只能靠系统核验过的观测推进，L3 以上的结论交给独立评估者，整场会话折成一份可重放的账本，并长成可浏览的领域本体。需要 DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1。

description.en: Search built for agents: multilingual coverage across web, academic, code, shopping, finance, news, and encyclopedias.
description.zh: 专为 agent 打造的搜索工具：多语言，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
description.zh: 多机同步：让多台机器上的 dsh 通过一个私有 GitCode 仓库保持一致——技能、会话、设置、插件清单四类内容各有独立开关；变更走分支 → PR → 合并，推送前自动回填远端新增防误删，支持 AI 智能对齐（语义合并双方改动）与一键解决冲突；强制私有仓库，pull 不覆盖本地改动。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面追踪 DeepSeek Token 用量、单次与会话费用及账户余额，并显示缓存感知的扣费动画。

description.en: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager that discovers community skins, displays previews and compatibility status, and provides verified one-click or manual installation paths.
description.zh: 原生皮肤市场与生命周期管理器，发现社区皮肤、展示预览与兼容状态，并提供已验证的一键安装或手动安装入口。

description.en: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.
description.zh: 手机优先的 DSH 前端体验优化：输入框自动折叠、手机回车换行、侧边栏/顶部栏/设置页压缩、禁缩放回弹，以及审批/提问/任务完成通知（页面卡片、Web Push、webhook）；零 dsh 本体改动。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: Conversation rewind: one click back to any earlier user message, in the same window — no new branch, no leftover copy; the target message is refilled into the composer, with optional workspace-file restore — the full Claude Code /rewind semantics.
description.zh: 对话回退：一键回到任意更早的用户消息，同窗口内完成，不新建分支、不残留副本；目标消息自动填回输入框，可一并还原工作区文件——即完整的 Claude Code /rewind 语义。

description.en: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
description.zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

description.en: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.
description.zh: 通过 Android App 或手机浏览器访问 DeepSeek Harness，支持安全局域网连接、远程访问、持久设备配对和可自定义移动界面。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.
description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

description.en: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.
description.zh: 插件管理面板：已安装插件一键启用/停用，内置 GitHub dsh-plugin 插件市场，支持详情查看与一键安装。

description.en: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and supported coding workspaces through an end-to-end encrypted channel, with adaptive Relay/WebRTC transport, device authorization, workspace files, read-only previews, terminals, and optional Codex Remote.
description.zh: 通过端到端加密通道远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 及兼容的编码工作区，支持自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输、设备授权、工作区文件、只读预览、终端和可选的 Codex Remote。

description.en: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

description.en: A live Android device inside the conversation — emulator or USB phone, driven entirely through adb: 20 agent tools for streaming, Gradle build and run, UI-tree or OCR interaction, logcat, processes and memory, plus a three-button navigation panel.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 Android 设备——模拟器或 USB 手机，完全通过 adb 驱动：20 个 Agent 工具用于流式投屏、Gradle 构建运行、UI 树或 OCR 交互、logcat、进程与内存检查，并附带三键导航面板。

description.en: Reports which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model, typed as /name, or none) and manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository, folder, SKILL.md or zip address, set a Chinese display name in the skill meta.yaml, and remove a skill while keeping a backup.
description.zh: 每轮对话报告本轮调用了哪些 skill（模型自动加载、用户输入 /name，或一个都没用），并管理本机 skill 目录：粘贴仓库、文件夹、SKILL.md 或 zip 地址即可安装，中文显示名写入该 skill 的 meta.yaml，删除时保留备份。

description.en: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
description.zh: 白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。

description.en: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化非线性对话工作区：把会话、追问与分支变成可浏览、可拖拽的对话地图。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用。

description.en: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and goal-mode alerts that wait for the final round.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: 为 DSH 提供 Chat / Harness 双模式切换
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Chat / Harness 双模式切换

description.en: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接进 DSH 模型选择器：国内版与国际版各自成组，带上游声明的推理档位、每条回复的积分消耗与剩余积分、按账号分别保存的模型显隐，以及在支持的模型上的图片输入。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
description.zh: 原生实现 Claude Code 式自动记忆:类型化记忆文件(user/feedback/project/reference)+ 自动注入系统提示词的 MEMORY.md 索引,无记忆时零提示词占用;memory_write/read/list/delete 遵循 Claude Code 写入规则(查重更新、相对日期转绝对、交叉链接);项目级与用户级双层作用域,跨进程文件锁与孤儿锁自愈,记忆为磁盘纯 Markdown,无外部服务、无 embedding。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Meme search, the fun way: describe the vibe, and the agent finds and sends a real meme that actually fits.
description.zh: 陪 AI 斗图的搞笑插件：说个感觉，AI 帮你搜到、发出那张恰到好处的真实表情包。

description.en: In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.
description.zh: DSH 的应用内插件市场：插件发现、安装、升级、开关与卸载一站完成，跟随 Web / Desktop 宿主 profile；4,000+ 条社区目录搭配可自定义精选清单，附 8 个 agent 工具与独立 dshm CLI，无需市场服务器或账号。

description.en: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

description.en: Multi-provider usage dashboard with provider/model token breakdowns, calendar drill-downs, account balances, and OpenCode Go / Z.ai subscription quota tracking.
description.zh: 多供应商用量看板：按供应商/模型统计 Token 与日期下钻，统一展示账户余额，并追踪 OpenCode Go / Z.ai 订阅额度。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.
description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。

description.en: Superpowers for DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers, installed as a Cordis plugin registering 14 skills with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版 Superpowers 技能包：移植自 obra/superpowers 的 TDD、调试、规划与协作技能，以 Cordis 插件安装并注册 14 个技能（零运行时依赖）。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。

description.en: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Drive a real Chrome/Chromium browser from DeepSeek Harness with 35 structured tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, forms, JavaScript/CDP, screenshots, downloads and tabs; a live sidebar mirrors the page and accepts mouse and keyboard input. It ships a managed CDP runtime, keeps login state across calls, and can import cookies from your everyday Chrome through a companion extension.
description.zh: 用 35 个结构化工具从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动真实 Chrome/Chromium：导航、语义快照、点击、表单、JavaScript/CDP、截图、下载与标签页管理；右侧边栏实时镜像页面，并支持鼠标键盘直接接管。插件自带受管 CDP 运行时，跨调用保留登录状态，并可通过配套 Chrome 扩展从日常浏览器导入 cookie。

description.en: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: a specialist MCP marketplace and MCP manager panel for Model Context Protocol data sources. Connect enterprise, financial, legal, patent, research and geospatial data; manage authorization, search tools and troubleshoot connections. Supports OAuth, API keys and HTTP/stdio. Provider permissions and fees apply.
description.zh: MCP连接器：DeepSeek Harness 的专业 MCP 市场、数据市场与 MCP 管理面板，汇聚企业、金融、法律、专利、科研和地理等 Model Context Protocol（MCP）数据源。通过超百个 MCP连接器接入 MCP Server，支持连接管理、授权配置、跨连接搜索工具与排障；支持 OAuth、API Key、HTTP/stdio。由企查查/QCC团队维护；数据权限与费用以各服务商为准。

description.en: A live iOS Simulator or USB-connected iPhone inside the conversation: 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity or OCR text, list-row actions and SwiftUI preview hot reload, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 iOS 模拟器或 USB 连接的 iPhone：22 个 Agent 工具用于启动、构建、按无障碍标识或 OCR 文本驱动 UI、列表行操作与 SwiftUI 预览热重载，并附带可点击拖拽的流式侧边栏面板。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics with per-provider and per-model breakdown (auto-discovers configured models), per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计（按供应商/模型分别统计，自动读取已配置模型）、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。

description.en: Office document preview, editing, and DOCX generation for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Fylar Office SDK.
description.zh: Office document preview, editing, and DOCX generation for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Fylar Office SDK.

description.en: Local SQLite taskboard as a native overlay page: projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments and workflow automation, with backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done statuses, `taskboard_*` Agent tools that can only submit work to in_review, a headless JSON CLI and a packaged skill.
description.zh: 本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.
description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入，并预演 dsh-memory-protocol v1——适配器注册表与可分发的一致性套件。

description.en: Drags the official reasoning-effort row into a continuous track: blue-to-violet fill, a starfield on the higher levels, and the official value text tinted to the current level. Off stays gray; no official text is rewritten.
description.zh: 把官方「推理等级」那一行改成一条可拖动的连续轨道：填充从蓝渐变到紫罗兰，较高档位带星尘粒子，官方数值文字跟着档位变色。Off 档保持官方灰，不改写官方任何文字。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Preview Univer sheets, docs & slides inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Preview Univer sheets, docs & slides inside DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Workspace-safe Office tools for agents: create/read Word, create/read/update Excel, and create/read PowerPoint decks with PNG/JPG/GIF image placement.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的工作区安全 Office 工具集：创建/读取 Word、创建/读取/更新 Excel、创建/读取 PowerPoint，并支持 PNG/JPG/GIF 图片排版。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。

description.en: Usage statistics settings panel: 26-week activity heatmap, daily token trend with a cache hit-rate curve, per-model donut and breakdown, time-range filters, summary cards, one-time historical backfill and lossless rebuild.
description.zh: 用量统计设置面板：26 周活跃热力图、按日 Token 趋势与缓存命中率曲线、模型用量环形图与明细、时间范围筛选、汇总卡片，支持历史会话回扫与无损重建。

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

description.en: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).
description.zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.
description.zh: DSH 会话与工作区管理——工作区：归档与显示。会话：跨工作区移动、预设迁移、删除；收藏、待回看、优先级、标签、备注。批量操作。

description.en: Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation, Markdown-to-docx, and document header/footer/page-number injection for 24 official document types.
description.zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

description.en: View and manage an agent’s tools and skills in a visual menu. Set each capability to Resident, On-demand, or Disabled; agents can find and use on-demand capabilities while reducing context usage.
description.zh: 以可视化菜单查看和管理 Agent 的工具与技能，按常驻、按需、禁用三档控制能力暴露；支持按需检索和使用，减少上下文占用。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).
description.zh: DSH 网页 UI 综合增强：中文补全、统计单行显示、思考自动展开、对话宽度、会话归档与删除，并可选的提示词注入（默认关闭）。

description.en: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：提供局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare 与自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人交互，内置安全认证与访问控制。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or Codex CLI.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH agents — durable, inspectable memories with recall, search, browse and knowledge-graph tools, import from ten other AI coding tools, and a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供长期记忆——可检索、可检视的持久记忆，带回忆、搜索、浏览与知识图谱工具，支持从十个其他 AI 编码工具导入记忆，并附设置页。

description.en: OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 模型提供方，支持网关实时模型发现、models.dev 在线能力配置、会话路由，以及含订阅用量显示的 Web 设置页。

description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: Multi-provider wallet chip: official DeepSeek balance, per-session cost & tokens, third-party token totals, recharge shortcut, low-balance alerts.
description.zh: 多供应商钱包标签：官方 DeepSeek 余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方合计 token、一键充值、低余额提醒。

description.en: Bridges a DSH session and QQ over NapCat HTTP, forwarding agent replies to QQ and feeding messages you send in QQ back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat HTTP 把 DSH 会话和 QQ 双向打通：AI 说完自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 里说的话自动转进会话。

description.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
description.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。

description.en: Complete chinese-traditional-wisdom (玄枢 / XuanShu) skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: bazi, ziwei-doushu, liuyao, meihua, qimen, daliuren, taiyi, wuyun-liuqi, constitution and fengshui calculation, with a local deterministic engine and a visualization dashboard.
description.zh: 完整中华传统智慧（玄枢 / XuanShu）技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件：八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、奇门遁甲、大六壬、太乙、五运六气、中医体质与风水推算，内置本地确定性引擎与可视化 Dashboard。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

description.en: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

description.en: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, internal pivot) with configurable concurrency; preflight checks skills/resources; scoring uses four stages (recon, internet, boundary, internal) with server-side caps and privilege-wins dedup; findings stay in a local SQLite fact base. The persistent right-side console has nine pages and includes asset mapping, agents, sessions/tunnels, findings, score targets, reports, POC knowledge base and skill library. v0.15.2 adds automatic HTTP evidence/action records, batch ingest, scope check, tunnel pivot probe, data proof, cleanup ledger and T0-T3 asset admission to prevent scope drift. 59 redteam_* tools; 38 bundled skills.
description.zh: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透），并发可配置；开工前做技能与资源预检；得分按四阶段（信息收集/互联网/边界/内网），上限、权限取高、同服务去重由服务端判定；发现落本机 SQLite 事实库。右侧常驻控制台 9 个页面，含资产测绘、智能体、会话隧道、漏洞战果、得分目标、报告、POC 知识库与技能库。v0.15.2 增加 HTTP 证据/动作记录自动留痕、批量落库、范围校验、隧道内网探测、数据证明、清理台账与 T0–T3 资产准入，防止打偏靶标。59 个 redteam_* 工具，随 npm 包 38 个随包技能。

description.en: Structured memory engine for DeepSeek Harness. Offline semantic search, entity-attribute-timeline, autoDream self-consolidation, and human-editable Markdown storage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 结构化记忆引擎。离线语义搜索、实体-属性-时间轴、autoDream 自我巩固、可人工编辑的 Markdown 存储。

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: Skills settings section with hot enable/disable, delete and add（Web界面的skill管理工具）
description.zh: DSH Web UI plugin: Skills settings section with hot enable/disable, delete and add（Web界面的skill管理工具）

description.en: Floating DSH desktop pet with 12 authored state animations for requests, tools, compaction, archive and prompt enhancement; live context occupancy; a persistent cross-session Lifetime Ledger; per-provider/model totals, hourly trends and 7/30-day views; dark/light theme switching; optional cost estimates (off by default) with a visual price editor and monthly budget alert; client-side skin ZIP import; JSON/CSV usage export; snapshot-only panel reads with background incremental indexing; and opt-in prompt enhancement with editable preview and DSH composer submission.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮桌面用量小宠物：用 12 个正式状态动作反馈请求、工具、上下文压缩、归档和提示词增强，展示实时上下文占用、跨会话终身用量账本、服务商/模型统计、小时趋势与近 7/30 日视图；支持深色/浅色主题切换；可选成本估算（默认关闭）与可视化价格表、月预算告警；客户端皮肤 ZIP 导入；JSON/CSV 用量导出；通过纯快照面板读取和后台增量索引避免打开面板时扫描历史，并提供用户主动触发、可编辑预览和直接发送的提示词增强。

description.en: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback to browser Web Speech, optional OpenAI-compatible ASR chain, polish through DSH-configured models, settings UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按或按住 Alt 听写，结果落进输入框草稿。默认本地离线 SenseVoice（离线、零配置、零 key），自动回退浏览器 Web Speech，可选 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR 服务链，可经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地视频制作与设计插件：多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地视频制作与设计插件：多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出

description.en: DSH / DeepSeek Harness 小说写作助手插件：章节库管理、句式模式分析（九类句式/情感曲线/风格指纹）、风格自检、伏笔登记、批量导入、续写辅助。Novel writing assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness: chapter library, sentence pattern analysis, style check, plot tracking, batch import, AI-assisted novel writing. dsh-plugin novel-writing ai-writing
description.zh: DSH / DeepSeek Harness 小说写作助手插件：章节库管理、句式模式分析（九类句式/情感曲线/风格指纹）、风格自检、伏笔登记、批量导入、续写辅助。Novel writing assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness: chapter library, sentence pattern analysis, style check, plot tracking, batch import, AI-assisted novel writing. dsh-plugin novel-writing ai-writing

description.en: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: 在deepseek harness中使用workbuddy api，因为公司只提供workbuddy积分
description.zh: 在deepseek harness中使用workbuddy api，因为公司只提供workbuddy积分

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
description.zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

description.en: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.
description.zh: 五种模式精读图书与文章（快速/深度/知识地图/费曼/全书），输出观点—证据—数据报告、四档置信度、Mermaid/XMind 思维导图，支持批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，可导出 MD/MM/HTML。

description.en: Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

description.en: Adds Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, Breeze and browser speech to DSH, with external provider and local model adapters, text filtering, streaming read-aloud, audio downloads, sound effects, desktop pets, QQ Bot and AI Passport integration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供小米 MiMo、豆包、Breeze 和浏览器语音，支持接入外部供应商与本地模型、文本过滤、实时流式朗读、音频下载、音效、桌宠及 QQ Bot、AI Passport 联动。

description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.
description.zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。

description.en: 🌹 Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort.
description.zh: 🌹将一切重复、烦躁的模板化提示词保存下来，只需要鼠标点击就注入对话框，节省您的精力损耗

description.en: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加动画桌面伙伴，支持任务提醒、会话聊天、角色包和原生设置。

description.en: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh: 为第三方供应商模型按模型配置思考强度与输入模态：知识库与原始 /models 端点取证融合建议并标注置信度，在官方「模型」页卡片内直接编辑。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 Trae 中国区模型接入 DSH，支持由 DSH 执行工具调用、账号切换，以及 Work/通用积分展示。

description.en: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。

description.en: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.
description.zh: 面向模型的 display_file 工具，在网页 UI 内联渲染 36 种扩展名：图片（点击开灯箱）、可拖进度条的视频、音频、PDF、经 LibreOffice 在 Host 转为 PDF 的 Office 与 OpenDocument 文件，以及沙箱 iframe 中的本地 HTML；字节由带 Range 支持的签名 HTTP 路由流式传输，PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 在支持图像输入的路由上同时进入模型上下文。

description.en: Lets a text-only agent watch a live screen or camera feed: every frame is scored by how much the picture changed, only the ones that matter are packed into one numbered sheet with an audio envelope, so the model looks at what actually changed instead of a screenshot every few seconds.
description.zh: 让只有文字的智能体「看」实时屏幕或摄像头：每帧按画面变化量打分，只把真正变了的帧拼成一张带编号、带音轨条的宫格图——看视频、看演示、看游戏都行，token 只花在变了的地方。

description.en: Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys are entered in a settings card that also toggles the web_fetch tool.
description.zh: 把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 作为 DSH 会话运行，同时保留其原生智能体循环、工具、技能、钩子和 MCP 集成。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance toolkit. Independently tune opacity + frosted-glass blur across 8 surfaces (main background, sidebar, cards & panels, inputs & controls, settings, conversation frame, trajectory view, produced/highlights — 9 with dsh-better-sidebar). Use any image or video as wallpaper with a drag-to-pan, scroll-to-zoom position editor and 5 layout modes (Fit/Fill/Stretch/Tile/Center); videos loop muted, survive refresh, and capture a live frame for preview, color extraction and framing. Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观一体化工具。对 8 个界面区域分别调节透明度与毛玻璃模糊（主背景、侧边栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页、产出物/高亮内容；安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后为 9 个）。用任意图片或视频做壁纸，配有拖动平移、滚轮缩放的位置编辑器与 5 种布局模式（适应/填充/拉伸/平铺/居中）；视频静音循环播放、刷新不丢失，并自动截取一帧用于预览、取色与构图。把多张图片加入轮换池（随机/顺序，每次刷新/每天/每周）自动更换。还包含 PS 风格色轮、一键从壁纸提取主题色、6 套预设 + 命名配置、昼夜自动切换与主题一键导出导入。

description.en: Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑内容、写日报，遇到值得看的会发评论 @ 你。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.
description.zh: DSH 精读与摘要：书籍/论文/视频/网页经可插拔解析器转成结构化 Obsidian 笔记，MapReduce 并行精读子代理、JSON Schema 输出与幂等缓存。

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
description.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。1M 上下文，同步全部元数据
description.zh: OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。1M 上下文，同步全部元数据

description.en: Human-led Kanban and AI-run workflows in one DSH plugin. Manage workspace tasks together with agents using draggable cards, search, priorities, labels, due dates, Markdown, images and comments. Create and edit reusable workflows through chat, configure stage models, and let AI execute each stage with DSH tools and permissions. Follow progress on a flowchart, inspect native stage conversations, approve results or send them back with feedback, and retry failed stages or terminate tasks. Preview files in each task's own artifact directory and use execution history and review feedback to improve workflows for future tasks.
description.zh: 一个插件，两种工作方式：面向人的看板与面向 AI 的工作流。看板支持与 Agent 共同管理工作区任务，提供拖拽卡片、搜索、优先级、标签、截止日期，以及 Markdown、图片和评论。工作流支持在对话中创建和修改可复用流程、配置阶段模型，由 AI 沿用 DSH 工具与授权逐阶段执行；通过流程图跟踪进度、查看原生阶段会话，在人工审核点通过或反馈打回，并支持失败重试与任务终止。每个任务拥有独立产物目录，可原地预览文件，还能结合执行历史和审核意见优化后续流程。

description.en: dsh session IDs for opencode, zero config.
description.zh: dsh session IDs for opencode, zero config.

description.en: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.
description.zh: 本地 GUI 管理你自己服务器上的 DSH 分身：SSH 隧道、远程会话混排列表、一键远程 GUI、隧道掉线自动重连。

description.en: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

description.en: AI4Scholar academic search: 38 tools over Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI resolution (search, citation graph, authors, recommendations, PDF full text in slices, auto-cite, scientific figures), a unified cross-platform search with de-duplication, an API-key card in Settings, and per-call credit accounting with an `/ai4scholar` balance card.
description.zh: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用量与消耗插件（dsh-usage-plugin）—— 每次调用的 token 用量/缓存命中统计、峰谷计费、余额查询、CSV/JSON/PNG 导出，可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量与消耗插件（dsh-usage-plugin）—— 每次调用的 token 用量/缓存命中统计、峰谷计费、余额查询、CSV/JSON/PNG 导出，可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: DSH Web UI little whale-maid theme with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, decorative assets, and a new built-in Codex-style pet.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 小鲸鱼女仆主题：亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与新增内置codex同款pet。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：对主程序与每个已装插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅按系统语言（中/英）列出可更新项；一键更新——主程序自动备份、完整性校验、失败回滚，插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包；更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

description.en: Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos, with a workflow library (graph extraction: per component / main flow / all), a load area with resolution auto-match, a live queue, SDXL and Wan 2.1 templates, a companion skill, and a same-origin media proxy.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接驱动本地或远程 ComfyUI：comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow 工具生成与编辑图像、视频，附带工作流库（图工作流提取：按分量 / 主流程 / 整体）、加载区分辨率自动匹配、实时队列、SDXL 与 Wan 2.1 模板、配套 skill 与同源媒体代理。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code / Codex 派发任务给 DSH Agent：原生子代理进度、按能力分层预设的宿主内工作会话，以及为纯文本 Harness 提供视觉与图像生成的多模态桥。

description.en: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
description.zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

description.en: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端适配：窄屏下把桌面三栏布局改造成触屏友好的手机布局（覆盖式抽屉、可拖拽悬浮按钮、全屏弹窗、上滑加载历史），1024px 断点内生效，桌面端零影响。 — 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DSH with parallel projects across hosts, file browsing and editing, recursive search, terminals, Git diffs, and Agent tools to edit, build and test remotely. Optional IDE layout.
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 远程工作区：多主机项目并行、文件浏览与编辑、递归搜索、终端、Git 差异，以及 Agent 远程编辑、构建与测试；可选 IDE 布局。

description.en: One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.
description.zh: 一条命令备份、恢复与迁移 DSH 全部用户数据（~/.dsh），附可视化设置面板：定时自动备份与每日/每周分级保留、sha256 校验、失败自动回滚并回执的加固恢复、分类型子集备份（--types）、凭据脱敏进本机 vault、GitHub 私有仓库同步跨机迁移、宿主起不来也能用的进程外救援通道（备份目录内置零依赖救援网页）。/backup doctor 从已知良好备份体检并定点修复损坏会话日志、轮换前先隔离；migrate-check 迁移预检在升级前静态扫描，预测哪些会话会被新宿主拒绝（冻结清单、文件名代际不匹配、硬链接、旧版凭据布局等）；凭据哨兵在宿主改写前自动存底；智能备份在宿主升级前快照；/backup check-update 与 /backup update 感知并一键更新（先留快照）。恢复链路支持含附件硬链接的归档与超大归档（清单走原始流逐行校验）。当前 npm 版本 0.13.4；覆盖 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2–0.2.0-rc.1，含 0.2.0 起的安装期 peer 闸门。macOS/Linux/Windows。

description.en: Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.
description.zh: 通知提醒 / 消息提醒 / 消息通知 / 桌面通知弹窗 / 桌面提醒 / 弹窗通知、弹窗提醒 / 任务提醒、任务完成提醒 / 后台提醒、回复完成提醒 / 审批提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或任务、回复跑完时，弹出系统通知（可操作提醒、审批通知、完成通知）与提示音，并标记标签页标题；这是一款 DSH 通知提醒插件、DSH 提醒插件、消息通知插件，设置页可开关提醒、调音量、切换中英文通知语言。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool (multi-account rotation, live credits, and a model catalog showing per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags).
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣。

description.en: Multi-engine web search and evidence synthesis for AI coding agents. Unified MCP server, Pi extension, and DeepSeek Harness bundle — free search, X/Twitter, parallel research, and TUI setup.
description.zh: Multi-engine web search and evidence synthesis for AI coding agents. Unified MCP server, Pi extension, and DeepSeek Harness bundle — free search, X/Twitter, parallel research, and TUI setup.

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.
description.zh: 导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

description.en: Study workspace for DeepSeek Harness: imports your own PDF, DOCX, PPTX and Markdown materials plus lecture recordings, turns them into source-cited flashcards, quizzes and open questions, and schedules spaced review with FSRS-6 in a built-in web panel. Imported recordings are transcribed with your own SiliconFlow, Groq or Gemini key; live classes can instead use an on-device SenseVoice engine that needs no key (about 239 MB on first install); requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later but below 0.3.
description.zh: DSH 的学习工作台：导入自己的 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、Markdown 资料与课堂录音，生成带出处引用的卡片、测验与开放题，按 FSRS-6 安排间隔复习，自带网页面板。导入的录音需用自备的 SiliconFlow、Groq 或 Gemini 密钥转写；课堂实录可改用本机 SenseVoice 引擎，无需密钥（首次约下载 239 MB）；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上、0.3 以下。

description.en: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: Multi-model council for DeepSeek Harness: independent answers, anonymous peer reviews, and an inspectable final decision.
description.zh: Multi-model council for DeepSeek Harness: independent answers, anonymous peer reviews, and an inspectable final decision.
