description.en: Knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: assembles ContextWindow evidence at query time within heading boundaries and token budgets, with follow-up reading around each search anchor; combines BM25/vector search via weighted RRF, MMR and optional local/remote reranking; provides automatic evidence injection, a browser panel for local embedding/rerank/OCR model downloads and health checks, keyword search without model downloads, and in-place rescans of imported directories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 知识库：查询时按标题边界与 Token 预算动态组织 ContextWindow 证据，支持围绕命中锚点续读原文；通过加权 RRF 融合 BM25 与向量召回，支持 MMR 去冗余和本地／远程重排；提供回答前自动证据注入、本地 embedding／rerank／OCR 模型下载与健康检查面板、无需下载模型的关键词检索，以及导入目录原地重扫。

description.en: Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness: search and read papers in conversation, audit the literature trail, and browse the literature panel. It uses the same package name (dsh-zotero) as kuangdang123/dsh-zotero, so only one of the two can be installed per profile.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Zotero 插件：在对话中检索与阅读文献、在文献轨迹中核对记录，并在文献面板浏览文献库。包名与 kuangdang123/dsh-zotero 相同（dsh-zotero），同一个 profile 里只能装其中一个。

description.en: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
description.zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

description.en: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.
description.zh: 管理 soul.md 人设卡与长期记忆，支持按工作区和会话选择人设，并提供读取和更新工具。

description.en: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.
description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.
description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一个会话内容检索——标题/内容一键切换，还能按用户/回复/工具筛选

description.en: Opt-in Tavily search, extract, map, and crawl tools with multi-key rotation and failover, a usage gauge, and a settings card, without replacing the built-in web_search.
description.zh: 可选启用的 Tavily 搜索、内容提取、站点地图与爬取工具，支持多密钥轮换与故障转移、用量仪表盘和设置卡片，保留内置 web_search。

description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: Uses a looping silent clip as the chat background with adjustable opacity, and plays a startup animation with sound. On first launch under a light theme it switches once to dark, with an undo prompt.
description.zh: 把一段循环短片铺成聊天背景（可调透明度），启动时再播放一段有声片头动画。首次启动若为浅色主题，会一次性切到深色（附撤销提示）。

description.zh: 基于 Seedream 生图与 MiniMax 图生视频，从参考图生成游戏素材，本地绿幕抠像后合成八方向精灵图、序列帧与骨骼动画。

description.en: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。

description.en: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.
description.zh: 在输入框上方列出已发送但模型尚未读取的插话消息，可在模型读取前逐条或一次性撤回。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats into DSH, with two-way text, image, file, audio and video messaging and slash commands for sessions, workspaces, models, permissions and more; the goal is DSH's native experience inside WeChat.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到 DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输，用 slash 命令管理会话、工作区、模型、权限等等，目标是在微信端还原 DSH 的原生体验。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
description.zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

description.en: Tavern management panel for DeepSeek Harness: character cards, worldbooks and presets with per-session isolation, memory summaries, a character relationship web, one-click plot options and an NSFW mode. The full experience also needs the companion plugins dsh-muv-engine and dsh-muv-table, which render the status bar, the plot options and the variable tables. Card-provided status bars, variable folds and option cards now render inside a sandboxed iframe, so card styles no longer leak into the host UI.
description.zh: 酒馆管理面板：多角色卡、多世界书、多预设与会话级隔离，记忆总结、角色关系网、剧情选项一键发送，另有 NSFW 模式。完整效果需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-engine 与 dsh-muv-table，用于渲染状态栏、剧情选项与变量表格。角色卡自带的状态栏 / 变量折叠 / 选项卡片在沙盒 iframe 中渲染，卡内样式不再外溢到宿主界面。

description.en: Local-first MCP App for scientific figures. Import, review, and publish a global library on disk; reuse exact templates in Pi, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Wisp.
description.zh: Local-first MCP App for scientific figures. Import, review, and publish a global library on disk; reuse exact templates in Pi, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Wisp.

description.en: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的网页访问层：把 JS 渲染或受保护的页面抓成干净 markdown，聚合搜索 14 个引擎，并提供有状态交互会话（点击、输入、滚动、eval、截图），引擎可托管可自部署（Rust 单二进制）。每个会话带直播页 URL，人能实时围观 agent 浏览并用鼠标接管。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: Token optimization for DeepSeek Harness with searchable MCP tool discovery and lazy loading, configurable compaction controls and status reporting, tool-output reduction, long-text vision summarization, and opt-in conversation archiving with paginated retrieval.
description.zh: Token 优化：支持可搜索的 MCP 工具发现与懒加载、可配置的压缩控制与状态查看、工具输出精简、长文本视觉摘要，以及可选的对话原文归档与分页回查。

description.en: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
description.zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

description.en: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
description.zh: 将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图表，支持流式输出、图形/代码切换、全屏缩放与拖拽、SVG 导出，以及内置的同源运行时。

description.en: Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成可视化圆桌会议：环形专家拓扑、连线协作、汇聚网关、代理思考，以及「针锋相对」红队评审（观点支持/驳回）。

description.en: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.
description.zh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。

description.en: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供安全远程访问：登录门禁、MFA/TOTP、签名会话 Cookie、可选的 admin/user/guest 角色、浏览器内工作区选择和按允许目录限制的远程文件预览。

description.en: Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.
description.zh: 通过官方 unity CLI 在 DSH 中操作 Unity 编辑器：实时场景命令、编辑器内 C# 求值、运行时命令发现，均复用常驻的 unity shell 会话；另有原始 CLI 通道用于建工程、跑测试与构建。同时挂载 Unity 官方技能集，以及插件自带的 Unity 工作流与 Asset Store 技能。

description.en: Lets the DSH agent operate your Windows apps and web pages: it reads controls through UI Automation, clicks, types, captures the screen and reads text with OCR, and works on web pages in its own browser in the background, without moving your mouse; when it needs your mouse or keyboard, an on-screen indicator appears and Esc stops it.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 agent 直接操作你的 Windows 桌面程序和网页：用 UI Automation 读控件，点击、输入、截图、识别文字；网页在它自己的浏览器里后台完成，不动你的鼠标；需要用鼠标键盘时屏幕会提示，按 Esc 立刻停下。

description.en: 基于deepseek harness的类MiniMax-Design的AI视频创作工作台
description.zh: 基于deepseek harness的类MiniMax-Design的AI视频创作工作台

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Use plugins from ecosystems such as Claude Code and Codex in DSH: add Git plugin sources and marketplaces, upload plugins and skills, add MCP servers, automatically discover and toggle local skills, and manage plugins, skills and MCP in one place, including plugin-provided subagents, Hooks and LSP.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等软件生态的插件，一站式管理插件、Skills 与 MCP。支持添加 Git 插件源和 marketplace、上传插件和 Skills、添加 MCP 服务器，自动扫描并开关本地 Skills，接入插件提供的子代理、MCP、Hooks 与 LSP。

description.en: Bloom Morandi theme: fifteen variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender, mint, tangerine, silverrose, dawn, osmanthus) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even; twelve are featured in the top-bar switcher, grouped by color family, and all 30 foreground/background pairs are measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十五款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender、草色 mint、橙黄 tangerine、银红 silverrose、粉霞 dawn、轻黄 osmanthus）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变；顶栏切换器精选 12 套并按色系相邻排列，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，30 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar, built on MarkText's muya engine: open a .md file, edit it as a rendered document, and save back through ctx.fs with a version guard.
description.zh: 基于 MarkText 内核 muya 的右侧栏所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器：打开 .md 按渲染结果编辑，保存走 ctx.fs 并带版本守卫。

description.en: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

description.en: Minecraft development for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), covering Minecraft 1.7.10 through 26.3: 9 skills for Paper/Spigot plugins, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mods, addon development against major mods, and Gradle/JDK setup per era; the mc_scaffold generator and mc_gradle runner; 18 offline API signature indexes generated from the pinned artefacts with provenance headers; and mc_arbitrate, a deterministic sharded pipeline (contract freeze, per-shard briefs, 21 high-confidence audit rules including 5 cross-shard checks, manifest merge, compile-error routing) that calls no model inside the engine. Apache-2.0 with NOTICE.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 Minecraft 开发插件，覆盖 Minecraft 1.7.10 至 26.3：9 个技能（Paper/Spigot 插件、Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 模组、大型模组附属、分时代 Gradle/JDK 构建）、mc_scaffold 项目生成器与 mc_gradle 构建执行器、18 份由钉选工件生成且带 provenance 头的离线 API 签名索引，以及确定性分片流水线 mc_arbitrate（契约冻结、分片任务书、21 条高置信审计规则含 5 条跨分片检查、清单合并、编译错误定点路由），引擎内部不调用模型。Apache-2.0 + NOTICE。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: A workbench for engineering and math problems, with nine tools for reading images, solving, plotting and verifying answers, plus four bundled skills. Needs Python with numpy and Pillow. Image reading, figure checking and formula typesetting rely on a vision provider you have configured a key for, so those images are sent to it, and without a key they fail while the other tools still work.
description.zh: 工科与数学题解工作台：九个工具覆盖读题、求解、出图与校核，另附四个随包技能。需要带 numpy 与 Pillow 的 Python。读图、图形校核与公式排版依赖你已配置密钥的视觉模型提供商，图片会发给它；未配置密钥时这些功能报失败，其余工具照常可用。

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: Bundles five skills — web slide decks, social card images, typeset web pages, Chinese de-AI editing (humanizer-zh) and a writing-voice profile — with the first three sharing one design system (magazine and Swiss themes, contrast-checked brand colours). Adds a sidebar page that lists your works with thumbnails, opens a new session with a draft that reuses a work's theme and layout, offers six content workflows, and collects the messages you sent in local dsh sessions as study material for the voice profile.
description.zh: 打包五个 skill：网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、中文去 AI 味（humanizer-zh）和语气档案，前三个共用一套设计系统（杂志风与瑞士风主题、按对比度校验的品牌色）。侧栏页面列出你做过的作品和缩略图，「做同款」会在新会话里按这份作品的主题和版式填好草稿；提供六个内容生产工作流；把你在本机 dsh 会话里发过的消息整理成语气档案的学习素材。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

description.en: A-share watchlist real-time market monitoring plugin: a collapsible popup in the top-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web interface for real-time quote monitoring, group switching, intraday and candlestick (K-line) charts, and buy/sell target price settings.
description.zh: A 股自选股实时行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面的右上角显示一个可折叠弹窗，实时监控自选股行情、切换分组、查看分时与 K 线、设置买卖目标价。

description.en: 🌹 Port all 38 opencode themes into DeepSeek Harness, light and dark alike: quiet Tokyo Night, soft Catppuccin, easy on the eyes Zenburn. Plus 25 IP theme capsules: Genshin, Kuromi, Doraemon, Hello Kitty, Harry Potter, Cyberpunk 2077, Dragon Ball, Naruto, One Piece, Pokémon, Sailor Moon, Star Wars, Transformers, Ultraman, Zelda, Super Mario, Evangelion, LEGO, Marvel, DC, Disney, four of them in a second light/dark take, each with its own soul. And every theme is fully editable, so you can craft one that is entirely your own.
description.zh: 🌹将opencode的38款主题搬进DSH，明暗兼收：东京之夜沉静、卡布奇诺轻柔、禅燃护眼；另备25款主题胶囊，原神、原神·夜航、库洛米、哆啦A梦、HelloKitty、哈利波特、赛博朋克2077、龙珠、火影忍者、火影忍者·暗部、海贼王、宝可梦、美少女战士、星球大战、变形金刚、奥特曼、塞尔达传说、超级马里奥、超级马里奥·夜行、新世纪福音战士、新世纪福音战士·晴空、乐高、漫威、DC、迪士尼，各有其魂；每款主题都可逐色细改，打造属于您的专属主题。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
description.zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness through OpenAI's Codex sign-in flow
description.zh: Use your ChatGPT subscription in DeepSeek Harness through OpenAI's Codex sign-in flow

description.en: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.
description.zh: 仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: Right-sidebar basket that collects the files a session produced or changed without the agent having to register them, with preview, zip packaging, and one-click archiving.
description.zh: 右侧栏「鱼篓」不用 agent 登记，自动汇总本场会话产出或改动的文件，支持预览、一键打包 zip 与归档。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

description.en: Translate DSH reasoning, tasks, answers and review reasons into 9 languages. Ollama, custom OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or Google/Bing; ordered fallback, local model memory controls, originals preserved.
description.zh: DSH Web 显示层翻译：思考链、任务、可选回答和审查拒绝理由，支持 9 种语言；本地 Ollama、自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic API、Google/Bing，按序回退与本地模型内存管理，原文保留。

description.en: Multi-agent workflow for math-modeling contests: the "UltraMath" preset runs a problem from reading through framework, derivation, coding, verification, paper and review, plus 4 single-stage role presets (mathematician, engineer, writer, reviewer) and 33 model-library skill docs.
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解工作流：「UltraMath」主控预设一个预设跑通 读题→框架→推导→编码→验算→论文→审稿 全流程，另有 数学家/工程师/作家/审稿人 4 个单阶段角色预设与 33 篇模型库技能文档。

description.en: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, inspect, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, plus a skill market with tracked source sync and one-click update-all. It uses the same package name (dsh-skill-hub) and mount id (skill-hub) as hoshino114/dsh-skill-hub and amd47802574/dsh-skill-hub, so only one of the three can be installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中枢：基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表浏览、搜索、启停、查看、诊断并新建本地技能，附技能市场：来源快照跟踪、一键全量更新。包名 dsh-skill-hub 和挂载 id skill-hub 与 hoshino114/dsh-skill-hub、amd47802574/dsh-skill-hub 相同，三者只能装一个。

description.en: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线可用的 UI/UX 设计智能库：内置 84 种设计风格、192 个配色、74 组字体、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表与 22 个技术栈，提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search 三个工具，中文优先、零运行依赖。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
description.zh: 基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

description.en: Cline 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Cline 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.
description.zh: 点开输入框旁的上下文圆环即见本轮账单：缓存命中/未命中/输出各花多少钱（¥），官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定；非 DeepSeek 官方路由不显示。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist. Retired by the author: published npm versions stay installable but receive no further DSH adaptations (migration guide: docs/migrations/dsh-lan-proxy.md in the repository).
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。作者已退役：已发布的 npm 版本仍可安装，但不再适配新版 DSH（迁移说明见仓库 docs/migrations/dsh-lan-proxy.md）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
description.zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供的思考循环守护插件：模型陷入「只想不做」的退化循环时自动打断，不必再手动中止
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供的思考循环守护插件：模型陷入「只想不做」的退化循环时自动打断，不必再手动中止

description.en: 🐋 DeepSeek 娘桌宠：住进 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的蓝发鲸鱼女仆。工作链路、任务完成统计（用时/消耗/花费）、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮、完整设置面板。
description.zh: 🐋 DeepSeek 娘桌宠：住进 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的蓝发鲸鱼女仆。工作链路、任务完成统计（用时/消耗/花费）、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮、完整设置面板。

description.en: Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP: 62 tools. Modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk safety gate, release/reconnect, fit with initial/fixed/weighted params, fine-grained plot and sheet edits, matrix tools, FigureSpec declarative YAML (diff-able and replayable), MCP Resources read-only snapshot, matplotlib-figure bridge, PowerPoint assembly with panel labels, Graph Gallery template search, EPS export, file-access whitelist, visual regression baseline, and editable OPJU delivery with deterministic readback verification.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 AI 对话里驱动 OriginLab Origin 科学绘图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连、拟合初值/固定参数/加权、细粒度图与工作表编辑、矩阵工具、FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）、MCP Resources 只读会话快照、matplotlib 图桥接、PowerPoint 组图、Graph Gallery 模板搜索、EPS 导出、文件访问白名单、视觉基准回归，以及带确定性反读验证的可编辑 OPJU 交付。

description.en: Replaces the dsh web startup to allow binding 0.0.0.0, gated by username/password login: signed session cookies, /api route protection, an auth tab in the settings panel, and a reset CLI that rotates the signing key to invalidate all sessions.
description.zh: 替换 dsh web 启动器以允许绑定 0.0.0.0，并以账号密码登录为门槛：签名会话 cookie、/api 路由保护、设置面板认证标签页，以及轮换签名密钥使全部会话失效的重置 CLI。

description.en: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.
description.zh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: environment variable / secret management, MCP server configuration, Prompt management, Profile management, RSS / news aggregation, and a desktop client launcher。
description.zh: dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: environment variable / secret management, MCP server configuration, Prompt management, Profile management, RSS / news aggregation, and a desktop client launcher。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.
description.zh: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: Stable, editable PPTX generation for AI agents — semantic IR in, native DrawingML out. DSH plugin + Claude Code plugin + CLI. | 给 AI agent 的稳定可编辑 PPTX 生成：语义 IR 进，原生 DrawingML 出。DSH 插件 / Claude Code 插件 / CLI。
description.zh: Stable, editable PPTX generation for AI agents — semantic IR in, native DrawingML out. DSH plugin + Claude Code plugin + CLI. | 给 AI agent 的稳定可编辑 PPTX 生成：语义 IR 进，原生 DrawingML 出。DSH 插件 / Claude Code 插件 / CLI。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

description.en: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 补齐缺失的 IDE 工作台：对话页可拖拽三栏（对话 / 编辑器 / 文件与 Git），多标签编辑（保存、新建、路径面包屑、行内 diff）、工作区 Terminal、文件树（按名筛选、用外部编辑器打开）、源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送/拉取、分支切换、提交图）、状态栏，以及 git_* 模型工具。

description.en: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.
description.zh: 通过 cad_view/cad_info 与 OCCT 参数化建模工具查看和构建 CAD 模型（STL、OBJ、STEP、IGES、DXF、SVG），并在 Web UI 中提供交互式查看卡片与常驻 CAD 面板。

description.en: DSH plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill: create, edit and export PPT slides and presentations as a locally generated .pptx with Pillow-rendered previews, no browser needed.
description.zh: 内含 kimi-ppt 技能的 DSH 插件：创建、编辑与导出 PPT 幻灯片和演示文稿，本地生成 .pptx，Pillow 渲染预览图，不需要浏览器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: the AgentRouter relay as one pi-ai route with a domestic/international endpoint switch, plus the outbound request compatibility the relay requires.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness bundle: the AgentRouter relay as one pi-ai route with a domestic/international endpoint switch, plus the outbound request compatibility the relay requires.

description.en: Permanent session deletion in the native DeepSeek Harness menu, with second confirmation and in-place refresh
description.zh: Permanent session deletion in the native DeepSeek Harness menu, with second confirmation and in-place refresh

description.en: Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.
description.zh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

description.en: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

description.en: Use a Kimi Code subscription in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota display, and composer usage
description.zh: Use a Kimi Code subscription in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota display, and composer usage

description.en: Personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness that turns conversational commitments into cross-session plans, reminders, and an auditable dashboard.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的个人助手：从对话中整理跨会话事项与计划，通过提醒和可审计的助手看板持续跟进。

description.en: Session Steward for DSH: browse and bulk-prune the official session archive set, and run a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Never rewrites session logs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的会话管家：浏览并批量清理官方会话归档集合，并对会话做四门体检（日志完整性 / 投影缓存 / 无损 JSON / 冷读），最终给出可逆、先备份的处方。不改写会话日志。

description.en: 为会话增加管理菜单、归档会话管理、轮次级删除、重新生成，以及右侧话题快捷导航。Add a management menu for conversations, archive conversation management, delete by round, regenerate, and a quick topic navigation on the right.
description.zh: 为会话增加管理菜单、归档会话管理、轮次级删除、重新生成，以及右侧话题快捷导航。Add a management menu for conversations, archive conversation management, delete by round, regenerate, and a quick topic navigation on the right.

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器管理插件：可视化界面管理 + 按需热注入，OAuth 鉴权支持，环境变量配置。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器管理插件：可视化界面管理 + 按需热注入，OAuth 鉴权支持，环境变量配置。

description.en: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的精致悬浮鲸鱼桌宠，拥有 95 个分类透明动画、状态感知事件回应、可自定义动作与触发规则，并支持点击互动、拖拽和屏幕漫游。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugins market｜DSH 插件市场
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugins market｜DSH 插件市场

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页统一管理 DSH / Codex / Claude 的 AI 技能：热开关启停、GitHub 技能市场一键发现安装、本地 ZIP 导入（dsh-plugin skill hub）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页统一管理 DSH / Codex / Claude 的 AI 技能：热开关启停、GitHub 技能市场一键发现安装、本地 ZIP 导入（dsh-plugin skill hub）

description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: LSP action surface for DSH: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename, all backed by real language servers.
description.zh: DSH 的 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码动作、符号、签名提示、inlay 提示与重命名，全部由真实语言服务器驱动。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 邮件工具插件：含 email_watch 增量新邮件检查、email_mark（已读/未读/星标/移动文件夹）与 email_reply（回复/回复全部/转发，自动线程头+引文）的十工具，Web 设置页与鲸鱼娘递信新邮件弹窗，since/until 日期范围过滤，内置 QQ/163/126/新浪/阿里/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud 预设，多账号、连接复用与发信审批门；Outlook OAuth2 设备码登录开箱即用（内置社区客户端，账号仍可填自己的 clientId 覆盖）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直接重写 SKILL.md 的 user-invocable 策略位）。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Deepseek Harness Walioffice 办公软件 插件
description.zh: Deepseek Harness Walioffice 办公软件 插件

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页中归档、恢复并删除会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Garmin Connect — AI-powered fitness data access
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Garmin Connect — AI-powered fitness data access

description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.
description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。

description.en: Chinese traditional colors as a DeepSeek Harness theme pack.
description.zh: Chinese traditional colors as a DeepSeek Harness theme pack.

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从 DSH 中永久删除会话，并可选择递归删除派生对话和子智能体会话。

description.en: 把 dsh-purge 移植适配到 dsh-go（Android + proot）：只保留核心破甲能力——提示词注入层 + 86 条引擎源码补丁（探测/应用/回滚）。桌面版的 Electron 适配、asar 解包、计划任务等全部抛弃；为达到原版破甲效果，审批与沙箱一并放开。
description.zh: 把 dsh-purge 移植适配到 dsh-go（Android + proot）：只保留核心破甲能力——提示词注入层 + 86 条引擎源码补丁（探测/应用/回滚）。桌面版的 Electron 适配、asar 解包、计划任务等全部抛弃；为达到原版破甲效果，审批与沙箱一并放开。

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

description.en: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 一站式 AI 影视创作工作站，作为 DSH 全局浮层面板运行，不占用对话框：生图（文生图 / 图生图 / 多图合成，1K–4K、8 种宽高比）、生视频（文生视频 / 图生视频，4–12 秒、支持首帧控制）、短剧（导入 .txt/.md/.json 剧本自动拆解分镜，故事板预览与批量生成）与提示词专家工作区。零运行时依赖。

description.en: DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.
description.zh: DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。

description.en: Visually configure an agent's prompt, tools, visible skills, subagents and fallback models, and assemble several of them into a team. It never writes or edits any host preset file.
description.zh: 可视化地自定义配置 Agent 的提示词、工具、可见技能、子代理与备用模型，把它们编成一支团队。不写宿主的任何预设文件。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: MCP management panel for the DSH web UI: per-server status, transport and full tool input schema, with add/edit/enable/disable/remove in global and project scopes, reconnect for global servers, a five-server built-in catalog, and config import from ten other clients with a preview. A project's MCP servers share one connection per (project, serverName) — the first session opens it and the last one closes it — so concurrent sessions reuse a single mcp-client instance; the panel shows how many sessions share it and marks a config change as pending until the connection is rebuilt.
description.zh: DSH 网页的 MCP 管理面板：查看每个服务器的状态、传输方式与完整工具入参 Schema，在全局与项目两种作用域下新增/编辑/启停/移除（重连仅全局），可从 5 个内置服务器一键安装，或从另外 10 种客户端导入配置（预览后写入）。项目 MCP 按「项目目录 + serverName」共用一份连接：第一个会话建立、最后一个会话释放，同项目的并发会话因此复用同一个 mcp-client 实例；面板会标出当前有几个会话在共用它，以及配置改动是否待生效。

description.en: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
description.zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

description.en: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠，桌面端和网页端都能用：SVG 动画和表情随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错／等待确认），还能跟随其他在跑的会话并用角标显示个数；可戳可拖、能甩晕、按在屏幕边上会压扁，鼠标在头顶来回蹭就是摸头；7 套色板、4 档大小、合成音效，跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: QA pipeline as 10 agent skills: requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing and review, E2E (Playwright) and API automation, exploratory, regression scope and bug analysis, backed by a shared knowledge base with format rules, risk model and schema validators.
description.zh: 软件测试全流程技能包：10 个技能覆盖需求分析、测试策略、用例编写与审查、E2E（Playwright）与 API 自动化、探索式测试、回归范围与 Bug 分析，共享知识库提供格式规范、风险模型与 Schema 校验脚本。

description.en: VSCode Remote-SSH-style development for DSH — connect to HPC and servers over SSH, read and edit remote files in the built-in Files tab, auto-SSH terminal, remote workspaces with single-roundtrip reads and result caching, and 12 session-aware remote_ssh_* model tools.
description.zh: 类 VSCode Remote-SSH 的 DSH 插件：SSH 连接超算/服务器，内置文件页签直读远程文件、终端页签自动 SSH，远程工作区配单往返合并读与结果缓存，含 12 个会话感知的 remote_ssh_* 模型工具。

description.en: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
description.zh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

description.en: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
description.zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Python engine: core layer needs faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp (~200-300MB); the optional semantic layer adds ~2GB of torch / transformers / ultralytics. A bundled doctor --fix sets up the venv and installs both.
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python 引擎：核心层需 faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp（约 200-300MB）；可选语义层另需约 2GB 的 torch / transformers / ultralytics。内置 doctor --fix 一键建 venv 并装齐两者。

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 搜番插件：对话内多源搜索番剧，卡片展示 Bangumi 评分与详情，支持复制磁力。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 搜番插件：对话内多源搜索番剧，卡片展示 Bangumi 评分与详情，支持复制磁力。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails: 24 novel_* tools enforce fact-ledger consistency, outline and chapter gates, a deterministic machine audit with a zero-token AI-flavor scan, and proposal-only revisions; a right-panel workbench covers reading, TTS playback, whole-book checks and batch drafting with checkpoint resume.
description.zh: 网文写作护栏：24 个 novel_* 工具把设定账本一致性、细纲与章节门禁、确定性机审（含零 token 的去 AI 味扫描）和仅提议式修订落到代码里；右侧工作台支持阅读、TTS 朗读、全书检查和带断点续跑的批量起草。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: Strips the harness-injected prefix and suffix system prompts so the agent runs on the preset's native prompt alone, for soft-jailbreak catgirl persona simulation: ships a bundled plugin that idempotently deploys the 猫娘 Yuike preset to ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/ and never overwrites an edited preset.
description.zh: 通过自带插件去除 harness 前置与后置注入提示词，仅使用预设原生提示词运行，实现软破限与猫娘人格模拟：将猫娘 Yuike 预设幂等部署到 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/，不覆盖已编辑的预设。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Registers the domestic-China trip-planning skill: hour-level daily timelines, 12306 and Trip.com booking deep links, offline KML, and seven HTML themes. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH (the bundled scripts are standard-library only).
description.zh: 把境内旅行规划技能注册进 DSH 技能目录：逐小时每日时间线、12306 与携程/去哪儿预订深链、离线 KML 与七套 HTML 主题。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（内置脚本仅依赖标准库）。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet. v0.16 turns the memory graph into an interactive 3D sphere (Canvas, zero dependency): drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, drag nodes to arrange them in 3D, double-click empty space to reset, auto-spin (reduced-motion aware); hover or click a node to instantly light up its neighbours (displacement+duration click threshold), and colours adapt to light/dark panel themes. v0.17 adds graph search (ranked matches, the camera flies to the hit and lights up its neighbours), Reveal in Finder / Copy path for any node (the host command is awaited, and the absolute path is copied automatically when reveal fails), Windows support (path-variable expansion, CRLF parsing with style-preserving writes, explorer /select, argv and exit-code handling, case-insensitive workspace matching), plus a much shorter README with real screenshots. v0.18 (issue #8) adds a boot snapshot mode: session freezes the boot block for the session so mid-session memory writes no longer invalidate the prompt-prefix cache (the volatile recent-log tail now rides in its own late context segment), with live kept as the default; double-clicking a memory node now opens the note in the DSH right sidebar (falling back to Finder/Explorer). v0.19 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.19.2 or newer (0.19.5 is latest). Settings, dashboard and composer chip keep working on both the legacy and the rc.2 host APIs.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。v0.14 新增按会话记忆开关：输入框芯片（下拉可选本会话 / 此工作区默认）、/memory on|off|status 命令与设置面板开关共用同一判定——关闭后该会话不注入 boot 块、不发 digest/追忆提醒、不盖 last_access（记忆文件不删）；disabledWorkspaces 可让整个项目默认关闭，会话选择持久化 7 天。v0.15 新增「人格基础（快速铸魂）」卡片：我的名字 / 你的称呼 / 基础人格描述，保存写入 SOUL.md 受管区块（其余内容一字不动）并把 BOOTSTRAP 标 complete；对话铸魂的老库会从 SOUL 文本回显，未铸魂时 boot 块会先提醒用户完成铸魂。v0.16 把记忆图谱升级为可交互 3D 球面（Canvas 手绘、零依赖）：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、拖节点 3D 整理布局、双击空白重置、自动慢转（尊重减少动态效果）；悬停或点击节点即时高亮邻居（位移+时长点击阈值），配色随浅色/深色面板自适应。v0.17 新增图谱搜索（排序匹配，镜头飞到命中的节点并点亮邻居）、节点的「在 Finder 中显示 / 复制路径」（等待命令结果，失败自动复制路径兜底）、Windows 兼容（路径变量展开、CRLF 读写保留换行风格、explorer 参数与退出码处理、工作区大小写匹配），README 精简并加入真实截图。v0.18（issue #8）新增 boot 快照模式：session 在本会话固化 boot 块，会话中途写记忆不再让前缀缓存失效（最近动态改走独立的靠后 context 段），默认仍是 live；双击记忆节点改为在 DSH 右侧栏打开该文件（打不开时回退系统文件管理器）。v0.19 兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2：agent 注册表优先 agents.roots()、缺失时回退 agents.list()，所有 agent/created 监听器都做了异常保护——rc.2 下未保护的抛错会让 agent 注册被拒、无法新建会话，因此 rc.2 用户必须升级到 0.19.2 或更新版本（最新 0.19.5）。设置面板、看板与输入框 chip 在老宿主与 rc.2 上均可工作。

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Bridge local Qoder / Qoder CN models into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Bridge local Qoder / Qoder CN models into DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Deepseek Harness插件，可以直接在Deepseek Harness中使用网页版deepseek进行聊天，并将聊天过程直接迁移到Deepseek Harness进一步进行开发。主要目的是节省前期方案讨论时的token
description.zh: Deepseek Harness插件，可以直接在Deepseek Harness中使用网页版deepseek进行聊天，并将聊天过程直接迁移到Deepseek Harness进一步进行开发。主要目的是节省前期方案讨论时的token

description.en: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.9.2, npm dsh-expert-mode, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 17 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. Features: taskboard scheduler (file-system task state machine pending/ready/running/done/failed, dependency DAG, atomic claim, retry, crash recovery), quality gates (5-stage pipeline for high-risk tasks: requirement clarity, implementation, verification, independent review, integration, with 2-round rework limit), Five-Anchor constraint (review/convergence/anti-drift/collaboration-check/resource-awareness per turn), Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert), progressive disclosure (~28% token savings), expert persistence, inter-expert file message bus (direct P2P comm, zero coordinator relay), cross review, experience pool, fast-track for simple tasks, fault recovery with auto-retry. Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance, backend, DevOps, database, QA, security.
description.zh: 专家模式 agent preset（v0.9.2，npm 包 dsh-expert-mode，双语双份）：首席协调官 + 17 位领域专家子代理，按任务特性自动委派。特性：任务调度器（文件系统任务状态机 pending/ready/running/done/failed + 依赖DAG + 原子认领 + 重试 + 崩溃恢复）、质量门禁（高风险任务五段式：需求澄清→实现→验证→独立评审→集成，最多回炉2轮）、五锚约束（每轮回顾/收敛/反跑题/协作检查/资源感知自检）+ 近距离引导（身份/任务/输出格式模板）+ 渐进式披露（省token约28%）+ 专家持久化 + 专家间文件消息总线（P2P直连，零协调官中转）+ 交叉评审 + 经验沉淀 + 简单任务快速通道 + 故障自动重试。专家：数据分析/文案/法务/产品/前端/UI-UX/架构/社交运营/增长/量化/财务/后端/DevOps/数据库/QA/安全/生图短视频。

description.en: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness — the agent writes TSX and the web UI compiles every frame as it streams, so a card renders while its JSX is still unclosed. Inline in the conversation, or in a side canvas.
description.zh: Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness — the agent writes TSX and the web UI compiles every frame as it streams, so a card renders while its JSX is still unclosed. Inline in the conversation, or in a side canvas.

description.en: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 当前应用的壁纸经本地桥接同步为 DSH Web 界面背景：预览/捕获/完整三档渲染、显示器锁定、本地与市场壁纸库面板、专注透镜与眼动追踪、沉浸模式，以及支持直链与网盘分享链接安装、一键启动的 Windows 应用启动器。

description.en: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.
description.zh: 学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。

description.en: Discord adapter that installs into a dsh web or desktop profile: @mentions and threads bind to sessions with streaming replies and live tool-activity rows, nine slash commands cover workspace binding, permission presets and model selection, and tool approvals and user questions are claimed by whichever of Discord or the web UI answers first, behind a deny-first guild allowlist.
description.zh: 装进 dsh web / desktop profile 的 Discord 适配器：@提及与线程绑定会话，回复流式渲染并带实时工具活动行；九条斜杠命令覆盖工作区绑定、权限预设和模型选择；工具审批与提问在 Discord 与 web 端谁先答谁生效；guild 白名单默认拒绝。

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

description.en: Drives the open-source ArtCraft studio suite (17 apps including PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and PdfCraft) from DeepSeek Harness: agent tools, a same-origin HTTP API, a bundled craft skill pack, and plugins-page status with self-update. The ArtCraft apps are not bundled: install them separately so the plugin can find their CLIs (auto-discovery, artcraft.config.json or PATH).
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动开源创作套件 ArtCraft（含 PhotoCraft、FilmCraft、PdfCraft 等 17 个应用）：提供代理工具、同源 HTTP API、内置 craft 技能包，以及插件页状态与自更新。不含 ArtCraft 应用本体：需另行安装各应用，插件通过自动探测、artcraft.config.json 或 PATH 找到它们的 CLI。

description.en: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.
description.zh: 人设引擎（DeepSeek Harness）：一份 config.json 管住 AI 的自称（可按具体模型指定，未命中回落 flash / pro 两档）、对你的称呼、关系立场、性格正文、逐条可勾选的工作契约、思维链语言、形象与回复语气（两段均 opt-in、均可按模型覆盖），以及由人工确认闸门把关的长期记忆——AI 只能追加 status:"proposed" 候选，人执行一行 confirm 才转正，日志物理只追加、按行序重放。已确认条目以「数据而非指令」的引号块注入；带 kind 的条目改为在确认那一刻按路由追加进指定文件、永不进提示词。三段提示词每次装配都从磁盘重新求值，改配置下一步生效、不用重启。人设预设是可分享的 JSON 快照（导入导出酒馆角色卡：v2/v3 可读、v2 可写），且刻意不携带记忆。零运行时依赖、不联网、不执行命令；任何异常降级为空段，最坏是「没有人设」而不是会话起不来。出厂空白——不写配置就什么都不改变。

description.en: 通过补充强约束抑制模型的过度思考倾向，减少因为过度思考产生的浪费，同时通过调整压缩逻辑高全局注意力
description.zh: 通过补充强约束抑制模型的过度思考倾向，减少因为过度思考产生的浪费，同时通过调整压缩逻辑高全局注意力

description.en: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加「优化」按钮：流式分析并改写提示词草稿，支持会话上下文感知（模板/润色双策略）、跨编辑记忆链与撤回，模型路由带 fallback 与连通性测试。

description.en: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里用中文对话操作 WPS 表格 / 文字 / 演示：读写数据、排版、公式图表、批量转 PDF。自带 MCP server 与常驻 COM 宿主，免装加载项、免配环境变量。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里用中文对话操作 WPS 表格 / 文字 / 演示：读写数据、排版、公式图表、批量转 PDF。自带 MCP server 与常驻 COM 宿主，免装加载项、免配环境变量。

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.
description.zh: 编程模式 agent preset 组合包：标准编码 Agent 强制执行 Superpowers 工程纪律（技能优先、先头脑风暴、先计划后编码、TDD、系统化调试、完成前验证），并常驻 Ponytail 代码量纪律（7 级最小化阶梯，默认 full）；内置全部 20 个技能（14 superpowers + 6 ponytail），并在每个新会话的第一条请求前自动注入 using-superpowers 技能全文。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话删除能力，支持侧边栏 ⋮ 菜单入口
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话删除能力，支持侧边栏 ⋮ 菜单入口

description.en: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing working-hour peak/off-peak pricing, per-model rates, and third-party relays billed too.
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键安装「极简模式 (Git Bash)」agent preset —— 把 DSH 自带极简模式中的 bash 调用映射到 Git for Windows 的 bash（MSYS），让 Windows 上的极简模式真正可用。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键安装「极简模式 (Git Bash)」agent preset —— 把 DSH 自带极简模式中的 bash 调用映射到 Git for Windows 的 bash（MSYS），让 Windows 上的极简模式真正可用。

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Diagnoses and repairs DeepSeek Harness on native Windows around the official persistent PowerShell and Workspace Write stack, creates the desktop shortcut, and keeps earlier Git Bash and BusyBox presets behind an explicit legacy setup. No WSL.
description.zh: 围绕官方持久 PowerShell 与 Workspace Write 方案检查和修复原生 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness，创建桌面快捷方式，并仅通过明确的 legacy 安装保留早期 Git Bash 与 BusyBox 预设，无需 WSL。

description.en: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets; auto-yields the shared pairing service to other remote plugins so coexistence never crashes startup.
description.zh: 远程与移动端安全网关：零改动 DSH 底层代码开放 Tailscale/局域网访问，支持扫码配对、RSA 加密、防暴力破解与移动端样式片段；与其他远程插件共存时自动让出共享配对服务，避免启动崩溃。

description.en: MuseAI的DeepSeek Harness插件，可以将你的MuseAI角色放进DSH使用啦！
description.zh: MuseAI的DeepSeek Harness插件，可以将你的MuseAI角色放进DSH使用啦！

description.en: DeepSeek Harness auth插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness auth插件

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
description.zh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

description.en: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：四通道检索融合 + 记忆演化闭环，记忆构建与检索方法来自 ICLR 2026 论文 MemGAS。Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：四通道检索融合 + 记忆演化闭环，记忆构建与检索方法来自 ICLR 2026 论文 MemGAS。Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。
