description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying their own provider/model route, reasoning effort, prompt and tools — and a composer control applies one Team to the current Session, installing the captain prompt and registering the spawn_team_member, get_team_preset and update_team_preset tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可复用智能体团队预设：设置页保存具名团队——队长带自己的提示词与工具白名单，成员各自带 provider/模型路由、推理强度、提示词与工具——编辑器栏的团队控件把选中的团队应用到当前会话，安装队长提示词，并注册 spawn_team_member、get_team_preset、update_team_preset 三个工具。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能够控制 Tabbit 浏览器：安装即自动加载 tabbit-browser skill，检测国际版 Tabbit 与国内版 Tabbit Browser 正式版（>= 1.9.0），检查 tabbit-cli 常驻运行时，按平台诊断调用 CLI 所需的 DSH sandbox 模式，并在没有合格版本时通过后台任务下载与系统地区匹配的正式版安装包。

description.en: UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness UI 协调器：规范化官方未完善、自相矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）——支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放、UI 字体栈，并在设置页提供圆角中栏卡片；纯客户端 dsh bundle，零模型开销，无 host 端，可无残留移除。

description.en: DSH 插件：在「设置→插件」页一键启停本地 llama.cpp 大模型（35B/9B，视觉×文本×快速/长上下文），卡片内配置、一条命令安装、自动注册，装完即用。 | start/stop a local llama.cpp llama-server right from Settings → Plugins, with Qwen3.6-35B / Qwen3.5-9B (vision × text, fast × long-context) as session models — card config, one-command install, auto-registered.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在「设置→插件」页一键启停本地 llama.cpp 大模型（35B/9B，视觉×文本×快速/长上下文），卡片内配置、一条命令安装、自动注册，装完即用。 | start/stop a local llama.cpp llama-server right from Settings → Plugins, with Qwen3.6-35B / Qwen3.5-9B (vision × text, fast × long-context) as session models — card config, one-command install, auto-registered.

description.en: 暴露 run_python/run_node 工具，通过 stdin 执行代码返回 stdout/stderr/exit，含解释器路径配置卡 | Exposes run_python/run_node tools that execute code via stdin and return stdout/stderr/exit, with interpreter-path config card
description.zh: 暴露 run_python/run_node 工具，通过 stdin 执行代码返回 stdout/stderr/exit，含解释器路径配置卡 | Exposes run_python/run_node tools that execute code via stdin and return stdout/stderr/exit, with interpreter-path config card

description.en: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
description.zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

description.en: Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.
description.zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

description.en: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Agent 预设：在 PTC 编码模式之上叠加自引用 Cordis 工具集（动态插件、运行时检视）与预设编写技能；物化文件带逐文件 sha256 标记，用户改过的预设升级与卸载时都不会被覆盖。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.
description.zh: 对话框旁的提示词市场：浏览并搜索三个内置在线提示词源，可收藏或自建，选中即插入输入框。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA rendering, batch reads and site crawling.
description.zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。

description.en: Runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a dsh model provider: live model list, session resume, approval relay, rewind, memory panel and remote SSH workspaces.
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供方：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、回退、记忆面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。

description.en: DSH 插件:直接复用 Codex CLI 本地登录订阅凭证,在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型,无需 API Key | DSH plugin: reuse your Codex CLI local subscription login to use ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness, no API key required
description.zh: DSH 插件:直接复用 Codex CLI 本地登录订阅凭证,在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型,无需 API Key | DSH plugin: reuse your Codex CLI local subscription login to use ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness, no API key required

description.en: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
description.zh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

description.en: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
description.zh: 通过非官方 Antigravity OAuth 通道提供 LLM 路由、网页搜索、图片生成与编辑、视频理解、配额状态和 DSH Web 设置控件。

description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official todo_write tool: priority tags on each task, full checklist rendering in the conversation, and a draggable in-session floating task panel with position memory, double-click reset and a live indicator of the action currently being executed.
description.zh: 官方 todo_write 的增强 fork：任务项支持优先级标签、会话内完整清单渲染，并提供可拖动的会话内浮动任务面板（位置记忆 / 双击复位 / 当前动作显示）。

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的「便携酒馆」插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡生成器 + 酒馆角色扮演聊天。支持世界书、角色卡 JSON/PNG 导入导出、面板主题与本地音乐。独立插件，仅依赖官方 @deepseek-ai SDK。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「便携酒馆」插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡生成器 + 酒馆角色扮演聊天。支持世界书、角色卡 JSON/PNG 导入导出、面板主题与本地音乐。独立插件，仅依赖官方 @deepseek-ai SDK。

description.en: Connects Qoder (China and Global) subscriptions to DSH through personal access tokens, keeping each variant on its own credentials and catalog, with saved-token switching, sidebar quota cards, per-model toggles, a context-window preference and a daily check-in.
description.zh: 通过个人访问令牌将 Qoder（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，两版各自独立的凭证与模型目录，支持多令牌切换、侧栏额度卡、按模型开关、上下文窗口偏好与每日自动签到。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
description.zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

description.en: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.
description.zh: 集成 TencentDB Agent Memory，支持对话捕获、结构化记忆提取、自动召回，以及记忆和对话搜索工具。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: WSL workspace support for DeepSeek Harness——无缝的 WSL 工作区使用体验，无需在 WSL 之中再安装一个dsh，安装该插件后在 GUI 里直接添加 WSL 工作区即可。WSL workspace support for DeepSeek Harness — Enjoy a seamless WSL workspace experience without needing to install dsh inside WSL. Once this plugin is installed, you can directly add a WSL workspace right from the GUI.
description.zh: WSL workspace support for DeepSeek Harness——无缝的 WSL 工作区使用体验，无需在 WSL 之中再安装一个dsh，安装该插件后在 GUI 里直接添加 WSL 工作区即可。WSL workspace support for DeepSeek Harness — Enjoy a seamless WSL workspace experience without needing to install dsh inside WSL. Once this plugin is installed, you can directly add a WSL workspace right from the GUI.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness balance plugin for the Settings page
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness balance plugin for the Settings page

description.en: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier with a Web settings page
description.zh: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier with a Web settings page

description.en: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
description.zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.
description.zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

description.en: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
description.zh: 用 Android/iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 dsh 完整网页界面,经 iroh 跨网点对点打洞直连,不用架任何服务器;打不通才退回 relay,relay 只见密文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自媒体工作台插件：一句话记灵感，一键生成脚本、封面、配图和分镜
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自媒体工作台插件：一句话记灵感，一键生成脚本、封面、配图和分镜

description.en: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost. One vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, MengBot and any MCP client. v0.31 adds five one-click skins (Default, Pop, Light, Resident Evil, Spider-Man) with full-bleed theme banners and per-skin hover contrast.
description.zh: 别的记忆插件让 AI 记住更多，我们让 AI 只记住对的：Agent 只能提案，人工审核才进主库（三库分离 + 不可变审计日志）；召回走 SQLite FTS5/BM25、零模型调用（实测 p50 2.3ms），记忆账本摊开召回成本与有用率。一个库接 DSH / Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw / Hermes / MengBot（任意 MCP 客户端）；v0.31 起内置五套一键切换皮肤（默认暗色 / 波普 / 明亮 / 生化危机 / 蜘蛛侠）与全幅主题头图。

description.en: Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes.
description.zh: 会卖萌、会记账、会弹跳的鲸鱼娘桌宠：实时余额/用量/上下文占用、中键弹弓抛掷、彩蛋气泡、省电模式；安装包 346KB，零新进程。

description.en: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.
description.zh: 为内置 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端：用真实浏览器渲染网页，经 Readability + DOMPurify 降噪后返回 Markdown。

description.en: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.
description.zh: 基于全双工语音模型的 DSH 网页端中文语音交互：边听边说、随时插话，用语音输入和修改任务、提交请求、管理会话、回答 DSH 的问题，并简短播报任务完成结果。

description.en: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: The plunge for dsh to boost model's search ability.
description.zh: The plunge for dsh to boost model's search ability.

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML/PDF/图片预览、15 种语言语法高亮、逐块差异编辑、Ctrl+S 保存）、文件操作（新建/移动/复制/删除、在文件管理器中显示）、可折叠图标窄条、多标签底部终端（ConPTY），以及由宿主已配置模型基于暂存差异生成提交信息。

description.en: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.
description.zh: 主题插件 —— 支持深色/浅色外观切换，提供 34 款预设主题，支持创建/分享/导入自定义主题。

description.en: Trace Compare & Live Maze: draw the agent's real exploration — main path, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, and subagent branches — on one wall-clock timeline; upload 1–2 session logs for a same-axis compare, or watch it grow live in a session tab.
description.zh: 轨迹对比与实时迷宫：把智能体真实的探索过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返点与子代理支路——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；可上传 1–2 个 session log 做同轴对比，或在会话页签里实时生长。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: Agent Teams for DeepSeek Harness: hand work to a team of agents that carries it end to end while you set the direction and hold the gates. Agents claim Tasks, hand work to each other, and have someone other than the builder verify it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 团队：把工作交给一支 Agent 团队，它们把事做到底，你定方向、把关键的关。Agent 自己认领 Task、互相交接，由做的人以外的成员验收。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Delete sessions from the DSH Web sidebar: a Delete action in the session menu with a risk-consent dialog; removes the log, workspace accounting and live session state.
description.zh: Delete sessions from the DSH Web sidebar: a Delete action in the session menu with a risk-consent dialog; removes the log, workspace accounting and live session state.

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: dsh free token route
description.zh: dsh free token route

description.en: skillhub of deepseek-harness
description.zh: skillhub of deepseek-harness

description.en: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.
description.zh: LLM 自动重试设置卡片：在设置页实时调整重试次数、退避与抖动，并可勾选额外可重试错误码（retryableCodes）—— 默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST，OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400 reasoning_text 报错开箱即自动重试。

description.en: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
description.zh: 多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。

description.en: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

description.en: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先注意力监督，提供 C0–C3 策略、去重 Inbox 提醒、静默时段和脱敏结果记录。

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
description.zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

description.en: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
description.zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: 🐋 DeepSeek Harness Web 宠物插件：动画陪伴、自适应输出节奏、可替换角色包与角色制作 Skill。
description.zh: 🐋 DeepSeek Harness Web 宠物插件：动画陪伴、自适应输出节奏、可替换角色包与角色制作 Skill。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
description.zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
description.zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

description.en: Analyzes usage and cost across models, providers and workspaces over any date range: hourly single-day and daily cross-day trends, a 53-week heatmap, cache-hit and model/workspace shares, plus request logs, CSV export and a ledger that survives session and workspace deletion. Highlights: multi-dimensional usage analysis, model and workspace insight, configurable cost and balance, full history with incremental sync, and auditable day-to-day operations.
description.zh: 统一分析多模型、多供应商、多工作区的用量与成本：任意起止日期、单日小时与跨日趋势、53 周热力图、缓存命中与模型/工作区占比，另有请求日志、CSV 导出与可跨会话恢复的持久账本。特点：多维用量分析，模型与工作区洞察，可配置成本与余额，完整历史与增量同步，可审计的日常操作。

description.en: Dispatches tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs and provides a sidebar panel for CLI availability and dispatch status.
description.zh: 从 DSH 向 11 种外部 Agent CLI 派遣任务，并在侧栏面板显示 CLI 可用性和派遣状态。

description.en: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a day/week/month/year/all usage heatmap.
description.zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与日/周/月/年/累计用量热力图。

description.en: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
description.zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件热管理器：装一次、重启一次，之后装插件、卸插件、升级插件全部即时生效，不用再重启。 | A plugin that makes installing, removing and upgrading DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins take effect instantly — restart once, then never again.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件热管理器：装一次、重启一次，之后装插件、卸插件、升级插件全部即时生效，不用再重启。 | A plugin that makes installing, removing and upgrading DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins take effect instantly — restart once, then never again.

description.en: An editable diagram canvas in the DSH sidebar plus two agent tools (diagram_read, diagram_apply) that read and edit the workspace in place, using native .drawio files: the canvas opens and saves them losslessly — cells it does not understand are preserved byte-for-byte — and a file-fingerprint revision powers optimistic locking against concurrent edits.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的可编辑画布，加两个模型工具（diagram_read、diagram_apply），直接读写工作区、载体是原生 .drawio 文件：无损写回让画布读不懂的单元逐字节保留，文件指纹 revision 支撑起对并发编辑的乐观锁。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步 generate_video 配 /build-video-tool 构建器；speak/clone_voice 语音合成覆盖七家供应商；全部由一个自动保存的设置页驱动。

description.en: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。

description.en: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
description.zh: 提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。

description.en: Task board for DSH: create tasks with project and model assignment, run them manually or on cron schedules; new sessions in a project automatically pick up its todo tasks and move them to in-review when done.
description.zh: dsh 的任务看板：创建任务时可指定项目与模型，支持手动执行及定时执行；项目内新建会话会自动拉取该项目的待办任务，完成后移至待验收。

description.en: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP stdio server that MCP-capable clients can launch; not tested against specific clients.
description.zh: DSH 刷贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP stdio server，支持 MCP 的客户端可尝试拉起；未逐客户端实测。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
description.zh: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

description.en: Browse and install DSH plugins without leaving the harness: a /store command, a Settings → Plugins tab, two agent-callable tools and a bundled skill, with an approval gate that lists the detected risk flags before anything installs.
description.zh: 不离开 harness 就能找插件、装插件：/store 命令、设置页的插件标签页、两个可供 agent 调用的工具和一个随包技能，安装前先确认并列出检测到的风险项。

description.en: dsh-better-sidebar 的视频文件预览插件： 在侧边栏打开 .mp4 .webm  .mov  .mkv  .avi 等视频文件时，内联渲染一个可播放、可拖拽进度条的 <video> 播放器。
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的视频文件预览插件： 在侧边栏打开 .mp4 .webm  .mov  .mkv  .avi 等视频文件时，内联渲染一个可播放、可拖拽进度条的 <video> 播放器。

description.en: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 inspect_image 工具将本地图片或 HTTP(S) 图片链接发送至配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并将文字结果带回对话。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
description.zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

description.en: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
description.zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: 把 AI 开发的进展变成人人看得懂、能拍板的产品仪表盘（DSH skill + 右侧栏面板）｜A product dashboard for AI-assisted development — readable and controllable (DSH skill + sidebar panel)
description.zh: 把 AI 开发的进展变成人人看得懂、能拍板的产品仪表盘（DSH skill + 右侧栏面板）｜A product dashboard for AI-assisted development — readable and controllable (DSH skill + sidebar panel)

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Recall (撤回), edit-and-resend (编辑重发) and regenerate (重新生成) for DeepSeek Harness conversation messages — Web and Desktop plugin
description.zh: Recall (撤回), edit-and-resend (编辑重发) and regenerate (重新生成) for DeepSeek Harness conversation messages — Web and Desktop plugin

description.en: Type /私 and complete 私家大厨 — Chinese skill names, zero renaming. Patches DSH skill discovery, the / gesture and the skill tool so any Unicode SKILL.md name (私家大厨, 卡路里, 作息管家…) works: slash completion, direct /私家大厨 invocation, model skill({name}) loading. Zero config; runtime changes revert on uninstall, but the regex patch written into three DSH packages on disk stays until the next DSH upgrade replaces those files.
description.zh: 中文技能名零改造直用：输入 /私 自动补全 私家大厨。为 DSH 打上技能发现、斜杠手势与 skill 工具补丁，Unicode 技能名（私家大厨/卡路里/作息管家…）补全、直达、加载全可用；不改 SKILL.md、零配置；运行时改动随卸载恢复，但写进 DSH 三个依赖包磁盘文件里的正则补丁会保留到下次 DSH 升级覆盖为止。

description.en: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能
description.zh: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description.zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面与桌面端的独立壁纸背景：内置壁纸、本地图片/视频上传（存 IndexedDB）、只读接入本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库（需仓库自带的 wallpaper-engine-api 服务）；支持图片、视频与场景工坊预览渲染，可调浅色雾层/深色遮罩、模糊、亮度与安全放大，并可只读跟随桌面壁纸。

description.en: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.
description.zh: 宿主侧无人值守定时任务：按 cron 表达式、固定间隔或一次性时点运行一次性 agent 任务或 shell 命令，调度状态持久化（至多一次语义），支持重叠/错过策略与有界运行历史。

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Image "reading" for text-only models: downscale + reduce color depth + structure/color fingerprints into text grids fed back to the conversation, letting the model zoom, sample and OCR autonomously like a multimodal model; fully local with zero external model dependency, ships an image-reading methodology skill and optional PaddleOCR.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的"读图"能力：图片降分辨率+降色深+结构/色彩指纹渲染成文本网格喂回对话，模型像多模态一样自主缩放、取样、OCR 读图；纯本地零外部模型依赖，附读图方法论 skill 与可选 PaddleOCR。

description.en: Lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one stable proxy tool instead of N tool schemas, servers connect on first use and idle out, metadata cached to disk.
description.zh: Lazy MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: one stable proxy tool instead of N tool schemas, servers connect on first use and idle out, metadata cached to disk.

description.en: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the official BPE tokenizer, to tell a slow stream from a stalled one.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时渲染 token 状态带：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表显示流式 token/s、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比每次 step 的估算与实际偏差，用于判断生成是慢还是卡住。

description.en: Jev (System One decision model) plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: Jev (System One decision model) plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)

description.en: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
description.zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

description.en: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 64 KiB and retires stale dsh-auth-* launch cookies on each response, so a fixed profile cannot lock itself out of the desktop welcome handshake after roughly 72 restarts.
description.zh: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 头部预算提升到 64 KiB，并在每次响应里清掉过期的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，避免固定 profile 在约 72 次重启后卡在桌面端欢迎握手。

description.en: An agent that wakes up on its own schedule: by default every 60 minutes, ±20% (48–72). It browses the interests you set, drops what it finds into a local pool of notes, and keeps a profile of what you like. When it has enough worth sharing it hands the session you linked a short package of notes — whether to speak, and which note to use, is that session's agent's call in the moment. Quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit and a cooldown are decided in code; when the answer is no, the decision and expression phases after the gate call no model at all — browsing runs before the gate and is counted separately. Windows, Linux and macOS (Linux and macOS are minimal support).
description.zh: 让 agent 不定期醒来的插件：默认 60 分钟一次，上下浮动 20%（48~72 分钟）。按你设的兴趣范围上网逛逛，看到的东西存进本地素材池，顺手维护一份你的兴趣画像。攒够值得说的，就往你绑定的会话递一份短素材——说不说、说哪条，交给那个会话里的 agent 按眼前处境定。静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却都在代码层判；判别说时，闸门之后的决策与表达两相不再调用模型（闲逛相在闸门之前，另算）。支持 Windows、Linux 与 macOS（Linux / macOS 为最小支持）。

description.en: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison, per-model cost ranking, cache savings, peak/off-peak pricing impact, and a draggable floating balance widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek 用量仪表盘：按近期日均消耗估算可用天数，今日/本月/累计花费环比对照，分模型成本排行、缓存节省、峰谷定价影响，以及可拖动的悬浮余额窗。

description.en: PC environment diagnostics & port control board: zero-dependency inspection of system, CLI toolchains, active listening ports with hover-to-kill release, and model key readiness. No external calls, zero plaintext secrets.
description.zh: 环境自检与端口控制大屏：零依赖洞察系统架构、12 款核心 CLI 工具链、活跃监听端口与悬浮释放、模型凭据就绪状态。局域网主 IP 一键速查，零外联、零私有凭据明文。

description.en: 为明日方舟的长篇剧情打造的RAG类DSH插件，拥有多种快速检索能力。
description.zh: 为明日方舟的长篇剧情打造的RAG类DSH插件，拥有多种快速检索能力。

description.en: Connect any ACP-capable agent to DSH and use DSH as a single entry point for all conversations and tasks. Models, thinking levels and permission modes come from the agent itself; tool calls appear in the main chat, diffs are collected on a dedicated NTR page, and approval requests appear in the composer. Requires an ACP-capable agent CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 把任意支持 ACP 的 Agent 接进 DSH，用 DSH 一个入口管理所有会话和任务。模型、思考等级和权限模式由 Agent 自己提供；工具调用显示在主聊天区，diff 汇总到独立的 NTR 页，权限询问出现在输入框。使用前需在本机安装支持 ACP 的 Agent 命令行工具。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释）。

description.en: Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor).
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 IM 通道接入的网关插件：钉钉 / QQ / 个人微信，支持扫码绑定与流式回复。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 IM 通道接入的网关插件：钉钉 / QQ / 个人微信，支持扫码绑定与流式回复。

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材与出图记录，复制素材直链。DSH asset browser for MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and generation history.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材与出图记录，复制素材直链。DSH asset browser for MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and generation history.

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
description.zh: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。

description.en: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description.zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
description.zh: PPT 制作插件：十一个 ppt_* 工具创建、编辑、逆向、质检与导出演示文稿，内置五族设计系统与主题模板，支持幻灯片动画、海报与信息图。

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

description.en: DSH 插件：免费网页搜索，双免费后端（Parallel 默认 + Exa 备用，均匿名免 key）+ 设置开关 + MCP server 双传输（stdio + HTTP/SSE 双端口），兼容 Claude Code / Codex | Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: Parallel (default) + Exa (backup) free providers, settings toggle, and dual-transport MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE) for Claude Code / Codex
description.zh: DSH 插件：免费网页搜索，双免费后端（Parallel 默认 + Exa 备用，均匿名免 key）+ 设置开关 + MCP server 双传输（stdio + HTTP/SSE 双端口），兼容 Claude Code / Codex | Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: Parallel (default) + Exa (backup) free providers, settings toggle, and dual-transport MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE) for Claude Code / Codex

description.en: DSH Web 广告拦截器，四层独立防御拦截 dsh-ads 插件的所有广告位 | DSH Web ad blocker with four independent defense layers targeting the dsh-ads plugin
description.zh: DSH Web 广告拦截器，四层独立防御拦截 dsh-ads 插件的所有广告位 | DSH Web ad blocker with four independent defense layers targeting the dsh-ads plugin

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session management, task notifications, skill controls, subagent model routing, and Linux permission maintenance.
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Rewind a DeepSeek Harness conversation and its workspace together, without touching Git: every rewind is a fork, /redo reverses it, and a Rust engine snapshots in milliseconds.
description.zh: 同步回退 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与工作区，不碰 Git：每次回退都是一个 fork，/redo 可撤销，Rust 引擎毫秒级快照。

description.en: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

description.en: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/cache-write), cache hit rate, estimated cost and average TPS tracked per session, provider, model and client, stored locally in SQLite with cross-device import/export.
description.zh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均 TPS，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

description.en: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
description.zh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

description.en: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.
description.zh: DSH Web 自定义背景插件：上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为全界面背景，可调不透明度、明暗自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃与壁纸模糊，实时预览、设置持久化；另附可选的 DeepSeek 官网风格会话时间线导航轨，支持重点书签与快速跳转。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.
description.zh: 以《鸣潮》清宵为主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，冰蓝·青碧·月白配色，含剑气流光与可更换背景。

description.en: Install suites from any Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi or agent-plugins.org git marketplace repo — skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into DSH sessions at runtime, with a market page in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 把任意 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi / agent-plugins.org 的 git 市场仓库加为源，套件的技能、MCP 服务器、hooks 与斜杠命令在运行时注入 DSH 会话，并自带 Web 市场页。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书的桥接插件：扫码绑定 PersonalAgent、流式卡片、git worktree 项目工作区、scope 并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理，以及 dsh 崩溃后仍在飞书应答的安全网守护。

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

description.en: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
description.zh: 语音输入插件：对着麦克风说话，识别后的文字作为普通聊天消息发送（本地模型或浏览器语音识别）。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
description.zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网/远程访问：为纯 HTTP 非安全上下文注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，局域网/Tailscale IP 直连时前端不再崩溃。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.
description.zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
description.zh: Minta 记忆引擎的 DSH 原生接入层:合成官方 dsh-mcp-client 行、注册 minta-memory-governance 技能与 session-start 记忆预热,并提供 Minta agent 预设;19 个 MCP 工具由需单独部署的 Minta 引擎(Python/Docker)提供,未部署引擎则无法使用。

description.en: Context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: when the window fills up it rolls over to a fresh one with zero summarization model calls, archiving the old window verbatim for line-by-line recall; handoff anchors carry task orientation, working notes survive compaction, and a stale-notes gate warns instead of vouching for outdated notes. The trigger follows the provider budget equation (window - max_tokens) and the real routed model even after a mid-session switch. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文窗口自动管理：窗口快满时零模型调用换窗，旧对话整窗无损归档、可逐字回查；交接锚点带任务定向，工作笔记跨压缩存活，笔记滞后自动 STALE 警示；触发线按（窗口 − max_tokens）预算方程计算，中途切模型也按真实路由测量；一键换窗按钮与 /smart-compact 命令，三带自动换窗，锚点强制脱敏，开箱即用零配置。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 TRAE SOLO 供应商插件，移植自 traework2api。提供 traework 供应商这一免费 SOLO 聊天通道，并向 dsh-router 核心上报单账号状态。

description.en: Omni Router - auto-routing DeepSeek Harness preset: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.
description.zh: Omni Router - auto-routing DeepSeek Harness preset: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.

description.en: Host-side degeneration guard for DSH: strips garbage code points, detects repetition collapse and discards the attempt before it enters history, and can retroactively decontaminate a poisoned session.
description.zh: Host-side degeneration guard for DSH: strips garbage code points, detects repetition collapse and discards the attempt before it enters history, and can retroactively decontaminate a poisoned session.

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: In-process graph memory kernel for DeepSeek Harness, backed by TriviumDB.
description.zh: In-process graph memory kernel for DeepSeek Harness, backed by TriviumDB.

description.en: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台——每个斜杠命令都是 ⚙️ 控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。

description.en: SillyTavern preset mode, macro engine and editor for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: SillyTavern preset mode, macro engine and editor for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
description.zh: 一键匹配 DSH 已配置模型的上下文窗口，展示容量来源，支持勾选批量配置、手动编辑和持续同步。

description.en: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.
description.zh: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.

description.en: QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.
description.zh: dsh 质量项目工作台：通过浏览器界面和 18 个 QA 领域工具管理测试项目、需求、用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与审批门禁。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。

description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: Codex-style side chat & selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web — fork the session into a persistent side panel; quote selections into context. Thin consumer of dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: Codex-style side chat & selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web — fork the session into a persistent side panel; quote selections into context. Thin consumer of dsh-better-sidebar.

description.en: 🐖 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的猪：吃你的真实工作长大，会学习、打工、旅行、生病。玩法照 QQ 宠物（怀旧服 v1.2.4）复刻
description.zh: 🐖 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的猪：吃你的真实工作长大，会学习、打工、旅行、生病。玩法照 QQ 宠物（怀旧服 v1.2.4）复刻

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets / launch-at-login / restart Harness, one-click install and update of the bundled dsh-plugin-usage-meter, and a dsh plugin half that starts the tray together with the harness.
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面化启动器：桌面快捷方式、静默启动、系统托盘（打开 / 彻底退出＝停服务＋关应用窗口＋退托盘）、PWA 应用窗口（已运行则聚焦不重复弹窗）、安装引导、任务完成通知。

description.en: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

description.en: Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 自带的压缩摘要器，改用五段式交接摘要，被压掉的每条消息都能在分段目录里读回。

description.en: Interactive A2UI cards for the dsh web UI — quizzes, forms, charts and diagrams rendered inline in the conversation, with a full action loop back to the agent.
description.zh: Interactive A2UI cards for the dsh web UI — quizzes, forms, charts and diagrams rendered inline in the conversation, with a full action loop back to the agent.

description.en: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. Analysis is upstream's: native binaries (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA), JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and adb devices, firmware, and process captures.
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.
description.zh: 将会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期事件转换为 OpenTelemetry GenAI 调用链与指标，通过标准 OTLP/HTTP 导出到任意兼容后端，正文采集默认关闭。

description.en: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.
description.zh: DSH Web 工作台基座插件：提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳（活动栏/侧边栏/编辑器区/面板/状态栏）和 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，供功能插件挂载面板、视图与命令。

description.en: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 上用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的非生成式决策模型）对待执行的工具调用分类——高置信高危拒绝、存疑转审批——并在 approval/request 上对明确授权且可逆的调用做带参数证据门控的自动批准。另子类化 session-reference resolver，让引用快照按 Jev 打分保留消息而非最旧优先丢弃。任何 provider 故障均回退原生行为；提供 shadow 模式与 /jev-stats 统计命令；支持 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 入口；64 个测试。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: HTTP + WebSocket 反向代理：把局域网端口转发到本地 DSH 服务
description.zh: HTTP + WebSocket 反向代理：把局域网端口转发到本地 DSH 服务

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
description.zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.
description.zh: 常驻界面的鲸鱼娘：随智能体状态切换动画，可摸头互动、喂小鱼干养亲密度，从幼鲸一路养成。

description.en: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.
description.zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：把单次评测试次的变量、预算上限、会话根目录与 fork 血统一次性注入 agent 进程，模型调用经宿主 broker 走网关租约，并写出 schema 版本化的 bundle descriptor 做证据归属。

description.en: Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness with behavior prompts, failure-driven concurrency reduction and retry guidance, post-write checks with backup rollback, high-risk command gates, change summaries and verification reminders, advisory project-memory checks, configurable project-discipline reminders after compaction or at intervals, and compliance statistics.
description.zh: 工具调用纪律：提供行为提示、失败后降低并行度与重试提醒、写后检查及备份回滚、高风险命令闸门、变更摘要与验证提醒、项目记忆建议性检查、可配置的项目纪律周期重述与压缩后补充，以及遵守度统计。

description.en: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 角色化多智能体专家团 = 你的数字员工。一句目标即自动组建最多 12 个角色（产品、架构、前端、后端、审查、测试等），按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，并支持常驻团队反复指挥。零运行时依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 Deepseek Harness 的插件
description.zh: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 Deepseek Harness 的插件

description.en: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话实时流程图，可查看工具调用、并行分组、子代理分支和逐层详情。

description.en: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
description.zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: AgentCompare provides A/B workflows for one Vite task in DSH: run two implementations, compare live previews with shared checks, choose blind, and review adoption against current project edits. Requires a root-level Vite project in a Git repository with at least one commit.
description.zh: AgentCompare A/B 对比：同一需求做两版 Vite 应用，在 DSH 主对话中并排体验、统一验收、盲选，再审查采用到当前项目。复用已有模型配置；适用于本地 Git 仓库（至少一次提交）的根目录 Vite 前端。
