description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile version drift, and a diff of what changed since the last scan.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile version drift, and a diff of what changed since the last scan.

description.en: Synchronizes DSH profiles and local plugin source archives through WebDAV and S3-compatible storage, with encrypted snapshots, conflict-aware recovery, and explicit self-updates.
description.zh: 通过 WebDAV 和兼容 S3 的存储同步 DSH profile 与本地插件源码归档，支持加密快照、冲突感知恢复和显式自更新。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Bilibili video search, metadata, and subtitle transcripts (bilibili_search / bilibili_video / bilibili_subtitles) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:B 站视频检索、元数据与字幕文稿,匿名可用,可选 SESSDATA 解锁登录字幕
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Bilibili video search, metadata, and subtitle transcripts (bilibili_search / bilibili_video / bilibili_subtitles) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:B 站视频检索、元数据与字幕文稿,匿名可用,可选 SESSDATA 解锁登录字幕

description.en: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动思考档位路由：本地微调的 7 题分类模型（ModernBERT，842MB，CPU 推理 <1s）对无档位指令的消息自动选择 low/high/max；会话内检测到重试自动沿阶梯升档，受「别用 max」类排除约束压制；判定服务不可达时熔断降级，会话不断。前端档位芯片实时显示当前档位与最近 20 轮判断原因。判定全程本地推理，任务文本不出本机。

description.en: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
description.zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的软工作流插件：在画布上设计流程，编译成计划提示词，由模型按计划执行；运行状态由模型自己记，没有执行引擎
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的软工作流插件：在画布上设计流程，编译成计划提示词，由模型按计划执行；运行状态由模型自己记，没有执行引擎

description.en: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转。附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。

description.en: Aggregated IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness: drive agents from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, QQ, WhatsApp and 20+ chat platforms with unified sessions, remote approvals and interactive questions. By default, anyone who can message a connected bot can drive the agent; configure allowedUserIds to restrict access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聚合 IM 网关：通过微信、飞书、Telegram、Discord、QQ、WhatsApp 等 20+ 聊天平台驱动 agent，支持统一会话、远程审批和交互提问。默认放行所有能给机器人发消息的人，需要限制请配置 allowedUserIds。

description.en: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话流式折叠：运行中只展开最新的思考小窗、其余过程行折成一条摘要，一轮结束滑回你提的那句话；读到哪一轮那轮提问就钉在顶部。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: 在 DSH 侧栏加一个「开启生图模式」入口：点击 → 炫酷跳转至生图模式
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加一个「开启生图模式」入口：点击 → 炫酷跳转至生图模式

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务管理器：在「设置 → MCP 管理」中新增/编辑/启停/重启/删除 MCP 服务，支持 JSON 导入导出、4 个 mcp_manager_* 模型工具与 HTTP API，可通过 npx、npm 或跨平台脚本安装。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

description.en: Command Code Go API provider for dsh. Command Code 订阅 + DeekSeek Harness 兼容层
description.zh: Command Code Go API provider for dsh. Command Code 订阅 + DeekSeek Harness 兼容层

description.en: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的字体插件：对话有自己的字体、字号、行高、字重、字距、词距、段距与首行缩进，界面字体跟随对话，代码独立成轴并支持连字；亮色与暗色可各调一套，整套配置存为预设，另有一个悬浮调参面板。

description.en: Ramify 是 DeepSeek Harness 的创意分支画布插件，用树状工作区生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。
description.zh: Ramify 是 DeepSeek Harness 的创意分支画布插件，用树状工作区生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it continue, and text typed meanwhile is sent along as a steering message; the pause never interrupts an in-flight API call and the model does not notice it.
description.zh: 在模型完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次请求之前暂停，输入框保持可用：裸回车或点按钮放行，草稿有字则随本次请求一并发出作为插话；不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、察觉不到暂停。

description.en: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.
description.zh: 将本地 Markdown 与文本文档转为可检索的知识库，支持语义与关键词混合搜索、引用校验与来源注入。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，提供紧凑侧栏与会话布局、浅色与深色主题、模型与推理强度控件，以及支持随机喷水、轻弹和摆尾互动的新会话页像素小鲸鱼。

description.en: ✂️ Token saver & usage tracker for coding agents: terse caveman replies, compact RTK shell output, lean Ponytail code, Headroom compression, pstack rigor, and a gain dashboard — one-command combos over one shared extension tree.
description.zh: ✂️ Token saver & usage tracker for coding agents: terse caveman replies, compact RTK shell output, lean Ponytail code, Headroom compression, pstack rigor, and a gain dashboard — one-command combos over one shared extension tree.

description.en: Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: Import pi / opencode / codex / claude-code sessions, chat history, and agents into DeepSeek Harness — one-click Sync button, slash commands, session-start migration prompt
description.zh: Import pi / opencode / codex / claude-code sessions, chat history, and agents into DeepSeek Harness — one-click Sync button, slash commands, session-start migration prompt

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rule-gated automatic sandbox approval with optional LLM review, one-time grants, fixed high-risk checks, and native human fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rule-gated automatic sandbox approval with optional LLM review, one-time grants, fixed high-risk checks, and native human fallback.

description.en: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 TUI 模式（dsh --profile pi-tui），基于内置 pi-tui fork 构建：覆盖主会话循环（审批、命令、会话切换与全文搜索），以及预设、技能、模型/设置菜单与斜杠命令。

description.en: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
description.zh: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

description.en: 我要成为Galgame高手！！将你的Vibe coding界面修改成为Galgame的样子，在不影响工作的情况下和赏心悦目的DeepSeek娘进行友好互动
description.zh: 我要成为Galgame高手！！将你的Vibe coding界面修改成为Galgame的样子，在不影响工作的情况下和赏心悦目的DeepSeek娘进行友好互动

description.en: DeepSeek 桌宠：把 DSH 账户余额与桌面蓝鲸女仆连起来（立绘 · 游戏屏 · 台词 · 余额播报）
description.zh: DeepSeek 桌宠：把 DSH 账户余额与桌面蓝鲸女仆连起来（立绘 · 游戏屏 · 台词 · 余额播报）

description.en: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
description.zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: DSH工作区内跨会话记忆插件
description.zh: DSH工作区内跨会话记忆插件

description.en: Rule mining for data risk control, distilled from the ideas of the "100-Day Risk Control Expert" course
description.zh: Rule mining for data risk control, distilled from the ideas of the "100-Day Risk Control Expert" course

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

description.en: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: A safety gate for DeepSeek Harness: a stronger model reviews dangerous tool calls before they run. Plus vision and 67 models from one wallet, paid per request over x402.
description.zh: A safety gate for DeepSeek Harness: a stronger model reviews dangerous tool calls before they run. Plus vision and 67 models from one wallet, paid per request over x402.

description.en: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users see only their own conversations, and unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP 桥 + 无限画布 + ffmpeg 后处理，13 个工具含画布连边/reroll/媒体编辑 | Provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP bridge + infinite canvas + ffmpeg post-processing; 13 tools incl. canvas linking/reroll/media-edit
description.zh: provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP 桥 + 无限画布 + ffmpeg 后处理，13 个工具含画布连边/reroll/媒体编辑 | Provider-agnostic AIGC HTTP bridge + infinite canvas + ffmpeg post-processing; 13 tools incl. canvas linking/reroll/media-edit

description.en: 💬 Chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat through the official WeChat ClawBot channel: native photo understanding, sending files both ways, reminders, long-term memory, and a "typing..." indicator while the bot is thinking.
description.zh: 💬 Chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat through the official WeChat ClawBot channel: native photo understanding, sending files both ways, reminders, long-term memory, and a "typing..." indicator while the bot is thinking.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.
description.zh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

description.en: Interactive UI, HTML/SVG diagrams and animation for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: Interactive UI, HTML/SVG diagrams and animation for DeepSeek Harness Web

description.en: 可配置子代理 profile 系统，单一 subagent 工具 + profile 参数，含 Web UI 设置/实时进度/子代理树 | Configurable subagent profile system: single subagent tool + profile param, with Web UI settings/real-time progress/subagent tree
description.zh: 可配置子代理 profile 系统，单一 subagent 工具 + profile 参数，含 Web UI 设置/实时进度/子代理树 | Configurable subagent profile system: single subagent tool + profile param, with Web UI settings/real-time progress/subagent tree

description.en: Skin center plugin and built-in skins for the DSH Web GUI: skins are pure asset directories, loaded and rendered by the skin center, and installed on demand from dsh-market.com.
description.zh: Skin center plugin and built-in skins for the DSH Web GUI: skins are pure asset directories, loaded and rendered by the skin center, and installed on demand from dsh-market.com.

description.en: Pairing-code remote access for DSH: a phone-first PWA with Web Push, plus a client role that operates the host's shared sessions in the native DSH interface, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
description.zh: 配对码远程访问 DSH：手机端可安装 PWA、带 Web Push 推送；另一台设备作为客户端，在原生 DSH 界面里直接操作主机共享的会话，经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 接入。

description.en: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link, LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access with an auto-generated self-signed certificate, token auth, gzip compression, a floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, configurable public URL and LAN port, and WeChat / Feishu / Telegram bot channels with per-channel health monitoring and session-completion push. Targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.2-rc.1+).
description.zh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接、局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码）、可配置公网链接与局域网端口，以及微信 / 飞书 / Telegram 机器人通道，支持分通道健康监测与会话完成推送。适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.2-rc.1+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
description.zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

description.en: A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent declares, asserts against, and queries under schema constraints.
description.zh: A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent declares, asserts against, and queries under schema constraints.

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: Codex-style conversation turn timeline and hover history overview for DSH Web UI
description.zh: Codex-style conversation turn timeline and hover history overview for DSH Web UI

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
description.zh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

description.en: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.
description.zh: 让单个会话在多个文件夹中读写并运行 bash，而不限于主目录——附加根经侧栏 Folders 面板或 /workspace-folders 命令登记（inherit/read-only/read-write），与主根共享同一套文件围栏 + 内核沙箱授权；不新增工具。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 界面里新到达的工具调用卡片，侧栏开关在不干预/展开/折叠三态间循环，档位持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL for DSH PTC mode: bindings and imports stay live across run_code calls, edit_run_code replaces one line without resending the block, module import/export syntax is adapted via AST rewriting, and durable bindings are restored from the session journal after a cold restart.
description.zh: 把 DSH PTC 模式的顶层 run_code 变成会话绑定的持久 TypeScript REPL：变量与导入在多次 run_code 调用间保持可用，edit_run_code 只替换一行而无需重发整段，import/export 模块语法经 AST 改写适配，持久绑定在冷重启后由会话日志恢复。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
description.zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Use AI agents from the DSH session UI.
description.zh: Use AI agents from the DSH session UI.

description.en: IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 IDE 风格 Git 面板：常驻标签页含三栏总览（分支/标签列表、可搜索的提交历史图、含变更文件树与提交信息的提交详情）与变更记录页（统计条、带逐文件暂存/取消/丢弃的未提交列表、含 amend 的提交框）；并排差异带懒加载 highlight.js 语法高亮、块间上下文按需展开与词级行内高亮，图片文件以变更前/后双图对照；另在输入框提供 zsh 风格分支标记。所有 git 命令以 argv 数组经宿主 subprocess 执行、cwd 锁定仓库根。

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: 🌌 Mebular · shared memory and task collaboration for agents. Through a DSH-native plugin, it provides cross-device, cross-agent memory sharing and task-graph capabilities — so physical devices are no longer the boundary of your agents. Secure, controllable, and decentralized! The plugin attaches to an existing Mebular app or CLI runtime; when none exists, the panel installs the shared runtime on demand, and it never starts or downloads Mebular silently.
description.zh: 🌌 Mebular 忆云 · 智能体共享记忆与任务协作。通过 DSH 原生插件接入，提供跨设备、跨 Agent 记忆共享与任务图功能，让物理设备不再是你智能体的边界，安全、可控、去中心化！插件连接已有的 Mebular App/CLI 运行时；没有时可在面板里按提示安装共享运行时，不会静默启动或下载 Mebular。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Live balance & quota panel for all your LLM providers, right in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: Live balance & quota panel for all your LLM providers, right in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

description.en: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.
description.zh: 合理搭配你的模型及 Token 额度，让 DSH 按任务类型自动委派专业子代理，覆盖架构分析、UI/UX、代码实现、代码库探索与文档调研。安装后自动配置，并支持按角色设置思考强度和工具权限。

description.en: White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost, plus 6 white-box self-check tools.
description.zh: 唯稳律白箱因果闸门：每个工具调用执行前沿确定性因果逻辑链裁决——拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本，附带 6 个白箱自查工具。

description.en: Vendor parameter mapping and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: map temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system across 11 vendors and repair broken JSON tool output with auditable rules.
description.zh: Vendor parameter mapping and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: map temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system across 11 vendors and repair broken JSON tool output with auditable rules.

description.en: Ships a set of /logi commands for project housekeeping: dispatches security, logic-correctness, maintainability, reliability and performance experts to inspect the whole project, then produces one consolidated improvement report.
description.zh: 提供一组 /logi 命令来做项目收尾工作，为你的项目派发「安全/逻辑正确/可维护/健壮/性能」5 位专家深入检查你的项目，并出一份优化总报告。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: 小说作家智能体预设，用于在DeepSeek Herness里让AI写小说，管理一整套作品工程。
description.zh: 小说作家智能体预设，用于在DeepSeek Herness里让AI写小说，管理一整套作品工程。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/SessionEnd）、 .mcp.json 服务器，并支持 Claude Code 插件 marketplace。自带 /cc-plugin 插件与市场全管理（claude CLI 优先、自实现兜底）、/cc-resume 列出并把 Claude Code 会话导入为 DSH 原生事件日志、/cc-export 把 DSH skill 导出为 Claude Code skill。Claude Code 与 DSH 的双向桥。

description.en: 把 对话分支 画成 可点击的树
description.zh: 把 对话分支 画成 可点击的树

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 基础工具增强：持久 bash、结构化 read、多模式 edit、原子 write、双引擎 grep/glob、图像直读，一个插件全覆盖
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 基础工具增强：持久 bash、结构化 read、多模式 edit、原子 write、双引擎 grep/glob、图像直读，一个插件全覆盖

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: DSH 通知中心插件：对话/任务完成、报错、等待批准等事件触发浏览器通知 + 21 种匹配音效
description.zh: DSH 通知中心插件：对话/任务完成、报错、等待批准等事件触发浏览器通知 + 21 种匹配音效

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found / error，并按输入样式生成可直接替换回论文的更正版引用（APA、GB/T 7714、IEEE、Vancouver、MLA、Chicago、Harvard、ACS、BibTeX）。

description.en: tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh 是一个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 可观测插件，直接将 GenAI trace 数据上报到腾讯云日志服务 (CLS)。  它观察 DSH 原生的 session、agent loop、LLM stream 和 tool 生命周期，将其转换为 腾讯云AI Agent可观测规范的 5 层 span 层级模型（entry → agent → step → chat → tool），并通过 tencentcloud-cls-sdk-js 直接上报到 CLS，无需额外部署 OTLP 收集器或 sidecar。
description.zh: tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh 是一个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 可观测插件，直接将 GenAI trace 数据上报到腾讯云日志服务 (CLS)。  它观察 DSH 原生的 session、agent loop、LLM stream 和 tool 生命周期，将其转换为 腾讯云AI Agent可观测规范的 5 层 span 层级模型（entry → agent → step → chat → tool），并通过 tencentcloud-cls-sdk-js 直接上报到 CLS，无需额外部署 OTLP 收集器或 sidecar。

description.en: A Vibe Learning Plugin made for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: A Vibe Learning Plugin made for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

description.en: 官方 subagent 的默认策略包：装上一次配好「什么时候自己干、什么时候派出去、派给谁」。
description.zh: 官方 subagent 的默认策略包：装上一次配好「什么时候自己干、什么时候派出去、派给谁」。

description.en: SSH remote-execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ProxyJump chain, SFTP filesystem, subprocess and PTY over ssh2
description.zh: SSH remote-execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ProxyJump chain, SFTP filesystem, subprocess and PTY over ssh2

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with defect rework, acceptance — and gives the model 12 `teamflow_*` tools plus a workbench with a live pipeline graph and a backlog kanban. Each requirement gets its own folder holding the PRD, design, technical plan, QA report and acceptance record.
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: PII masking for DeepSeek Harness — anonymizes names, phones, emails, ids, and keys before requests and restores them at the display layer, keeping plaintext out of session logs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 PII 脱敏：请求前匿名化姓名、电话、邮箱、证件与密钥，展示层还原，明文不进入会话日志。

description.en: 为DeepSeek  harness开启局域网访问及移动端页面的插件，移动端界面适配
description.zh: 为DeepSeek  harness开启局域网访问及移动端页面的插件，移动端界面适配

description.en: Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).
description.zh: 把本机 GitHub CLI (gh) 包装成 Agent 工具集（PR、Issue、Actions 运行、仓库检索与原始 API 调用），另提供 /gh status 与 /gh help 两个斜杠命令，以及全局仓库驾驶舱和会话工作区两个 Web 面板。

description.en: FDE Workstation — customer lifecycle, kanban, 8 stage gates and a method library as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. 中文界面 / 零运行时依赖。
description.zh: FDE Workstation — customer lifecycle, kanban, 8 stage gates and a method library as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. 中文界面 / 零运行时依赖。

description.en: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
description.zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

description.en: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.
description.zh: 在设置页按模型编辑能力：推理档位及其发往端点的取值写法、输入模态与 token 容量，以声明或官方目录稀疏覆盖的形式写入。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: DSH Web 工作区侧栏替代，顶部全局最近会话 + Workspace→Session 二级菜单 + 面包屑 | DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement: top global recent sessions + Workspace→Session two-level menu + breadcrumbs
description.zh: DSH Web 工作区侧栏替代，顶部全局最近会话 + Workspace→Session 二级菜单 + 面包屑 | DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement: top global recent sessions + Workspace→Session two-level menu + breadcrumbs

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim. Compresses ~80k tokens to a few hundred.
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多对话面板：并排查看并与多个 Agent 会话同时交互。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多对话面板：并排查看并与多个 Agent 会话同时交互。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.
description.zh: 联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: Log directly into your Cursor account within DeepSeek Harness and use your Cursor subscription — no API Key required, and no dependency on Cursor IDE or Cursor CLI. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接登录 Cursor 账户并使用 Cursor 订阅，不需要 API Key， 也不依赖 Cursor IDE 或 Cursor CLI。
description.zh: Log directly into your Cursor account within DeepSeek Harness and use your Cursor subscription — no API Key required, and no dependency on Cursor IDE or Cursor CLI. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接登录 Cursor 账户并使用 Cursor 订阅，不需要 API Key， 也不依赖 Cursor IDE 或 Cursor CLI。

description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: Tencent CodeBuddy plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

description.en: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 与 Desktop 端的内置浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的 AI 原生浏览器工作区，融合了多标签浏览、实时页面批注、轻量级代码编辑、工作区预览，以及跨网页和桌面的智能助手辅助迭代功能。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
description.zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server (brain=Hermes, arms=Harness)
description.zh: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server (brain=Hermes, arms=Harness)

description.en: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: AI-for-Science research workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness, aimed at researchers and grad students using agentic AI: multi-angle literature review with per-angle files, experiment design with a caveat list, figures and paper reading; each job returns files plus a cross-verification brief for a second model. Zero deps, MIT.
description.zh: AI4S 科研工作流技能包，面向 AI for Science 与研究生/科研 Agent 用户：多角度文献调研（每角度落盘）、实验方案（含漏洞清单）、作图与精读；每单交付文件，附交叉验证任务书。零依赖，MIT。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VS Code 风格的本地工作台，含文件资源管理器、Monaco 编辑器、全文搜索与 Git 面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消耗统计插件：设置页 Token 用量 KPI、半年活跃热力图、按模型堆叠柱状图与模型环形图（dsh-plugin）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消耗统计插件：设置页 Token 用量 KPI、半年活跃热力图、按模型堆叠柱状图与模型环形图（dsh-plugin）

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: DSH 长期记忆插件：上下文超过阈值时把最早的一段对话归档到 memory/ 回忆文件夹，之后按关键词与重要度概率自动回忆。Host-only, zero-dependency memory engine for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件：上下文超过阈值时把最早的一段对话归档到 memory/ 回忆文件夹，之后按关键词与重要度概率自动回忆。Host-only, zero-dependency memory engine for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: 由 Genca（缙嘉集团，上海缙嘉科技有限公司）VinkWork 团队开源的 DSH 插件：PSD 主图模板批量套 SKU、画布微调、整批导出。VinkWork 核心产品：VinkClaw.com。
description.zh: 由 Genca（缙嘉集团，上海缙嘉科技有限公司）VinkWork 团队开源的 DSH 插件：PSD 主图模板批量套 SKU、画布微调、整批导出。VinkWork 核心产品：VinkClaw.com。

description.en: DSH sidebar image-generation workbench with illustration and photography pipelines, a built-in local account pool, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏 AI 生图工作台，涵盖图文与摄影两类流程，内置本地账号池，亦支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness 功能中枢：用一张管理面板统一注册、开关所有小功能（模型余额、Token 用量记录、任务动画等）。每个功能独立模块，支持开关与错误隔离，新功能即插即用。0.1.0 为基础框架，功能接入按 README 路线图迭代。
description.zh: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness 功能中枢：用一张管理面板统一注册、开关所有小功能（模型余额、Token 用量记录、任务动画等）。每个功能独立模块，支持开关与错误隔离，新功能即插即用。0.1.0 为基础框架，功能接入按 README 路线图迭代。

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复读出来，带可拖动的挂件开关与一键部署。需预装 Python 3.10–3.12（安装器只负责定位，不负责安装）；建议约 5 GB 磁盘与 GPU。

description.en: 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching; the whole UI is tinted from the palette and hover interactions glow in the theme accent.
description.zh: 🐱 Catppuccin 主题插件：充满活力、令人放松的柔和彩色主题。遵循官方 26 色粉彩盘，🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha 四档一键切换，全界面按色盘上色，鼠标滑过交互变主题色。

description.en: 在 Windows 环境中为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL 2 bash 工具,含 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式、后台任务
description.zh: 在 Windows 环境中为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL 2 bash 工具,含 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式、后台任务

description.en: Codex-style archived session manager for DSH Web UI — view, search, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
description.zh: Codex-style archived session manager for DSH Web UI — view, search, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page

description.en: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
description.zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness の日本語化プラグイン
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness の日本語化プラグイン

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).
description.zh: 可复现科学分析工作台：agent 驱动的 cell、内联图形与反馈重画、manifest 溯源、环境快照与出版级出图技能（9 个 bio_* 工具 + 工作台界面）。

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Tell your deepseek-v4.1-flash: "shut up! Stop looping!"
description.zh: Tell your deepseek-v4.1-flash: "shut up! Stop looping!"

description.en: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，把该套餐的模型作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 provider 路由提供；调用 api.openai.com/v1/responses 并使用账号的套餐授权范围，而非 Codex 后端。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated comments, a draggable control ball, per-session pools with replay, and a settings card.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 对话区叠加 B 站风格弹幕：按 agent 事件生成滚动/顶部/底部三轨弹幕，三套预设包、可选 LLM 生成吐槽、可拖动控制球、分会话弹幕池与历史回放，以及完整设置卡。

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.
description.zh: 把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness：内置华为云 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），也支持粘贴 token；登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 提供的模型。积分余额、即将过期额度与每日签到读 CodeArts 自己的积分接口，请求数与 token 用量按账号在本机统计；对话输入框下方那行积分可点开看逐号明细，积分与上游排队位置都能在设置里单独关掉。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
description.zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

description.en: Runs the DSH session agent as an explicit control loop: a persistent session goal drives rounds of task, verify and triage agents via one workflow run per round, with append-only goal revisions and an optional hard gate that restricts the top-level agent to read and orchestration tools while routing every change through a goal. Includes a client-side Goal tab and sub-agent approval relay.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话代理组织为显式控制回路：持久的会话目标驱动每轮由任务、验证、分诊代理组成的 workflow 执行，目标修订只追加不改写，并提供可选硬门——顶层代理仅保留读取与编排工具，一切变更须经目标循环。含客户端「目标」标签页与子代理审批透传。

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: Markdown conversation theme plugin — 4 built-in themes with light and dark variants, user-editable CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, an in-browser editor with syntax highlighting and save-time validation, and a theme selection that persists across reloads and tabs. Also ships a version-history panel. Windows and DSH Desktop supported.
description.zh: 对话 Markdown 主题插件——4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、可自行编辑的 CSS 用户主题、跟随系统自动切换、内置编辑器（语法高亮 + 保存校验）、选中主题在刷新与新标签页后保持，并附带版本台账面板；支持 Windows 与 DSH Desktop。

description.en: Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-compatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment
description.zh: Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-compatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description.zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

description.en: An in-process trigram index that makes code search in Pi&DSH 20-70x faster than ripgrep, with identical results and no sidecar process.
description.zh: An in-process trigram index that makes code search in Pi&DSH 20-70x faster than ripgrep, with identical results and no sidecar process.

description.en: Turns an organised memory archive into a browsable star map — one star per memory, the diary as an outer timeline, plus a chapter view, a day view, and a picking task that files each day's raw conversation into the archive.
description.zh: 把整理好的记忆档案铺成一张能点的星图——一条记忆一颗星，日记在外圈排成时间星带，另有星册、星历，以及把每天的原始对话收进档案的「拾星」。

description.en: Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web plugin — Anime maid whale desktop pet with satiety system and real-time LLM interaction
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web plugin — Anime maid whale desktop pet with satiety system and real-time LLM interaction

description.en: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.
description.zh: 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 部署到自有 VPS：零依赖登录网关加自动 HTTPS，反向代理原生 Web 界面，令牌保护的初始化向导，DSH 一键升级且失败自动回滚；作为插件在设置中新增「VPS 部署」页，可填表经 SSH 把 DSH 装到或卸出 VPS，并显示版本、升级、网关状态，以及扫码把 DSH 添加到手机桌面。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Project-level MCP manager for DSH: auto-mount MCP servers from each project's .dsh/mcp.yml, hot-reload config changes, and scope tools to the active session's project.
description.zh: Project-level MCP manager for DSH: auto-mount MCP servers from each project's .dsh/mcp.yml, hot-reload config changes, and scope tools to the active session's project.

description.en: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
description.zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
description.zh: 一站式管理 MCP 服务器、技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。

description.en: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
description.zh: 安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正；评分以角标形式展示在该回答的操作行上（通过=绿、未达标=红，悬停可见重试次数与原因）。闸值配置可从输入框上方视图栏的「Reviewer 配置」标签页（对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置）、本机 127.0.0.1 HTTP 服务或 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签页实时修改。

description.en: A remote workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It manages SSH hosts inside DSH, opens remote terminals, lets you browse and edit remote files and inspect remote Git, and adds remote directories as workspaces, so the Agent's file operations and commands run on the remote machine.
description.zh: A remote workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It manages SSH hosts inside DSH, opens remote terminals, lets you browse and edit remote files and inspect remote Git, and adds remote directories as workspaces, so the Agent's file operations and commands run on the remote machine.

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Tone or voice alerts for DSH approvals, questions, completions, errors and stalls; reads out what is waiting and repeats until handled; no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 提醒音：审批、提问、完成、错误、卡住各有音色；选「语音」会念出工具名、原因或问题原文；未处理会重复提醒，全程不联网。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
description.zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

description.en: Fold completed turns into their final conclusions, split thinking from prose with a divider, and jump between turns from a rail dockable left or right with line or dot marks, an optional ring and hover summaries; it can hide the host right-edge TurnNavigator, load earlier history, and open a pre-filled diagnostics issue.
description.zh: 已完成轮次折叠成最终结论、思考与正文之间插入分隔线、可贴左缘或右缘的定位条（横线 / 圆点标记、可选外圈、悬停摘要 + 点击跳转）；还可隐藏宿主原生右缘 TurnNavigator、加载更早历史、一键打开预填好的诊断报告 issue。

description.en: Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with git-cleanliness guardrails.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Trellis 风格工作流：基于 agent/pre-step 的每轮速记注入、内置技能提供方，以及带 git 清洁度护栏的 DSH 原生任务与相位状态管理。

description.en: Douyin local-promotion OEM ad daily/weekly report automation (Author: Kirin): collects 3 data sources (laike leads, plan-level delivery, video analysis) via a one-time Edge login, computes metrics, builds A4-style docx reports, supports free-choice scheduled run times and email notifications.
description.zh: 抖音本地推 OEM 广告日报/周报自动生成（作者：Kirin）：一次 Edge 登录后自动采集三大数据源（来客客资、计划级投放明细、视频分析），计算指标并生成 A4 排版 docx 报告，支持自由选择定时运行时间和邮件通知。

description.en: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 音频插件 —— 多厂商 TTS、音乐、音效与音色设计，含侧边栏面板、模型对比、资源库与 Agent 工具。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: 主打安全，提倡先审查再安装的DeepSeek Harness市场。深度扫描 5 分钟，放心使用每一天。
description.zh: 主打安全，提倡先审查再安装的DeepSeek Harness市场。深度扫描 5 分钟，放心使用每一天。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: 🐂🐴 牛马修仙看板：DeepSeek Harness 工时统计 × 修仙养成——把每一分钟劳动，都修成境界（日/周/月 + 学年年历，炼气→宇宙洪荒）
description.zh: 🐂🐴 牛马修仙看板：DeepSeek Harness 工时统计 × 修仙养成——把每一分钟劳动，都修成境界（日/周/月 + 学年年历，炼气→宇宙洪荒）

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

description.en: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.
description.zh: 在 GUI 页签内嵌真实的 VSCode 编辑器（code-server，或通过自带 bridge 扩展连接本机桌面 VS Code）：Agent 的文件改动弹出按对话轮次累计的红绿 diff，关标签、刷新页面都不丢，写入期间文件自动锁定，看门狗托管进程、崩溃升级不留孤儿。

description.en: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.
description.zh: Typst 文档编辑工具：WYSIWYG 编辑排版论文、报告、试卷、简历、图表、海报、乐谱和可导出为 PPTX 的 Slides。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加可配置的「沙箱授权目录」，允许工作区外的受信修改。
description.zh: 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加可配置的「沙箱授权目录」，允许工作区外的受信修改。

description.en: Authenticated remote access for a DeepSeek Harness web profile: TLS, QR/passcode device pairing, password sign-in, and per-device revocation in front of an untouched loopback harness.
description.zh: Authenticated remote access for a DeepSeek Harness web profile: TLS, QR/passcode device pairing, password sign-in, and per-device revocation in front of an untouched loopback harness.

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

description.en: A customizable process-tree visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: A customizable process-tree visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.
description.zh: 受 opencode 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动，提供会话侧栏、流式聊天、markdown 工具卡片、待办列表、斜杠命令建议、带上下文用量表的遥测底栏与内联审批提示。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
description.zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

description.en: Parse PDFs and documents into structured Markdown with MinerU. Uploads files to the MinerU cloud; no offline mode.
description.zh: 用 MinerU 把 PDF 与文档解析为结构化 Markdown。文件会上传到 MinerU 云端，无离线模式。

description.en: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

description.en: MCP server installer and verifier for DeepSeek Harness: interactive init writes real patch entries into a profile, list and validate inspect them, and a CI-enforced verifier connects to every curated server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器安装与验证工具：交互式 init 会把真实 patch 条目写进 profile，list 与 validate 检查配置，CI 强制的验证器逐个连接精选服务器。

description.en: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关的模型接入 DSH 选择器，支持模型显隐管理、图片输入与思考档位。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

description.en: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的待处理改动审查：每次 edit/write/str_replace_editor 改动都会自动汇总到文件列表，可对单个差异块、选区内的多块或整个文件执行保留/回退，支持撤销重做。还能导入工作区的版本控制改动，以单栏或左右对照视图展示差异，并提供亦能保留/回退差异的 Markdown 预览、文件内搜索、差异块跳转与可复制的行号引用；差异数据持久化存储，重启后可继续审查。

description.en: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
description.zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

description.en: Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.
description.zh: DSH 本地代码智能插件：Impact X-Ray 可视化展示潜在变更影响、源码证据与不确定性，并提供符号导航、有界 Context Pack 和 ArkTS 支持。

description.en: Claude-Code-Styled TUI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Claude-Code-Styled TUI for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏内嵌 dsh 网页界面，让 agent 读取当前页面、捕获 HTTP 流量并操作浏览器。

description.en: Visible agent browser for DSH over CDP, also driving egolite, Tabbit, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Lightpanda backends. Only bcdp_status stays resident (401 chars); the other 33 context-optimized bcdp_* tools unlock per activity batch, so non-browser sessions pay no schema tax (-91.9% measured). Realtime watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picks quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices; non-CDP channels (ego CLI / Tabbit CLI) sync frames by 3s polling. Cross-version support for DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 (exact enumeration of 10 rc).
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入），同时驱动 egolite、Tabbit、Chrome、Edge、Brave 与 Lightpanda 后端。常驻只有 bcdp_status（401 字符），其余 33 个经过上下文优化的 bcdp_* 工具按活动批次解锁——不碰浏览器的会话不缴 schema token 税（实测 -91.9%）。实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；非 CDP 通道（ego CLI / Tabbit CLI）以 3s 轮询同步画面。DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 跨版本支持（精确枚举 10 个 rc）。

description.en: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - drive dsh agents from Zed and any ACP v1 client
description.zh: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - drive dsh agents from Zed and any ACP v1 client

description.en: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.
description.zh: 会话智能标题：每轮对话结束后用一次独立的辅助 LLM 调用对「用户消息+助手回答」的完整转写做总结，标题跟随会话真实主题而不是复述第一句话；首条消息即时出题、内置标题失败在后续轮次自动重试、用户手动改名绝不被覆盖、自动跳过子代理与 fork 会话。

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层——autopilot/ralph/team 三种执行模式、19 张角色卡、40 个双语技能与内置 MCP 状态服务，移植自 oh-my-claudecode。

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

description.en: 向模型暴露 sleep 工具，按指定毫秒暂停执行后返回，支持取消/clamp | Exposes a sleep tool that pauses for specified ms then returns, with cancellation/clamping
description.zh: 向模型暴露 sleep 工具，按指定毫秒暂停执行后返回，支持取消/clamp | Exposes a sleep tool that pauses for specified ms then returns, with cancellation/clamping

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh subagent with its own persona. Supports breakpoint resume for interrupted runs.
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: DSH 对话体验增强套件（零 DSH 源码改动，纯插件注入）。回合呈现：思考/工具调用聚合 chip · 步骤卡/总结卡 · 共享活动抽屉。正文增强：proto-tabs 卡片 · diagram 流程图 · 生图画廊。界面与工具：会话头部标签上移 · 桌面壳窗口控制留位与主题同步 · 对话截图（无头浏览器渲染 markdown/shiki/mermaid）· download 下载工具（实时进度/速度/ETA）。另有可选的 KR 对话双栏执行大盘。
description.zh: DSH 对话体验增强套件（零 DSH 源码改动，纯插件注入）。回合呈现：思考/工具调用聚合 chip · 步骤卡/总结卡 · 共享活动抽屉。正文增强：proto-tabs 卡片 · diagram 流程图 · 生图画廊。界面与工具：会话头部标签上移 · 桌面壳窗口控制留位与主题同步 · 对话截图（无头浏览器渲染 markdown/shiki/mermaid）· download 下载工具（实时进度/速度/ETA）。另有可选的 KR 对话双栏执行大盘。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native text-read protection is off by default.
description.zh: 为编码 Agent 提供可恢复的文件和 Git 操作、共享恢复与脱敏工具及 DSH Shell 适配器；保留审计记录，可选原生文本读取保护默认关闭。
