description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: FEMO插件版 — 可接入dsh的多智能体引擎，差不多能做所有事：我已经用femo和我的主agent玩了好几局狼人杀了，他抽到狼他还刀我！ 我在b站的宣传视频也是用femo剪的。 coding的时候，特别难找的bug、代码重构，我都会用femo来做。 我甚至用femo模式给我的主agent养了只宠物，她很开心。
description.zh: FEMO插件版 — 可接入dsh的多智能体引擎，差不多能做所有事：我已经用femo和我的主agent玩了好几局狼人杀了，他抽到狼他还刀我！ 我在b站的宣传视频也是用femo剪的。 coding的时候，特别难找的bug、代码重构，我都会用femo来做。 我甚至用femo模式给我的主agent养了只宠物，她很开心。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

description.en: Brave Search-backed WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web)
description.zh: Brave Search-backed WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web)

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用 TOTP 动态码或通行密钥（WebAuthn：一个账号可绑定多个密钥，手机可扫码添加，支持免用户名登录，改动登录因子前必须二次验证）；设置面板内置用户管理（普通用户可修改本人资料与密码并管理自己的 TOTP 与通行密钥，管理员可新增/删除用户、重置密码、管理邀请码、清除丢失设备的通行密钥）；模型与 API Key 按用户隔离管理，私有配置用登录口令派生的密钥加密、任何管理员都无法读取，管理员可把自己的模型分享给指定用户（可用、可看余额、看不到 Key、撤销立即生效），未配置的用户被阻断而不是回退到部署级配置；REST/列表接口按用户隔离，WebSocket 主通道逐帧按归属过滤；会话重启后免登录恢复；JSONL 审计日志；存储故障时保持 fail-closed。仅支持 DSH 0.2.0 线（0.1.1-rc.2 传输线已在 0.7.0 移除）；因浏览器要求安全上下文，通行密钥需通过 localhost 或 HTTPS 访问。

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate fell from 7.95% to 2.20%.
description.zh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

description.en: DSH 插件：统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用——Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型/供应商/项目/来源/账号/日期拆分。A token usage, cost and provider-balance plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 插件：统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用——Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型/供应商/项目/来源/账号/日期拆分。A token usage, cost and provider-balance plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.
description.zh: DSH 实时安全浮标，随工具调用更新防护状态，点击查看调用统计、风险来源链和拦截结果，支持只读任务约束及工具元数据变化检测。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: Turn your DSH token usage into a gacha game: feed a monster with tokens, earn coins, pull from 14 AI waifus (Kimi/GLM/Gemini/Claude and more), enhance artifacts, and build a Balatro-style battle team with daily sign-in bonuses.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 token 消耗变成抽卡小游戏：喂代码怪、攒代币、抽 14 位 AI 娘（Kimi娘/GLM娘/Gemini娘/Claude娘…），圣遗物强化、双件合成与每日签到弹窗，组建小丑牌式战斗阵容，十连出金自动生成分享卡。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: 面向数学笔记的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，驻留在 Obsidian 右侧栏。可直接读写数学笔记，维护分层长期记忆（画像、主题、类型化记录、原始证据），按 Rethlas 风格证明工作流工作，内置个人定理索引与问题模板库，并能把关键想法捕捉到备忘录、主动提醒打磨。
description.zh: 面向数学笔记的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，驻留在 Obsidian 右侧栏。可直接读写数学笔记，维护分层长期记忆（画像、主题、类型化记录、原始证据），按 Rethlas 风格证明工作流工作，内置个人定理索引与问题模板库，并能把关键想法捕捉到备忘录、主动提醒打磨。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: DSH 插件：生成式界面 / Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness。模型写声明式 DSL，无 DOM Worker 沙箱里执行，宿主用原生 DOM 画成真界面；另有一条自包含文档的逃生舱。原地改写、版本历史、跨重启可 patch。对标 ChatGPT Intelligent UI 与 Claude Artifacts。
description.zh: DSH 插件：生成式界面 / Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness。模型写声明式 DSL，无 DOM Worker 沙箱里执行，宿主用原生 DOM 画成真界面；另有一条自包含文档的逃生舱。原地改写、版本历史、跨重启可 patch。对标 ChatGPT Intelligent UI 与 Claude Artifacts。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: 贾维斯 · 常驻桌面的悬浮窗桌面助手 / 桌面宠物 —— DSH Desktop 的粒子光球：快速审批权限、⌃⌥J 快速对话。A floating-window desktop assistant & desktop pet for DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 贾维斯 · 常驻桌面的悬浮窗桌面助手 / 桌面宠物 —— DSH Desktop 的粒子光球：快速审批权限、⌃⌥J 快速对话。A floating-window desktop assistant & desktop pet for DSH Desktop.

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

description.en: 在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue / React / Svelte / Angular 源码。DSH 点击定位源码检查器，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar：预览本地 dev server，点击元素，源码直达 DSH 聊天，交给助手微调。Click a UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue / React / Svelte / Angular source in the DSH chat. DeepSeek Harness click-to-source inspector, dsh-better-sidebar compatible.
description.zh: 在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue / React / Svelte / Angular 源码。DSH 点击定位源码检查器，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar：预览本地 dev server，点击元素，源码直达 DSH 聊天，交给助手微调。Click a UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue / React / Svelte / Angular source in the DSH chat. DeepSeek Harness click-to-source inspector, dsh-better-sidebar compatible.

description.en: Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs, authorized local HTML and running Windows apps through a searchable native sidebar or @. Open browser candidates and the webpage sidebar refresh when the extension connects, disconnects or changes tabs, including an unchanged search query. Windows application lists skip protected processes with unreadable identity metadata and preserve other running apps. Read scoped snapshots, batch actions, capture screenshots and use available WebMCP tools; supports authorized uploads, drag/drop and opt-in network metadata. Browser actions preserve failure evidence, accept an explicit post-action observation scope and can check one final visible/text/value/URL condition without replaying effects. Expandable context preserves model content; dockable annotations support a session-bound staging queue with edit/delete/restore, and append to chat drafts without sending. App control prefers a matching installed MCP or approved installation, then Cua Driver with text, hotkeys and paged controls; desktop reads present the window once per connection or when recovery is needed. Background input depends on the app. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ with the companion MV3 extension manually loaded and paired; installing the plugin does not install the extension.
description.zh: 通过可搜索的原生侧栏或 @ 引用已登录的 Chrome / Edge 标签页、已授权的本地 HTML 和运行中的 Windows 应用。扩展连接、断开或标签页变化时，已打开的浏览器候选与网页侧栏自动更新，无需修改搜索词。Windows 应用列表跳过身份信息无法读取的受保护进程，保留其他运行中的应用。读取局部快照、批量操作、截图及调用可用的 WebMCP 工具；支持授权上传、拖放和按需网络元数据。浏览器动作失败后保留执行证据，可显式指定后置观察范围，并在末尾检查一次可见性、文本、输入值或 URL 条件，不自动重放副作用。可展开引用保留模型内容；可收纳批注支持绑定会话的暂存队列与编辑、删除、恢复，加入聊天草稿而不自动发送。应用控制优先匹配的本地 MCP，未安装先询问，无匹配时使用 Cua Driver，支持打字、快捷键及控件分页；桌面读取在连接首次或需要恢复窗口时展示。后台输入取决于应用。需要 Chrome / Edge 125+，手动加载配套 MV3 扩展并配对；插件不会自动安装扩展。

description.en: Native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, approvals, questions, notifications, and secure remote access.
description.zh: Native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, approvals, questions, notifications, and secure remote access.

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission policy, and provides persistent-terminal tools.
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: Cross-session verification, claims and a decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness — so two agent sessions don't repeat, contradict or deadlock each other.
description.zh: Cross-session verification, claims and a decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness — so two agent sessions don't repeat, contradict or deadlock each other.

description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生成式交互界面：模型每次回答自行在 26 个校验过的原生组件与沙箱流式 HTML widget 之间选择，可按组件 ID 就地修补已渲染的界面，标签页、排序、筛选与表单值在刷新后恢复，滑块与筛选的重算在浏览器本地完成，不回调模型。

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。

description.en: A local-first research workspace for DeepSeek Harness: PDF annotations, AI reading, citations, knowledge graphs, LaTeX and slides.
description.zh: A local-first research workspace for DeepSeek Harness: PDF annotations, AI reading, citations, knowledge graphs, LaTeX and slides.

description.en: 用于提供更丰富的DeepSeek Harness底栏信息显示插件
description.zh: 用于提供更丰富的DeepSeek Harness底栏信息显示插件

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

description.en: 优化DeepSeek Harness的聊天区交互体验 | Chat-area UX plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI.
description.zh: 优化DeepSeek Harness的聊天区交互体验 | Chat-area UX plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI.

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Smart Charts skill: turns CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON data files into standalone interactive ECharts HTML - 32 chart types including offline maps, 3 themes, no CDN. A --profile data profile (per-column dtype, cardinality, missingness, samples, statistics, entity grain, insight signals) lets the agent read the data and pick the chart itself; each chart embeds a fact sheet (plot_stats + data_preview) whose numbers are the only quotable values. LLM transform code runs in a restricted sandbox (blacklist + AST whitelist + safe builtins); --doctor self-checks the Python environment. Fully offline, ECharts bundled.
description.zh: 智能图表 skill：把 CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON 数据文件转为独立交互式 ECharts HTML——32 种图表（含离线地图）、3 套主题、无需 CDN。--profile 数据画像（每列 dtype/基数/缺失/样本/统计、实体粒度、洞察信号）让 agent 自己读懂数据并决定选型；每张图内置事实卡（plot_stats + data_preview），其数值是解读时唯一可引用的数字。LLM 转换代码在受限沙箱（黑名单 + AST 白名单 + 安全 builtins）中执行；--doctor 自检 Python 环境。ECharts 离线打包，完全无需联网。

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接进 DSH 界面：左侧边栏的 Studio 面板、输入框下方的会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右侧边栏查看当前会话检索到哪些记忆的面板。

description.en: File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
description.zh: 文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。

description.en: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录并叠加 GitHub 与 npm 实时搜索来找 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度、新鲜度与有界热度排序，而不是只看 star。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness: per-model daily and range charts plus a yearly contributions heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计：近 7 天/30 天按模型的柱状图、饼图，外加近一年每日活跃热力图。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Deepseek Harness 宠物插件
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 宠物插件

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

description.en: 梁文谷 DSH 插件：在 Web GUI 右上角显示当前算力错峰时段（已适配deepseek 2026.08.22 公布的最新峰谷收费政策，工作日 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为梁文峰，其余时间含整个周末为梁文谷），并实时倒计时当前时段剩余时间；谷期跨天计算，直达下一工作日 09:00。
description.zh: 梁文谷 DSH 插件：在 Web GUI 右上角显示当前算力错峰时段（已适配deepseek 2026.08.22 公布的最新峰谷收费政策，工作日 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为梁文峰，其余时间含整个周末为梁文谷），并实时倒计时当前时段剩余时间；谷期跨天计算，直达下一工作日 09:00。

description.en: GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
description.zh: 基于 gh CLI 的 GitHub 搜索/发现/审计技能包（SKILL.md 打包）：仓库搜索、多轴探索、趋势、仓库概览、相似项目、代码搜索、issue/PR 搜索与组织审计；以 dsh bundle 形式安装（并已发布 npm）。

description.en: Modular execution discipline and autonomous steward for DSH: evidence-first routing across 44 canonical skills, durable state planning, verification gates, fail-streak recovery, and interactive web dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化执行纪律与自主管家：覆盖 44 项规范技能的循证路由、持久化状态规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

description.en: 按 agent_key 将 DeepSeek Harness subagent 严格路由到已注册 provider/model 的轻量插件
description.zh: 按 agent_key 将 DeepSeek Harness subagent 严格路由到已注册 provider/model 的轻量插件

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: Floating notes for the dsh web GUI: keep commands, credentials and snippets at hand, insert any note into the composer, save any selection as a note
description.zh: Floating notes for the dsh web GUI: keep commands, credentials and snippets at hand, insert any note into the composer, save any selection as a note

description.en: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
description.zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

description.en: Connect Google Antigravity OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness with smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image generation.
description.zh: 接入 Google Antigravity OAuth 账号，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能多账号池额度自愈轮换、全系多模型流式路由及 Nano Banana 2 图像生成。

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容寻址 blob 去重并自动 GC。深浅两套配色跟随 DSH 主题，字体跟随 DSH 与已装皮肤（也可选机器上的任意字体并微调字号）；设置里可把「用简体中文思考」规则注入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: Build PowerPoint decks from a brief: plan and storyboard gates, per-page authoring through pptwise and ppt-master, a design-profile pass, page-image snapshots with a render audit, and a tool that hands those pages to an image-capable model for review.
description.zh: 从需求生成 PPTX：规划与分镜门、pptwise + ppt-master 页级作者、设计档案 pass、渲染页图快照与渲染审计，以及把页图交给支持图片的模型自评的工具。

description.en: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
description.zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.
description.zh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen + Go free-tier models working: session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.
description.zh: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen + Go free-tier models working: session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.

description.en: OneBot v11 hub: sits between an upstream OneBot implementation (LLOneBot and similar) and downstream bot implementations, relaying events and actions verbatim, and gives the agent a per-session timeline, an action ledger, layered memory (active topics and tasks, long-term events, person and group profiles) and onebot_* tools for replying, media, members and raw API calls.
description.zh: OneBot v11 枢纽：夹在上游 OneBot 实现（LLOneBot 等）与下游 bot 实现之间，逐字转发事件与动作；给 agent 一条按会话的时间线、动作账本、分层记忆（进行中的话题与任务、长期事件、人物与群档案）以及一组 onebot_* 工具（回复、媒体、成员、原始 API 调用）。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: A searchable, sortable model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — provider groups, favorites, models.dev prices, context windows, live per-task token cost and a local-model filter. One-command install: dsh plugin add dsh-model-garden.
description.zh: A searchable, sortable model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — provider groups, favorites, models.dev prices, context windows, live per-task token cost and a local-model filter. One-command install: dsh plugin add dsh-model-garden.

description.en: Keeps plugins you have edited (third-party or built-in) as local git repos: deploys an exact commit only after it builds and passes checks, reverts a change that crashes dsh right after it is applied, merges origin updates (npm or git) into your edits, and can open an agent session that squashes your edits into one commit on top of the original release (backup branch first).
description.zh: 把你改过的插件（第三方或内置）保存为本地 git 仓库：只部署已构建并通过检查的指定提交，应用后导致 dsh 崩溃时自动回滚，把 npm 或 git 源的更新合并进你的修改，并可打开智能体会话，把你的修改压缩为原始发布版本之上的一个提交（先建备份分支）。

description.en: A visual Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web—inspect repositories, run common Git actions, and safely execute AI-generated workflows.
description.zh: A visual Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web—inspect repositories, run common Git actions, and safely execute AI-generated workflows.

description.en: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 手写墨迹开屏插件：按真实笔顺写出你的文字，收在鲸鱼锁标上；字体、文字与深浅色都在设置里配置。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 手写墨迹开屏插件：按真实笔顺写出你的文字，收在鲸鱼锁标上；字体、文字与深浅色都在设置里配置。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Local-first failure evidence capsules for DeepSeek Harness sessions
description.zh: Local-first failure evidence capsules for DeepSeek Harness sessions

description.en: Independent workspace and conversation personas with adaptive styles, approved communication preferences and role-based routing to registered DSH models, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins.
description.zh: 为工作区与对话配置独立人格，支持自适应风格、经确认的通用交流偏好和子代理模型路由；可配合其他 provider 插件使用 Codex、Claude Code 等已注册模型。

description.en: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.
description.zh: 在编辑/写入工具行内联 +N −M 徽标，每轮末尾给出可折叠的文件变更汇总卡：对齐差异、逐文件审查与撤销；覆盖原生 edit/write、str_replace_editor 与 Code Dispatch 子调用，不依赖 git。

description.en: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端对话区底部的统计行换成可配置状态栏：10 个字段可选可排序，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷口径实时估算费用，支持自定义模型单价、CNY / USD 计价切换与账户余额显示。

description.en: 原神哥伦比娅主题的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：背景、蒙版与明暗配色。A Genshin Impact Columbina themed plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: background, mask, and per light/dark color schemes.
description.zh: 原神哥伦比娅主题的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：背景、蒙版与明暗配色。A Genshin Impact Columbina themed plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: background, mask, and per light/dark color schemes.

description.en: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.
description.zh: DSH 纯净桌面壳：双击桌面快捷方式即可像普通桌面软件一样启动；后端活性实时监测 + 托盘一键启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、单实例。复用现有 web profile，不改动 web 界面。Windows + macOS 双平台。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏用量与成本面板：官方峰谷计价 · 1M 上下文 · 词勋段位 · 成就与热力图
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏用量与成本面板：官方峰谷计价 · 1M 上下文 · 词勋段位 · 成就与热力图

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: Local library panel for DSH: indexes files and artifacts into a searchable card tree with PDF, Office and image preview, plus paper search across arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref and others, web-page archiving to markdown snapshots, a plugin-market tab, and one-click switching for resources found in installed plugins (personas, meme packs, whale widget assets). Ships 18 tools and 22 host routes.
description.zh: DSH 的本地资料馆：把本机文件与产物索引成可搜索的卡片树，支持 PDF / Office / 图片预览，另带论文检索（arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref 等）、把网页存成 markdown 快照、插件市场标签页，以及已装插件资源的同步与一键切换（人设、表情包图集、鲸鱼挂件素材）。包含 18 个工具与 22 条宿主路由。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉群聊常驻个人助理插件
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉群聊常驻个人助理插件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商额度监控插件：余额型 API 查询 + 限额型本地用量计量，侧边栏实时卡片 + 可视化配置。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商额度监控插件：余额型 API 查询 + 限额型本地用量计量，侧边栏实时卡片 + 可视化配置。

description.en: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先持久记忆：在 pre-step 注入有预算上限的热记忆，使用精确匹配与中文二元 BM25 召回冷层，提供六个 Agent 工具，并以审批门禁、租约锁、恢复回执和只读治理与轨迹复盘候选保护写入。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: 让DSH能够支持远程访问Web的插件，可指定WebToken进行认证
description.zh: 让DSH能够支持远程访问Web的插件，可指定WebToken进行认证

description.en: The opt-in 0.8 preview adds Superagent teams for request intake, ticket assignment, progress reports and owner decision cards, on an A2A network with signed peer discovery, linked-host routing and receipt tracking.
description.zh: 0.8 预览版提供 Superagent 团队的需求受理、工单分派、进展汇报和属主决策卡；A2A 底座支持签名节点发现、已链接主机间路由及回执追踪。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: 把 WebUI 会话流中连续相邻的同工具调用合并为「主卡片+紧凑子行」树状展示，默认覆盖所有内置通用行工具 | Merges consecutive same-tool calls in the WebUI chat flow into a main-card + compact-child-rows tree view, all built-in generic tools by default
description.zh: 把 WebUI 会话流中连续相邻的同工具调用合并为「主卡片+紧凑子行」树状展示，默认覆盖所有内置通用行工具 | Merges consecutive same-tool calls in the WebUI chat flow into a main-card + compact-child-rows tree view, all built-in generic tools by default

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: DSH 插件 UI 调试神器：让 AI 在真实 Chrome 中帮你看界面、点按钮、拖组件，一键安装零配置
description.zh: DSH 插件 UI 调试神器：让 AI 在真实 Chrome 中帮你看界面、点按钮、拖组件，一键安装零配置

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase：检索工作区知识、操作结构化记录与应用、将写入提交为可审阅的 ChangeRequest，并在实时卡片中查看结果。

description.en: Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

description.en: WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
description.zh: 微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.
description.zh: 把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

description.en: Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.
description.zh: DSH 免费对口型口语视频生成插件，支持 3000+ 声音和 500+ 语言。

description.en: Two-tier model router for DeepSeek Harness — LLM-Judge routing, multi-model fallback chains, exponential-backoff failover, and task-level orchestration (DSH adaptation of pi-shift-router)
description.zh: Two-tier model router for DeepSeek Harness — LLM-Judge routing, multi-model fallback chains, exponential-backoff failover, and task-level orchestration (DSH adaptation of pi-shift-router)

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI, tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision.
description.zh: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI, tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision.

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.

description.en: dsh wps云文档插件
description.zh: dsh wps云文档插件

description.en: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧的可自定义部件栏：61 个部件覆盖会话统计、token 与缓存、上下文、后台任务、子代理、机器指标、OpenCode Go 与 Command Code 额度、会话成本、峰谷定价与 GitHub 待审队列；部件可在栏内市场安装，支持 1-4 列网格与 2x2 / 2x4 尺寸、逐实例配置、指针划过放大波峰与一键整栏收起。支持 DSH 0.1.x / 0.2.x，网页版与桌面端通用。

description.en: Network optimization for the DSH web UI: reduces transfer size with caching and compression to greatly speed up page loading, plus a connection-drop indicator and automatic reconnection. Ideal for users pursuing peak performance or using unstable networks.
description.zh: dsh网页端网络优化：通过缓存与压缩技术降低传输，从而大幅提升网页加载速度；同时提供网络断连指示与自动断网重连功能。非常适合追求极致性能或网络不稳定用户使用。

description.en: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.
description.zh: 按设定间隔从指定文件夹轮换 DSH 应用背景壁纸（带交叉淡化）；未配置文件夹时使用随插件分发的 4 张 SVG 渐变壁纸，并提供背景不透明度、壁纸压暗、毛玻璃模糊与文字阴影四个可读性调节，让面板与文字在花哨的图上仍然看得清。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 的持久知识库：十个 tiddlywiki_* 智能体工具（带过滤的检索、读写/批量/改名/删除、最近、标签，以及 git 同步与冲突解决），GUI 中央栏经同源代理内嵌完整 TiddlyWiki 编辑器，右侧栏知识库 Tab，会话级汇总本会话读写过的笔记，快速笔记卡片支持草稿自动保存，另可选剪藏书签（选中图片一并存为二进制附件）——全部由自动提交的 git 仓库支撑。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
description.zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
description.zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Swift Cycle governance skill adapter for DeepSeek Harness; user-invoked, version-pinned, and offline-verifiable.
description.zh: Swift Cycle governance skill adapter for DeepSeek Harness; user-invoked, version-pinned, and offline-verifiable.

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then require a persisted verdict backed by evidence from a real Odoo instance, with fail-closed gates, human-approved batches in a declared environment, Odoo's own CSV/Excel importer, and a journal that reverses the data written through the plugin.
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go, and bind a server to project directories so only sessions working inside them can see or call its tools.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置，并可把某个服务器绑定到指定项目目录——只有工作目录在其中的会话能看到并调用它的工具。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：悬浮的 Cubism 模型，表情随状态变化并跟随鼠标；尺寸与位置由插件配置驱动；内置官方 Haru 示例模型（© Live2D Inc.）。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

description.en: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
description.zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.5.x expands the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded (including a project AGENTS.md picked up mid-session, needs DSH 0.2.0+) and offers an opt-in live mode (off by default) that watches injected files and re-injects them on change, with settings-page controls; use 0.2.x on DSH 0.1.7.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。v0.5.x 会展开 DSH 已加载的所有指令文件里的引用（包括会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md，需 DSH 0.2.0+），并提供可选的实时模式（默认关闭）：监听已注入文件、变更后自动重注入，设置页可调；DSH 0.1.7 请用 0.2.x。

description.en: Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.
description.zh: 用本地 ComfyUI 出图：一个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘与去背景。

description.en: Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: Tencent CloudQ integration: AIOps chat mode with usage, inspiration, artifact and architecture panels.
description.zh: 腾讯云智能顾问集成：CloudQ 对话模式，附用量、灵感、制品与架构图面板。

description.en: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
description.zh: 模型选择器旁的 CLIProxyAPI 额度圆环，设置面板仿 CPA 管理页列出全部账号的额度窗口、套餐与刷新时间。

description.en: a simple plugin to improve web UX/UI for "Deepseek Harness (dsh)"
description.zh: a simple plugin to improve web UX/UI for "Deepseek Harness (dsh)"

description.en: Exposes a running DeepSeek Harness as an MCP server over Streamable HTTP or a bundled stdio bridge, so an external agent can create workspaces and sessions, prompt, fork, rename and switch the model on them, read and write files, run foreground and background shell commands, call the instance's own agent tools by name, and read per-turn and cumulative token usage with a cost receipt when a price plugin is installed.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 暴露为 MCP server（Streamable HTTP，或附带的 stdio 桥），外部 agent 可创建 workspace 与会话，发起 prompt、fork、重命名、切换模型，读写文件，运行前台与后台 shell 命令，按名调用该实例自身的 agent 工具，并读取单轮与累计 token 用量；装了计价插件时还给出费用回执。

description.en: DSH 动画优化：输出流式动画与 Claude Code 风格外观插件
description.zh: DSH 动画优化：输出流式动画与 Claude Code 风格外观插件

description.en: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.
description.zh: 能胜任严肃编程任务的 dsh。（Tools x Schemas）^REPL。`skill://`，`ctx://`，`agent://`，`dvc://`，`dsh://`，IPython REPL，Context as Variables，抗压缩可回溯、完整上下文重构。`hash-edit`、`dvc://browser`、subagent as function、workflow as function。

description.en: Connects DSH Web and qq-bridge to OFM, defaulting to the DeepSeek public pool while preserving reasoning effort and manual model selection; loads the official OFM dependency when absent and reports account-rotation receipts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web / qq-bridge 接入 OFM，默认先选 DeepSeek 免费池并保留思考档位；缺少 OFM 时装载官方依赖，支持自有账号与轮换回执，不限制手动选模。

description.en: Shares a local memory pool between DeepSeek web chat and Harness, with full-answer saving and sidebar browsing and injection. The optional Windows desktop patch for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 adds shadow sessions that sync completed web turns to Harness, display Harness replies in the original web chat, and hand tasks off to Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 网页与 Harness 共用本地记忆池，支持保存完整回答、侧栏浏览和注入。可选的 Windows 桌面补丁适用于 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，提供影子会话，可将已完成的网页问答同步到 Harness、在原网页对话查看 Harness 的回答，并从网页向 Harness 交办任务。

description.en: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中心增加「关于」分区：版本信息、npm 检查更新与一键安装（自动重启）、GitHub 版本更新记录。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel client connects to UUMit's hosted tunnel, and a panel in the sidebar handles pairing and who can use it (only you, people you invite by link or phone number, or everyone), with revocation. Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: the model answers with an openui-lang program and the Web GUI renders it as a live, interactive UI inside the chat
description.zh: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: the model answers with an openui-lang program and the Web GUI renders it as a live, interactive UI inside the chat

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline where every delivery must prove itself with structured evidence before the next phase may start; reviewers are read-only, code merges only after a review pass, and an append-only event log gives full replay and audit on a live kanban board. Its design draws inspiration from the Hermes Agent kanban.
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes Agent kanban。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

description.en: Codex-style conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness Web: a right-edge rail with hover preview and click-to-jump
description.zh: Codex-style conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness Web: a right-edge rail with hover preview and click-to-jump

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: dsh-plugin: OKF v0.2 topic memory for dsh - local-first git-tracked bundle, hot-path LLM-free injection, two-stage observer with background distill
description.zh: dsh-plugin: OKF v0.2 topic memory for dsh - local-first git-tracked bundle, hot-path LLM-free injection, two-stage observer with background distill

description.en: Agentic Control Plane for DeepSeek Harness — policy-check every tool call before it runs
description.zh: Agentic Control Plane for DeepSeek Harness — policy-check every tool call before it runs

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
description.zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: Native tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: wiki_query, wiki_write, wiki_rename, wiki_scaffold, wiki_archive, and wiki_lint cover BM25 search with link-graph context, bookkeeping writes with sha256 source tracking, vault-wide renames, mode scaffolds, source archiving, and health checks — with cross-process locks and optional git auto-commit.
description.zh: Obsidian wiki vault 原生工具：wiki_query、wiki_write、wiki_rename、wiki_scaffold、wiki_archive、wiki_lint 覆盖 BM25 链接图检索、带 sha256 源追踪的簿记式写入、全库改名、模式化脚手架、源归档与健康检查，并内置跨进程锁与可选 git 自动提交。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Plugin Store for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a graphical app-store inside the Harness Web UI — browse, search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugins (topic:dsh-plugin / #dsh-plugin repos), with local ratings, dependency impact graphs, audit logging and a plugin scaffold guide.
description.zh: Plugin Store for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a graphical app-store inside the Harness Web UI — browse, search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugins (topic:dsh-plugin / #dsh-plugin repos), with local ratings, dependency impact graphs, audit logging and a plugin scaffold guide.

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: 毛玻璃风格DSH主题，含壁纸、字体定制与网易云音乐
description.zh: 毛玻璃风格DSH主题，含壁纸、字体定制与网易云音乐

description.en: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的不同触发情况可分别设置音频提醒：支持正常完成、中断、出错、等待确认、自动重连成功五种场景，每种场景都有独立音频配置和默认音效；出错后自动重连，等待时长可自定义（10-300 秒）；附带社区音色库下载；已适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在上下文计量面板中添加「压缩上下文」与「新建会话」两个按钮：压缩按钮通过与手敲 /compact 相同的通道提交命令，新建会话按钮在同一 workspace 中开启新会话。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 配置、浏览器终端、SFTP 浏览、端口转发、代理与会话级 AI 访问。

description.en: RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.
description.zh: RigorQuant 预设与技能包：面向实证与计算数学（经济学、金融、组合）的无人值守隔离多智能体研究，内置四重实现前校验与 jacobian/Lean 升级通道。

description.en: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
description.zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): exports agent sessions as OpenTelemetry trace trees (GenAI semconv) to Langfuse's OTLP endpoint
description.zh: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): exports agent sessions as OpenTelemetry trace trees (GenAI semconv) to Langfuse's OTLP endpoint

description.en: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 23 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：23 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

description.en: Context visibility + GitHub-style usage heatmap for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Codex-style /context lens + 53-week contribution graph
description.zh: Context visibility + GitHub-style usage heatmap for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Codex-style /context lens + 53-week contribution graph

description.en: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.
description.zh: 文献研究工具集，注册 26 个模型工具，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar：字段语法检索、ID 互换、残缺引文定位、引文格式化、MeSH 与相关文献追溯、PubTator 生物概念归一与关系查询、Europe PMC 与 Semantic Scholar 翻页检索、全文获取，以及开放获取 PDF 发现（可选下载）。统一检索会跨源去重，排序依次按跨源命中、相关度、被引数；会话知识图谱带 PubTator 概念富集，可提交为持久用户图谱并渲染为 Mermaid。多数数据源无需密钥。

description.en: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
description.zh: 为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件管理器：在 Web 设置页中按官方/社区分组管理已安装插件（中文描述、一键启停、详情、卸载），并内置 GitHub 插件市场（高收藏/增长最快榜单 + 搜索 + 一键安装）。
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件管理器：在 Web 设置页中按官方/社区分组管理已安装插件（中文描述、一键启停、详情、卸载），并内置 GitHub 插件市场（高收藏/增长最快榜单 + 搜索 + 一键安装）。

description.en: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
description.zh: 面向视觉模型的内容感知 PDF 读取插件：逐页分析图（矢量与栅格）、表格、公式风险与双栏排版，基于内容识别进行混合提取，图表/公式页渲染成高 DPI 区域裁切。提供低清预览以理解页面概况并支持指定选区获取高清渲染。功能包装为多个工具供Agent使用。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): realtime quotes and indices, full-market search, intraday and forward-adjusted candlestick K-line with F10 fundamentals, stock/ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, watchlist with position P/L and price alerts, 13-signal screener with 7 preset strategies, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, three-source 7x24 news, and AI stock analysis.
description.zh: 韭菜盒子：A股看盘助手——实时行情与大盘指数、全市场搜索、同花顺式 K 线详情弹窗（日/周/月/5分/30分，含 F10 财务摘要）、股票/ETF/可转债/LOF 榜单、带持仓盈亏与价格预警的自选股、13 项技术信号选股与 7 个预设策略交叉、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、三源 7×24 聚合快讯、AI 个股分析。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: 🧬 dsh bio analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness — wish-style bioinformatics & biology analysis: Biopython-powered sequence analysis, genomics, zero-install Python env (uv+venv)
description.zh: 🧬 dsh bio analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness — wish-style bioinformatics & biology analysis: Biopython-powered sequence analysis, genomics, zero-install Python env (uv+venv)

description.en: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
description.zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Browse and search GitHub dsh-plugin repositories from Web UI Settings, sort by stars, and install plugins through the DSH CLI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 设置页浏览和搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 仓库，按 Star 排序，并通过 DSH CLI 安装插件。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: A version‑aware adapter registry that decouples third‑party Cordis plugins from dsh’s internal service names, paths, and RPC internals. 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。
description.zh: A version‑aware adapter registry that decouples third‑party Cordis plugins from dsh’s internal service names, paths, and RPC internals. 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
