description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 回退链插件：主模型失败自动切换备用 provider，带 Web UI 配置面板 | Provider fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 回退链插件：主模型失败自动切换备用 provider，带 Web UI 配置面板 | Provider fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: DSH的插件创意市场来啦!～～～欢迎使用&提供反馈！！DSH 插件创意市场 · DeepSeek Harness 插件发现与一键安装面板 全量嗅探官方 dsh-plugin topic（900+），过滤蹭标签噪音，保留人工精选标记； 支持总星数/最新发布/最近推送排序、即时搜索、语言过滤； 点安装先校验 dsh.bundle 声明，装不了的一律拒绝。零依赖零构建，装进 Web UI 的 Plugins 设置区。
description.zh: DSH的插件创意市场来啦!～～～欢迎使用&提供反馈！！DSH 插件创意市场 · DeepSeek Harness 插件发现与一键安装面板 全量嗅探官方 dsh-plugin topic（900+），过滤蹭标签噪音，保留人工精选标记； 支持总星数/最新发布/最近推送排序、即时搜索、语言过滤； 点安装先校验 dsh.bundle 声明，装不了的一律拒绝。零依赖零构建，装进 Web UI 的 Plugins 设置区。

description.en: Autonomic heartbeat for each root agent: silent pulses diff the session's todos, Agent Team board and goal against what the last pulse saw, and speak only on a signal — L1 report, L2 ask (ask_user_question), L4 escalate — never starting work. Each message carries a why-now line, an optional one-line physiology signature (time since your last message and how many times it has reached out today) and a compact task snapshot (800-char cap); a dedupe window, quiet hours, a daily budget, refractory/restart cooldowns and persisted vitals keep it quiet, while busy-safe followup injection never stacks. It shares one advisory speech floor with dsh-plugin-memory (~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json, 180 s) so the two never talk over each other, stays silent while a child subagent or teammate is still working, and surfaces a "subagents working · N" pill in the conversation header (polling pauses while the tab is hidden). v0.8 adds a diagnostics panel that explains recent quiet pulses and names the current speech-floor holder, plus panel controls for the arbitration window, presence suppression and the physiology line; its settings section carries a stroked heart mark (16×16, stroke 1.3, same spec as dsh-plugin-memory). v0.8.1 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.8.1 or newer.
description.zh: 给每个根 agent 装一套自主神经心跳：静默拍会 diff 会话的待办 / 团队任务板 / 目标，只有出现信号才开口（L1 汇报 / L2 提问 / L4 升级），只问不做。每条消息带 why-now 行、可选的一行生理签名（距你上次说话多久、今天第几次找你）与紧凑任务快照（800 字符上限）；去重窗口、静默时段、每日预算、不应期 / 重启冷却与持久化生命体征共同限流，忙碌时 followup 注入排队不打断。它与 dsh-plugin-memory 共享一个建议性发言权（~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json，默认 180 秒）互不抢话，子 agent / teammate 仍在运行时保持静默，并在会话头部显示「子智能体执行中 · N」胶囊（标签页隐藏时暂停轮询）。v0.8 新增诊断面板（解释最近几次为何没开口并显示当前发言权持有者）与面板内可调的仲裁窗口 / 在场抑制 / 生理签名开关；设置区块带专属描边爱心标记（16×16 / stroke 1.3，与 dsh-plugin-memory 规格一致）。v0.8.1 兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2：agent 注册表优先 agents.roots()、缺失时回退 agents.list()，所有 agent/created 监听器都做了异常保护——rc.2 下未保护的抛错会让 agent 注册被拒、无法新建会话，因此 rc.2 用户必须升级到 0.8.1 或更新版本。

description.en: dsh-okf-memory: 会话记忆 → OKF 知识沉淀插件(神经自我学习驱动)。Session-to-OKF memory plugin: predictive recall, uncertainty-driven capture, reinforcement feedback, consolidation & forgetting.
description.zh: dsh-okf-memory: 会话记忆 → OKF 知识沉淀插件(神经自我学习驱动)。Session-to-OKF memory plugin: predictive recall, uncertainty-driven capture, reinforcement feedback, consolidation & forgetting.

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 情绪球桌宠：根据 Agent 状态显示表情，支持对话内停靠与桌面端。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 情绪球桌宠：根据 Agent 状态显示表情，支持对话内停靠与桌面端。

description.en: DeepSeek API quota (balance) widget for the DSH web GUI: a floating bottom-right card showing remaining DeepSeek API balance.
description.zh: DeepSeek API quota (balance) widget for the DSH web GUI: a floating bottom-right card showing remaining DeepSeek API balance.

description.en: DeepSeek balance widget for the dsh web sidebar
description.zh: DeepSeek balance widget for the dsh web sidebar

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日全部会话总花费；每轮消息操作行前置本轮花费，详情面板含按模型计价与今日会话消费排行。官方峰谷定价，余额取自 /user/balance API。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于 MaaAssistantArknights (MAA) 官方命令行工具 maa-cli 构建的 DeepSeek Harness Skill：让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 MaaCore，自动化完成《明日方舟》日常任务。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Batch-port official Codex plugins into DSH skills (codex_list/port/status/health; measured: 186 plugins / 583 skills, 577 ported, 0 failures).
description.zh: Codex 官方插件一键移植为 DSH 技能（codex_list/port/status/health，实测 186 插件/583 技能，移植 577 个 0 失败）。

description.en: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.
description.zh: 补上官方 pi-ai 适配器在模型页缺的那半：网关可达性与延迟探测、一键拉取网关模型目录并勾选写回配置、DeepSeek 余额与各家配额就地常驻、每个 provider 实际接入的协议与地址；模型下拉只列当前真能用的分组 —— key 失效、余额耗尽、配额用尽都会被摘掉，修好后自动恢复。

description.en: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按模型、会话与日期统计 token 用量，并监控 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与 Z.ai 额度。

description.en: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema/stats/health across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Visual session graph for DeepSeek Harness — browse, arrange, branch, merge, and summarize AI agent sessions on an interactive canvas.
description.zh: Visual session graph for DeepSeek Harness — browse, arrange, branch, merge, and summarize AI agent sessions on an interactive canvas.

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: Mermaid 可视化编辑器 · DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 浏览器插件：右侧可关闭面板，画布与 Mermaid 代码双向同步，AI 工具通道自动导入（flowchart / sequenceDiagram / classDiagram / erDiagram）
description.zh: Mermaid 可视化编辑器 · DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 浏览器插件：右侧可关闭面板，画布与 Mermaid 代码双向同步，AI 工具通道自动导入（flowchart / sequenceDiagram / classDiagram / erDiagram）

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 更新中心与插件市场：自托管 plugins.json 注册表（GitHub dsh-plugin 主题自动聚合 + npm 包名映射秒级安装），一键安装/更新/卸载/禁用插件与更新 dsh 本体。Update center & plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 更新中心与插件市场：自托管 plugins.json 注册表（GitHub dsh-plugin 主题自动聚合 + npm 包名映射秒级安装），一键安装/更新/卸载/禁用插件与更新 dsh 本体。Update center & plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 图形化技能管理器——可通过 Web 设置界面创建、编辑、导入（ZIP 压缩包）和删除 SKILL.md 技能。支持全局安装及按工作区安装。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 图形化技能管理器——可通过 Web 设置界面创建、编辑、导入（ZIP 压缩包）和删除 SKILL.md 技能。支持全局安装及按工作区安装。

description.en: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 动态点阵鲸鱼壁纸：约 1,750 个呼吸的 WebGL2 粒子，指针液态涡流交互，明暗双主题，带 Canvas2D 回退。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
description.zh: 每轮对话开始向模型上下文注入单行时间戳读数（星期 / 日期 / 时间 / UTC 偏移 / IANA 时区），收尾再注入 Turn ended 关闭读数——模型始终知道现在几点、今天星期几、上一轮何时结束，日期运算与跨轮间隔不再靠猜；轻量时钟感知，每条约 30 token。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: DSH better-sidebar 侧边栏标签页:一键启动鸿蒙模拟器、构建并部署 HarmonyOS 应用到模拟器。
description.zh: DSH better-sidebar 侧边栏标签页:一键启动鸿蒙模拟器、构建并部署 HarmonyOS 应用到模拟器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delete sessions from the running Web runtime — live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts. Host half + web client half in one package.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delete sessions from the running Web runtime — live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts. Host half + web client half in one package.

description.en: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
description.zh: 让模型自主压缩自身上下文的 dsh 插件：mind_map 工具俯瞰模型自己的上下文表面（稳定 seq、角色、token 重量、清理边界标记，返回内附清理手册），clear_mind 工具把选定的对话历史区间替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 渲染可展开的压缩行），调用对自动折叠成单行墓碑，上下文过长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理；人类侧会话记录保持原样、可审计可回退。

description.en: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.
description.zh: 苹果风格智能体手机：双面板电话/短信、RCS 群聊（信任门禁）、跨设备智能体消息（registry 收件箱桥）、L0–L4 信任徽章与证据审计。实验性：信任摘要非安全保证，短信/信令经运营方收件箱中继（运营方可见）；E2E 加密为演进方向。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: Answers hard questions by staging a formal debate: two adversarial subagents argue opposite sides with research, then the main agent rules on the transcript through the debate_open, debate_round, and debate_verdict tools.
description.zh: 通过一场正式辩论来回答难题：两个对抗性子代理各自调研并论证对立立场，最后由主代理依据辩论记录作出裁决，提供 debate_open、debate_round、debate_verdict 三个工具。

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web GUI 通用（同一份插件，只是 profile 名不同）的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、语音识别可选本地 SenseVoice（复用官方「语音输入」插件已下载的模型，免装第二份模型）/ FunASR HTTP 或流式 / 云端兼容 API、MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS（含导演模式与音色克隆）/ OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness — strict evidence, health-checked failover, original pixels, and Token accounting.
description.zh: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness — strict evidence, health-checked failover, original pixels, and Token accounting.

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: RTS-style multi-agent orchestration board for DeepSeek Harness: issue plain-language strategic orders, a staff agent drafts acceptance-checked task orders, commander agents deploy typed subagent troops on isolated workspaces — with a 3D starfield campaign view, append-only event logs, and machine-checked verification.
description.zh: RTS-style multi-agent orchestration board for DeepSeek Harness: issue plain-language strategic orders, a staff agent drafts acceptance-checked task orders, commander agents deploy typed subagent troops on isolated workspaces — with a 3D starfield campaign view, append-only event logs, and machine-checked verification.

description.en: 告别繁琐的手动配置！本插件支持从 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、YAML 或网页中直接导入 MCP 配置。在写入前，它会自动帮你进行安全审查和风险提示，只需点一下确认，就能把第三方工具无缝接入 DSH，您可从「设置 → MCP 安装」中管理相应信息。
description.zh: 告别繁琐的手动配置！本插件支持从 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、YAML 或网页中直接导入 MCP 配置。在写入前，它会自动帮你进行安全审查和风险提示，只需点一下确认，就能把第三方工具无缝接入 DSH，您可从「设置 → MCP 安装」中管理相应信息。

description.en: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
description.zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Windows 默认 Shell 策略：探测 git-bash/MSYS2，配置面板一键切换 bash/pwsh，动态注册 bash 工具并裁剪提示词工具面 · DSH 组合插件。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Windows 默认 Shell 策略：探测 git-bash/MSYS2，配置面板一键切换 bash/pwsh，动态注册 bash 工具并裁剪提示词工具面 · DSH 组合插件。

description.en: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的对话式 GIS：支持本地文件与 PostGIS 查询、交互式地图与空间分析。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

description.en: 一只常驻 macOS 桌面、随 DeepSeek Harness 工作状态变化的蓝色大肥鲸桌宠
description.zh: 一只常驻 macOS 桌面、随 DeepSeek Harness 工作状态变化的蓝色大肥鲸桌宠

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。

description.en: 防止 Agent 自我修改把服务改崩的守护插件（dsh 插件）：绿色构建凭证绑定 git HEAD，改坏不许重启；watchdog 无感重启 + canary 自动回滚
description.zh: 防止 Agent 自我修改把服务改崩的守护插件（dsh 插件）：绿色构建凭证绑定 git HEAD，改坏不许重启；watchdog 无感重启 + canary 自动回滚

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite V3.7 原生 DeepSeek Harness 智能体预设与独立 Cordis 插件，提供深层推理路由、工作区状态外化账本（.jspace）与全模型解耦的认知工作空间
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite V3.7 原生 DeepSeek Harness 智能体预设与独立 Cordis 插件，提供深层推理路由、工作区状态外化账本（.jspace）与全模型解耦的认知工作空间

description.en: 模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel
description.zh: 模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel

description.en: Lifecycle notification layer for AI coding agents — DeepSeek Harness plugin for turn, job, review & failure notifications
description.zh: Lifecycle notification layer for AI coding agents — DeepSeek Harness plugin for turn, job, review & failure notifications

description.en: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）里驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：会话 list / resume / fork / delete、按会话切换模型、一句话摘要预览、导入外部 ACP 会话，并可把 Obsidian 侧会话拉进 dsh 原生会话库。需 DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3。

description.en: Web search with Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish, per-session search connection and freshness preferences, and a chat-toolbar selector.
description.zh: 集成 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily 和 Tinyfish 的联网搜索，支持会话级搜索连接与实时性偏好，并提供聊天工具栏切换器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页搜索提供方插件：把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 及其原生 web_search 工具上。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页搜索提供方插件：把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 及其原生 web_search 工具上。

description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的全局安装树会被自动检测并从安装前快照修复。检查到新版本时弹窗确认是否立即更新，安装后自动重启宿主，遇到 registry 不可达时自动回退到镜像。

description.en: DSH updater + official docs sync in Settings: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with live progress (npm output stream, elapsed timer, monotonic bar), multi-copy protection that only touches the running instance, source-tree mode via git pull, one-click PowerShell 7 install on Windows, incremental sync of the official docs/ with progress, and the dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read model tools.
description.zh: 设置页内的 DSH 更新器 + 官方文档同步器：一键以 npm 全局更新 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并带实时进度（npm 输出流、已运行计时、单调进度条），多副本保护只更新当前运行实例，源码树模式走 git pull；Windows 缺 PowerShell 7 时可一键安装；官方 docs/ 增量同步（按 blob sha 跳过未变文件）带进度条，并提供 dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read 模型工具。

description.en: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 开发者工具面板：文件浏览/预览/编辑与路径式文件提及、多终端（快捷命令）、Git 面板（提交/推送/拉取/分支）与后台任务管理。UI 移植自 pi-web-ui。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API peak/off-peak status, a countdown to the next switch and a mini timeline next to the DSH desktop avatar, with a 24-hour Beijing-time timeline on click; holiday calendars update automatically from holiday-cn, and an optional reminder fires 5 minutes before each peak period.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端头像旁显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段、切换倒计时与迷你时间轴，点击查看北京时间 24 小时时间轴；节假日日历从 holiday-cn 自动更新，可选在峰时段开始前 5 分钟提醒。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.
description.zh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Native side-by-side chat beside the main conversation: an independent DSH session with native UI, on-demand parent-context retrieval, selection quoting, and a keep-or-delete lifecycle.
description.zh: 在主对话旁边打开原生并排侧聊：独立的真实 DSH 会话、原生界面、按需读取父会话上下文、选文引用与保留或删除的生命周期。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Aggregate and natively control multiple remote DeepSeek Harness (DSH) servers' sessions from one official Web UI — hub gateway + official-UI bridge. 多服务器 DSH 会话聚合与原生操控
description.zh: Aggregate and natively control multiple remote DeepSeek Harness (DSH) servers' sessions from one official Web UI — hub gateway + official-UI bridge. 多服务器 DSH 会话聚合与原生操控

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级全文检索浏览器：FTS5 trigram 索引按消息检索（用户/助手/系统注入/工具四类，可按类型筛选），fork/续接会话结果自动去重，只读上下文预览自动滚动定位焦点消息，一键跳转真实会话；支持增量/全量重建索引与健康检查；界面中英双语跟随 Host locale 服务。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars.
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: Prompt-level wiki skill suite (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, save) for dsh — pairs with dsh-plugin-wiki-tools.
description.zh: Prompt-level wiki skill suite (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, save) for dsh — pairs with dsh-plugin-wiki-tools.

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Security audit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static permission profile with file/line evidence + a runtime sentinel gating credential access and unknown-host egress · DSH 插件安全审计：静态权限画像（附文件/行号证据）+ 运行时哨兵，触及凭证或向未知主机外发数据时先请你批准
description.zh: Security audit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static permission profile with file/line evidence + a runtime sentinel gating credential access and unknown-host egress · DSH 插件安全审计：静态权限画像（附文件/行号证据）+ 运行时哨兵，触及凭证或向未知主机外发数据时先请你批准

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): graceful restart + client auto-reconnect + cross-restart goal continuation.
description.zh: Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): graceful restart + client auto-reconnect + cross-restart goal continuation.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server

description.en: Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.
description.zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: DSH plugin: auto-fill metadata (context window, output cap, display name, input modalities) for custom-provider models from the Model Metadata Registry (models.dev)
description.zh: DSH plugin: auto-fill metadata (context window, output cap, display name, input modalities) for custom-provider models from the Model Metadata Registry (models.dev)

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Per-session billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: token buckets, cache hit rate, and peak-aware cost in the session header + a price-table settings page
description.zh: Per-session billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: token buckets, cache hit rate, and peak-aware cost in the session header + a price-table settings page

description.en: A web Settings "Loop engine" switch that swaps the agent loop driving every dsh session among five engines — the built-in in-process loop plus hosted Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Kimi Code — with zero changes to the harness; each hosted engine keeps its thinking and tool calls in the durable session transcript, takes over commands, skills, and the agent preset, and runs sandboxed through the dsh subprocess seam.
description.zh: Web 设置页的「循环引擎」开关，在五套引擎间切换驱动每个 dsh 会话的 agent 循环——内置 in-process 加托管的 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、Kimi Code——无需改动 harness；每个托管引擎都把思考与工具调用写入持久会话记录，接管命令、技能与 agent 预设，并经 dsh 子进程接缝沙箱运行。

description.en: Claim-verification skill that checks design documents and plans against codebase facts, escalating behavioral claims to executable logic-primitive verification for state machines and data models, with before/after regression, domain constraints, and concurrency risk mining.
description.zh: 声称核查技能：将设计文档与计划中的每条声称对照代码库事实核验，行为类声称升级为状态机/数据模型逻辑原语验证，支持前后回归、领域约束与并发风险挖掘。

description.en: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。

description.en: Jev-judged context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: semantic tool-result pruning + deterministic receipt compaction
description.zh: Jev-judged context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: semantic tool-result pruning + deterministic receipt compaction

description.en: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
description.zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.
description.zh: coding 工作台：停靠式工作区面板、项目分组侧栏、可休眠/恢复的分栏编辑器 TAB 组、文件预览与 DIFF 查看，以 git worktree 并行开发与跨会话协作为地基。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
description.zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

description.en: dsh-plugin
description.zh: dsh-plugin

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.
description.zh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

description.en: AI驱动的分波分析自动化。
description.zh: AI驱动的分波分析自动化。

description.en: 在「设置 → 模型」的模型目录编辑器行内配置每个模型的图像支持与思考等级（reasoning efforts）
description.zh: 在「设置 → 模型」的模型目录编辑器行内配置每个模型的图像支持与思考等级（reasoning efforts）

description.en: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
description.zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

description.en: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.
description.zh: 把模型请求、web 抓取/搜索与衍生工具统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址——幂等内核（读操作不重组分发器）、头部一键开关、按 URL 路由诊断与 NTLM 认证提示。

description.en: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.
description.zh: 每次完成的 agent 回合后，一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用把一条建议的下一句 prompt 写入会话日志；Web 输入框将其渲染为幽灵占位文字，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: deepseek harness 插件 替换会话持久化引擎为 MySQL 数据库
description.zh: deepseek harness 插件 替换会话持久化引擎为 MySQL 数据库

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）流程图管理插件：浏览 Archify 业务流程图目录、按 Git 附注标签阅读历史版本、保存版本。A workflow-diagram manager plugin for DSH.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）流程图管理插件：浏览 Archify 业务流程图目录、按 Git 附注标签阅读历史版本、保存版本。A workflow-diagram manager plugin for DSH.

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
description.zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: DeepSeekHarness任务完成时进行消息推送提醒（微信+Windows通知）
description.zh: DeepSeekHarness任务完成时进行消息推送提醒（微信+Windows通知）

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.
description.zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、用量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: This is a plugin that allows deepseek harness own the ability of lx music.
description.zh: This is a plugin that allows deepseek harness own the ability of lx music.

description.en: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 人设与记忆插件：从聊天记录、小说、剧本或设定文档蒸馏角色；支持长期与临时记忆、风格学习、认可语料、人设切换纠偏、记忆星图和角色卡导入导出。任务侧仅保留轻量工作纪律，不再注入计划、台账或动态提醒。

description.en: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
description.zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: "Weniger" — less, but better: a Dieter Rams-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: "Weniger" — less, but better: a Dieter Rams-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI

description.en: Tavily web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Keyless or API-key modes with a configurable UI card; provider framework designed to be extended to more search APIs.
description.zh: Tavily web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Keyless or API-key modes with a configurable UI card; provider framework designed to be extended to more search APIs.

description.en: Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices), service status and platform key management; login via platform account or session cookie — credentials stay on the local host.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的类 Todoist 待办管理：项目/标签/优先级、中英双语自然语言快速添加、重复规则、统计仪表盘、导入导出、七个 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

description.en: 毕业论文全流程 DSH 插件
description.zh: 毕业论文全流程 DSH 插件

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: dsh 斗地主
description.zh: dsh 斗地主

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面电子宠物插件：跟随 agent 状态变换心情的内置/自定义/Codex 精灵图伙伴。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面电子宠物插件：跟随 agent 状态变换心情的内置/自定义/Codex 精灵图伙伴。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based system for building AI agents. Everything, from tools and models to the web UI, can be added or replaced as a plugin.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based system for building AI agents. Everything, from tools and models to the web UI, can be added or replaced as a plugin.

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: per-conversation notes, selective injection, project memory, semantic Vault search + automatic retrieval.
description.zh: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: per-conversation notes, selective injection, project memory, semantic Vault search + automatic retrieval.

description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: Browser plugin for DSH (浏览器): Codex-style native browser control in your signed-in Chrome, with smooth virtual-cursor feedback, semantic page reads, form filling, screenshots and handoff; setup from the Browser sidebar. Requires macOS + Google Chrome (Chrome 125+) and a one-time unpacked load of the bundled MV3 extension; Edge, Windows and complete Linux installation are experimental.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器插件（Browser）：以 Codex 浏览器操作为体验参考，直接使用已登录的 Chrome 浏览器，平滑虚拟鼠标，支持页面读取、填表、截图与控制交还；安装后从侧栏「浏览器」完成配置。需要 macOS + Google Chrome（125+），并一次性以解压加载方式安装随包的 MV3 扩展；Edge、Windows 与完整的 Linux 安装仍属实验。

description.en: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
description.zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

description.en: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.
description.zh: 把网页对话里的每次文件改动渲染成一张折叠的 diff 卡片并逐行高亮，涵盖 MCP filesystem 的 edit_file/write_file 与内置的 edit/write。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

description.en: Long-term project work-log system for AI agents (software, research, writing, design, ops): process journal + index ledger + lessons, with a stdlib-only Python toolbox.
description.zh: Long-term project work-log system for AI agents (software, research, writing, design, ops): process journal + index ledger + lessons, with a stdlib-only Python toolbox.

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: Global font DIY: change size, weight, colour and family at any place in the DSH interface, per element or for the whole window, then hide the floating ball when you are done. No CSS writing and no restart. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 全局字体 DIY：界面任意位置的字体大小、字重、颜色与字体族都能改，可逐个元素也可整体生效，调完把悬浮球隐藏即可。不用写 CSS、不用重启。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.
description.zh: 拖拽上传 PDF/Word/Excel/图片等文件:落盘为本地路径引用,对话里不塞 base64 大文本。

description.en: Durable dependency-graph task factory for DeepSeek Harness: recurring Agent work, safe checkout lanes, first-class queues, Triage, and artifacts.
description.zh: Durable dependency-graph task factory for DeepSeek Harness: recurring Agent work, safe checkout lanes, first-class queues, Triage, and artifacts.

description.en: DSH 右侧栏 Excel 编辑插件：支持 xlsx 预览/编辑、公式实时计算、合并单元格、格式设置并保存回原文件。
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Excel 编辑插件：支持 xlsx 预览/编辑、公式实时计算、合并单元格、格式设置并保存回原文件。

description.en: Edit any user turn in DeepSeek Harness and re-run it: an inline editor rolls the conversation back through the official surface-replace contract, then re-prompts the agent with the revised text. The append-only session log is never rewritten.
description.zh: Edit any user turn in DeepSeek Harness and re-run it: an inline editor rolls the conversation back through the official surface-replace contract, then re-prompts the agent with the revised text. The append-only session log is never rewritten.

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web（`dsh --profile web`）记录**每日 LLM 调用花费**，支持按会话 / 模型 / 天多维度查看。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web（`dsh --profile web`）记录**每日 LLM 调用花费**，支持按会话 / 模型 / 天多维度查看。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization
description.zh: Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization

description.en: Computer-use mode for DeepSeek Harness: screen capture, mouse and keyboard synthesis, and window control for operating GUI software that has no agent-facing integration.
description.zh: Computer-use mode for DeepSeek Harness: screen capture, mouse and keyboard synthesis, and window control for operating GUI software that has no agent-facing integration.

description.en: Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
description.zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

description.en: DSH 声音提醒插件:九类 Agent 事件(完成/子任务/后台任务/审批/提问/评审/受阻/打断/失败)独立铃声、音量与开关,浏览器合成音 + Windows 系统蜂鸣,工作区快捷静音
description.zh: DSH 声音提醒插件:九类 Agent 事件(完成/子任务/后台任务/审批/提问/评审/受阻/打断/失败)独立铃声、音量与开关,浏览器合成音 + Windows 系统蜂鸣,工作区快捷静音

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel inside the settings page, in-panel connection setup that is tested before saving, and drag-to-reschedule in the week view (15-minute snapping, undo). A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Import local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch config into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login for supported providers.
description.zh: 把本机的 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持的提供方可直接 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格暖调编辑 DSH Web 皮肤：象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙点睛、衬线标题+无衬线界面+等宽标签、发丝线与胶囊 CTA，亮暗双主题跟随系统。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Workbench
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Workbench

description.en: Correctness-oriented MCP server and batch CLI for compact structural reads and reviewed TypeScript/JavaScript edits.
description.zh: Correctness-oriented MCP server and batch CLI for compact structural reads and reviewed TypeScript/JavaScript edits.

description.en: Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.
description.zh: Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that does QA: an agent explores your app like a real user and leaves evidence, then the explored path is exported as a deterministic replay scenario you run every release. Orchestrates the browser, macOS desktop, iOS and Android drivers — never a false green.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin that does QA: an agent explores your app like a real user and leaves evidence, then the explored path is exported as a deterministic replay scenario you run every release. Orchestrates the browser, macOS desktop, iOS and Android drivers — never a false green.

description.en: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.
description.zh: 只读 DSH Web 插件，可在对话中检查和搜索 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud Collection，支持标量、BM25、稠密向量与混合查询。

description.en: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.
description.zh: 把思源笔记（SiYuan）接入 DeepSeek Harness：17 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具，覆盖笔记本与文档列表、全文检索、SQL 查询、读取文档与块、新建与追加内容、移动与重命名文档、日记与块属性，另提供一个 Web 设置页配置思源地址、API token 与逐工具开关。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：输入框模型名旁的小星星按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化的可执行提示词并写回
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：输入框模型名旁的小星星按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化的可执行提示词并写回

description.en: 基于dsh的token用量统计，DSH的Token用量统计功能
description.zh: 基于dsh的token用量统计，DSH的Token用量统计功能

description.en: DSH插件-模型余额显示功能
description.zh: DSH插件-模型余额显示功能

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: generate_ui — the model authors A2UI documents rendered as interactive surfaces in the chat (valuz genui)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: generate_ui — the model authors A2UI documents rendered as interactive surfaces in the chat (valuz genui)

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: Bridge your pi extension, codex plugin or claude code plugin to dsh (DeepSeek Harness)
description.zh: Bridge your pi extension, codex plugin or claude code plugin to dsh (DeepSeek Harness)

description.en: Fully-local image understanding & OCR via macOS Vision Framework: `ocr_image` (text, table layout + coordinates) and `view_image` (scene, faces, QR) — paste multiple images into the web input box or pass path/URL/base64; images never leave your Mac.
description.zh: 基于 macOS Vision Framework 的全本地识图插件：`ocr_image`（文字提取，表格结构+坐标）与 `view_image`（场景/人脸/二维码）；web 输入框可直接粘贴多张图片，图片永不离开你的 Mac。

description.en: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.
description.zh: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: DSH plugin for agent-driven span compaction: compress chosen conversation spans into self-written checkpoints instead of the official head-anchored full-context sweep.
description.zh: DSH plugin for agent-driven span compaction: compress chosen conversation spans into self-written checkpoints instead of the official head-anchored full-context sweep.

description.en: 模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占系统上下文 - Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.
description.zh: 模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占系统上下文 - Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: Gated multi-agent pipeline for OpenSpec changes — six opx_* tools drive the phase state machine, two agent presets (developer and reviewer) carry implementation and review, and 23 bundled skills define the quality standards they are checked against; full mode runs analyze, implement, then tool, task and dimension-based quality review, while simple mode runs implement and one merged quality review.
description.zh: 面向 OpenSpec 变更的按阶段门禁多 Agent 编排：6 个 opx_* 工具驱动阶段状态机，开发者与审核人两个 agent preset 分工实施与审查，23 份内置 skill 定义审查基准；完整流程为 analyze、实施、工具/任务/维度质量三层审查，精简流程为实施加一次合并质量审查。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Sanitizes leaked DeepSeek DSML closing tags from model text streams.
description.zh: 清理模型文本流中泄漏的 DeepSeek DSML 闭合标签。
