description.en: DeepSeek Harness 数据保险箱插件（dsh-vault）—— 自动备份、清空检测、一键恢复，保护聊天记录与工作区数据；可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 数据保险箱插件（dsh-vault）—— 自动备份、清空检测、一键恢复，保护聊天记录与工作区数据；可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

description.en: agentmemory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): full memory_* tools, capture hooks, and context injection over the local REST server
description.zh: agentmemory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): full memory_* tools, capture hooks, and context injection over the local REST server

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 dsh Web 界面背后：scene 壁纸在浏览器内实时渲染（three.js 播放器 + Rust/WASM CPU 粒子模拟），视频与 web 壁纸原样播放，其余回退 preview 图，不需要安装 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。壁纸库从 Steam 创意工坊目录（431960）自动探测或手动指定，设置面板可选壁纸、配壁纸库与引擎目录、调光晕与暂停/画质。

description.en: Per-session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness: Python / R / CLI slots from conda, standalone R, WSL, or custom paths, via /env, session_env, DSH_ENV_* facts, and a header dropdown.
description.zh: Per-session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness: Python / R / CLI slots from conda, standalone R, WSL, or custom paths, via /env, session_env, DSH_ENV_* facts, and a header dropdown.

description.en: DevEco CLI 将 DevEco Studio 工具链统一封装为一个 CLI，内置 ohpm、hvigor、hdc、emulator、hilog，同时集成 HarmonyOS 技能安装、项目脚手架、本地 HarmonyOS 文档检索和 MCP 服务。
description.zh: DevEco CLI 将 DevEco Studio 工具链统一封装为一个 CLI，内置 ohpm、hvigor、hdc、emulator、hilog，同时集成 HarmonyOS 技能安装、项目脚手架、本地 HarmonyOS 文档检索和 MCP 服务。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Agent plugin for major harnesses — DeepSeek Harness (DSH), OpenCode, Pi and Codex: define custom AI agent roles with per-role prompts, models, skills, permissions, memory and multi-agent orchestration.
description.zh: Agent plugin for major harnesses — DeepSeek Harness (DSH), OpenCode, Pi and Codex: define custom AI agent roles with per-role prompts, models, skills, permissions, memory and multi-agent orchestration.

description.en: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
description.zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
description.zh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

description.en: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.
description.zh: Gitee/GitHub AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支（如"需要修改 release-v1.2 分支"），它自动克隆仓库开发、向指定分支提交 PR，可自动合并并自动关闭 issue。v1.2 新增代码安全扫描：配置扫描仓库后按内置/自定义提示词审计代码，去重后把新发现提交 issue。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：纯 HTTPS 取源码与发行版，无需 git 二进制、不 clone。| DeepSeek Harness plugin: fetch source & releases over plain HTTPS, no git binary, no clone.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：纯 HTTPS 取源码与发行版，无需 git 二进制、不 clone。| DeepSeek Harness plugin: fetch source & releases over plain HTTPS, no git binary, no clone.

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让 agent 按需搜索播放。

description.en: deepseek harness 皮肤插件。支持选择本地目录下的图片作为背景设置
description.zh: deepseek harness 皮肤插件。支持选择本地目录下的图片作为背景设置

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness all-in-one: no model switching — regular DeepSeek auto-routes to vision & image gen. Multi-backend: Gemini + any OpenAI-compatible (GPT-4o, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, gpt-image, DALL-E, Flux, OpenRouter). gemini_vision/gemini_generate_image/gemini_optimize_image with vision self-check. Better than modlens.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness all-in-one: no model switching — regular DeepSeek auto-routes to vision & image gen. Multi-backend: Gemini + any OpenAI-compatible (GPT-4o, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, gpt-image, DALL-E, Flux, OpenRouter). gemini_vision/gemini_generate_image/gemini_optimize_image with vision self-check. Better than modlens.

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: ChatGPT-style right-edge turn navigation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web
description.zh: ChatGPT-style right-edge turn navigation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

description.en: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Markdown 用户与项目记忆：置顶偏好、关键词检索、软失效、历史归档，以及带预览、备份与回滚的 JSON 迁移。

description.en: Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，像 Skill 一样按需加载工具，减少模型上下文占用。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.en: Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: DeepSeek 峰谷时刻悬浮徽章 · dsh plugin：实时峰谷档位、下一阶段倒计时、本次会话 API 花费（含三段历史价格档）| A floating tide badge for DeepSeek Harness: live peak/off-peak phase, countdown and session cost.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷时刻悬浮徽章 · dsh plugin：实时峰谷档位、下一阶段倒计时、本次会话 API 花费（含三段历史价格档）| A floating tide badge for DeepSeek Harness: live peak/off-peak phase, countdown and session cost.

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的独立双面插件，用于把产品的原始需求澄清为研发和开发 AI 可直接理解的 Ready Spec。产品、研发、产品 AI 与研发 AI 在同一份 Git 版本化 Markdown 上完成初审、逐项回复、二次审核、候选 patch、产研共审、Decision、分角色确认与 Ready 质量门。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立双面插件，用于把产品的原始需求澄清为研发和开发 AI 可直接理解的 Ready Spec。产品、研发、产品 AI 与研发 AI 在同一份 Git 版本化 Markdown 上完成初审、逐项回复、二次审核、候选 patch、产研共审、Decision、分角色确认与 Ready 质量门。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply/health) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
description.zh: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply/health 五工具），Socket Mode 免公网回调。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自定义皮肤工作室，支持全界面配色、组件图片/视频背景与皮肤包分享
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自定义皮肤工作室，支持全界面配色、组件图片/视频背景与皮肤包分享

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

description.en: Local, verifiable delivery evidence reports and DSH plugin for coding-agent projects.
description.zh: Local, verifiable delivery evidence reports and DSH plugin for coding-agent projects.

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
description.zh: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：回复/提问/审批三类会话通知（系统原生 toast）+ 会话内梯子目录导航。DeepSeek Harness plugin: session notifications (reply/ask/approval) with native OS toasts + an in-conversation ladder outline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：回复/提问/审批三类会话通知（系统原生 toast）+ 会话内梯子目录导航。DeepSeek Harness plugin: session notifications (reply/ask/approval) with native OS toasts + an in-conversation ladder outline.

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: Cross-session usage and cost observatory for DSH — token trends from hourly lines to 90-day and 1-year heatmaps, per-model DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reconciled against the official balance, GLM/Kimi/MiniMax subscription-quota windows with burn-rate forecasts, cache-hit ring, project rankings, CSV export, and a dsh-tui terminal face.
description.zh: 跨会话用量与费用观测台——分时走势与 90 天/1 年热力图、逐模型峰谷计价并与官方余额对账、GLM/Kimi/MiniMax 订阅额度与燃速预估、缓存命中环、项目排行、CSV 导出，另有 dsh-tui 终端面。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Usage statistics: a usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a reference price list generated from opencode Zen and DeepSeek's published rates, with DeepSeek models billed by Beijing weekday peak/off-peak windows and Chinese public holidays; a pricing-match dialog to point an unmatched model at a reference model or type per-million rates by hand; reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: 用量统计：DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；参考价目由 opencode Zen 与 DeepSeek 官方定价生成，DeepSeek 型号按北京时间工作日高峰/空闲与法定节假日分档计价；未匹配的模型可在「定价匹配」里指定参考模型或手填单价；参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with auto-discovery, quota windows, reset times, color-coded status, dragging, and automatic refresh.
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.
description.zh: 四套配色的像素风 DSH Web 皮肤（木屋/羊皮纸/暖阳/终端绿）；中文像素字体由插件自身的 host 路由发货；完全平面、无阴影。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Peak/off-peak billing clock with live DeepSeek balance and per-turn cost above the dsh-tui prompt, plus an optional flashing peak-hour warning frame.
description.zh: Peak/off-peak billing clock with live DeepSeek balance and per-turn cost above the dsh-tui prompt, plus an optional flashing peak-hour warning frame.

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn research PDFs into a citable OKF markdown library, with full-text & semantic search, knowledge graph, and survey writing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn research PDFs into a citable OKF markdown library, with full-text & semantic search, knowledge graph, and survey writing.

description.en: DSH 宿主插件：给 AI 智能体增加读写 Word/Excel 的工具（docx/xlsx/xls/doc/rtf/odt，纯 JS 跨平台）｜ DSH host plugin: Word/Excel read & write tools for AI agents
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：给 AI 智能体增加读写 Word/Excel 的工具（docx/xlsx/xls/doc/rtf/odt，纯 JS 跨平台）｜ DSH host plugin: Word/Excel read & write tools for AI agents

description.en: Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes or your input is needed.
description.zh: Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes or your input is needed.

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: Multi-provider (11) quota & balance glass card for the DSH sidebar footer — local fork of dsh-musage with SiliconFlow/Tavily/ZenMux/MiMo/Claude support
description.zh: Multi-provider (11) quota & balance glass card for the DSH sidebar footer — local fork of dsh-musage with SiliconFlow/Tavily/ZenMux/MiMo/Claude support

description.en: 简洁、克制、安静，旨在为您的Vibe Coding增加些许文艺感。每次打开WebUI，左下角都会出现一句话，从古诗词到文采句，再到脍炙人口的游戏台词，应有尽有。语料库可高度自定义，插件风格完全适配原生Harness界面，功能简洁明确，绝不喧宾夺主。
description.zh: 简洁、克制、安静，旨在为您的Vibe Coding增加些许文艺感。每次打开WebUI，左下角都会出现一句话，从古诗词到文采句，再到脍炙人口的游戏台词，应有尽有。语料库可高度自定义，插件风格完全适配原生Harness界面，功能简洁明确，绝不喧宾夺主。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: Thinking levels, image input and image generation for third-party models in the official Models page; multiple keys per provider routed by model, automatic failover between keys on failure, per-route custom request headers, and balance display.
description.zh: 在官方「模型」页为第三方模型补上思考等级、图片输入与生图；一个供应商可配多把密钥，按模型分流、失败自动换密钥重试，并可配置按路由的请求头、查看余额。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多供应商真实账户余额显示
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多供应商真实账户余额显示

description.en: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的极简手机遥控器：手机页面上只有你发出的指令和 AI 最后的结论，工具调用、文件读写、子 Agent 调度与思考过程全部留在电脑上；可通过内网、Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道连接，每条路径各配二维码、链接和密码。

description.en: MCP Tools panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every MCP server & tool in your session, grouped by server, with JSON schemas, live search and last-used times from real session logs.
description.zh: MCP Tools panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every MCP server & tool in your session, grouped by server, with JSON schemas, live search and last-used times from real session logs.

description.en: Deepseek-Harness数学建模竞赛论文全自动撰写流水线插件。Deepseek-Harness fully automatic pipeline plugin for writing mathematical modeling competition papers.
description.zh: Deepseek-Harness数学建模竞赛论文全自动撰写流水线插件。Deepseek-Harness fully automatic pipeline plugin for writing mathematical modeling competition papers.

description.en: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
description.zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

description.en: Loom (织机) — external coach / second verifier for DeepSeek Harness: silently evolves your agent's tools, skills, config and model, with deterministic verification and cold-apply.
description.zh: Loom (织机) — external coach / second verifier for DeepSeek Harness: silently evolves your agent's tools, skills, config and model, with deterministic verification and cold-apply.

description.en: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.
description.zh: DSH 全本地向量记忆:本地 embedding、SQLite 存储、自动召回注入、去重与冲突检测、软删除回收站、在线备份,可选 LLM 提取。

description.en: 可以在 DSH 中使用 WorkBuddy 里面的模型
description.zh: 可以在 DSH 中使用 WorkBuddy 里面的模型

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 adds bounded, read-only evidence checks for observable shell/bash/pwsh and file-tool changes; uncertain evidence remains incomplete. [Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0).
description.zh: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 通过有界、只读检查点追踪 shell/bash/pwsh 与文件工具产生的可观察变更；证据归因不确定或不足时保留为 incomplete。[正式 Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0)。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.
description.zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的一个固定按钮，点一下就把 DSH 关掉并自动重开，全程没有控制台窗口；右键它还有内置自检，能生成一份自包含的诊断报告。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.

description.en: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 28 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止，支持自动刷新、搜索、Windows 到期提醒与 .ics 导出。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: ⚡ DSH 多机算力组网：把朋友间/局域网/云上 ECS 的闲置算力汇聚成分布式 AI 算力池，一台机调用整个团队的算力。一个人掌控多台 Harness 并行开发研究。
description.zh: ⚡ DSH 多机算力组网：把朋友间/局域网/云上 ECS 的闲置算力汇聚成分布式 AI 算力池，一台机调用整个团队的算力。一个人掌控多台 Harness 并行开发研究。

description.en: Fabric-style deterministic compaction, checked code execution, durable coordination, and live topology for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Fabric-style deterministic compaction, checked code execution, durable coordination, and live topology for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.
description.zh: GNU Emacs 与正在运行的 DSH 会话之间的双向桥：走本机回环 HTTP + SSE，可在 Emacs 里提交提示、流式收回复、管理会话与工作区、回答 ask-user / 审批提示；插件页还有一张卡片用来安装 Emacs 那边的包。

description.en: A tiny glass companion for DeepSeek Harness — it breathes while the agent thinks, pulses while it works, and politely checks with you before touching anything.  🍎 Liquid Glass looks · 🌱 zero extra dependencies · 👀 always knows what your agent is up to；给 DeepSeek Harness 的一只小玻璃伙伴——Agent 思考时它轻轻呼吸，干活时它微微脉动，要动你的东西之前，它还会先礼貌地问你一声。
description.zh: A tiny glass companion for DeepSeek Harness — it breathes while the agent thinks, pulses while it works, and politely checks with you before touching anything.  🍎 Liquid Glass looks · 🌱 zero extra dependencies · 👀 always knows what your agent is up to；给 DeepSeek Harness 的一只小玻璃伙伴——Agent 思考时它轻轻呼吸，干活时它微微脉动，要动你的东西之前，它还会先礼貌地问你一声。

description.en: Map dsh (DeepSeek Harness) workspaces onto a Discord category — query session trajectories and live subagents, and drive an agent, from anywhere with no inbound port.
description.zh: Map dsh (DeepSeek Harness) workspaces onto a Discord category — query session trajectories and live subagents, and drive an agent, from anywhere with no inbound port.

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消息级删除插件，用于避免用户误发或错误的助手消息污染会话上下文。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息级删除插件，用于避免用户误发或错误的助手消息污染会话上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek usage monitor as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: balance / day-month-all-time token & cost panel in the chat UI with drag-reorder config, plus an optional local usage proxy
description.zh: DeepSeek usage monitor as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: balance / day-month-all-time token & cost panel in the chat UI with drag-reorder config, plus an optional local usage proxy

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: Symphony-inspired multi-provider task orchestrator and native operations dashboard for DeepSeek Harness. Supports Linear, GitHub, Jira, Asana, GitLab, and local tasks. 受 Symphony 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 多任务源编排与原生运维仪表盘，支持 Linear、GitHub、Jira、Asana、GitLab 及本地任务。
description.zh: Symphony-inspired multi-provider task orchestrator and native operations dashboard for DeepSeek Harness. Supports Linear, GitHub, Jira, Asana, GitLab, and local tasks. 受 Symphony 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 多任务源编排与原生运维仪表盘，支持 Linear、GitHub、Jira、Asana、GitLab 及本地任务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh web）额度插件：跟随当前模型显示官方余额或 OpenCode Go 订阅用量，支持本会话估算、跨会话累计消耗与可视化设置。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh web）额度插件：跟随当前模型显示官方余额或 OpenCode Go 订阅用量，支持本会话估算、跨会话累计消耗与可视化设置。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
description.zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

description.en: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.
description.zh: 对话大纲目录导航：支持书签标记、轮次置顶钉住、全局快捷键与智能标题提取。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: Persistent identity layer for DeepSeek Harness. The first reference implementation of AI Soul.
description.zh: Persistent identity layer for DeepSeek Harness. The first reference implementation of AI Soul.

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

description.en: Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings.
description.zh: 同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置。

description.en: 面向 AI Agent 的 Markdown 转 Word 工具：中文排版、Mermaid 图表、可编辑数学公式，提供 Skill、独立 CLI 和 DSH 插件。
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Markdown 转 Word 工具：中文排版、Mermaid 图表、可编辑数学公式，提供 Skill、独立 CLI 和 DSH 插件。

description.en: An architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering.
description.zh: An architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering.

description.en: AiFP 记忆感知系统｜MCP 服务，一套记忆全 AI 共享。面向中文的 Agent 感知记忆，支持叙事链、语义纠错、感知链图扩散。兼容 DeepSeek‑Harness、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等全部 MCP 客户端，数据完全本地存储。
description.zh: AiFP 记忆感知系统｜MCP 服务，一套记忆全 AI 共享。面向中文的 Agent 感知记忆，支持叙事链、语义纠错、感知链图扩散。兼容 DeepSeek‑Harness、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等全部 MCP 客户端，数据完全本地存储。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: DSH Web UI enhancement plugin: turn-by-turn conversation navigation & thinking-chain default-expand DSH Web UI 增强插件:逐轮对话导航、思维链默认展开
description.zh: DSH Web UI enhancement plugin: turn-by-turn conversation navigation & thinking-chain default-expand DSH Web UI 增强插件:逐轮对话导航、思维链默认展开

description.en: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的完整 Git 管理插件：分支切换/fetch/pull/commit/push，可折叠悬浮面板 + 输入框胶囊
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的完整 Git 管理插件：分支切换/fetch/pull/commit/push，可折叠悬浮面板 + 输入框胶囊

description.en: dsh-cc-studio · CCv3 角色卡工坊 从一句话点子到可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 chara_card_v3。专治「只有点子，世界观薄弱」。
description.zh: dsh-cc-studio · CCv3 角色卡工坊 从一句话点子到可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 chara_card_v3。专治「只有点子，世界观薄弱」。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

description.en: Cloudflare Code Mode MCP global bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — mcp__cloudflare__* tools + cfbridge skill + wrangler passthrough
description.zh: Cloudflare Code Mode MCP global bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — mcp__cloudflare__* tools + cfbridge skill + wrangler passthrough

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web 用量与计费插件：官方余额、Token 用量、贡献热图与按小时计费统计。Balance, token usage, contribution heatmap & per-hour cost stats for dsh web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness web 用量与计费插件：官方余额、Token 用量、贡献热图与按小时计费统计。Balance, token usage, contribution heatmap & per-hour cost stats for dsh web.

description.en: 🐟 Salted Fish Pet — a Cordis-based web-client UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Injects a draggable, feedable salted fish mascot + full-viewport engineer wallpaper into the shell.overlay slot. Pure front-end (React + CSS Modules), zero server-side.
description.zh: 🐟 Salted Fish Pet — a Cordis-based web-client UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Injects a draggable, feedable salted fish mascot + full-viewport engineer wallpaper into the shell.overlay slot. Pure front-end (React + CSS Modules), zero server-side.

description.en: 为DeepSeekHarness开发的会话级插件管理面板。在任何时候添加移除你的插件，热插拔生效，会话隔离，便捷的可视化面板。同时管理插件，skills，mcp | A session-level plugin management panel developed for DeepSeekHarness. Add or remove your plugins at any time with hot-swapping support, session isolation, and a convenient visual interface.
description.zh: 为DeepSeekHarness开发的会话级插件管理面板。在任何时候添加移除你的插件，热插拔生效，会话隔离，便捷的可视化面板。同时管理插件，skills，mcp | A session-level plugin management panel developed for DeepSeekHarness. Add or remove your plugins at any time with hot-swapping support, session isolation, and a convenient visual interface.

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) usage statistics dashboard plugin: token / cost / duration / session aggregation with trend, heatmap and calendar views.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) usage statistics dashboard plugin: token / cost / duration / session aggregation with trend, heatmap and calendar views.

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: mcp apps support plugin for dsh (DeepSeek Harness)
description.zh: mcp apps support plugin for dsh (DeepSeek Harness)

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Give DeepSeek (text-only) models **vision** in Claude Code and Codex by routing image files to any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, …). Zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.
description.zh: Give DeepSeek (text-only) models **vision** in Claude Code and Codex by routing image files to any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, …). Zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.

description.en: Lexmount Browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: Lexmount Browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
description.zh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

description.en: Branch chip in the composer tool row that switches, creates, and refreshes workspace branches, commits a checked subset of changed files with a message the session's own model writes from the diff, and pushes the current branch.
description.zh: 位于 composer 工具栏的分支标记：切换、新建、刷新工作区分支；提交时可勾选部分改动文件，提交信息由当前 Session 的模型根据 diff 生成；并可推送当前分支。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: Kabutack 是一个面向 DSH 的插件，用于在一个界面里统一管理插件、Skill 和 MCP，并支持按“角色”一键动态装载、切换与恢复能力组合。
description.zh: Kabutack 是一个面向 DSH 的插件，用于在一个界面里统一管理插件、Skill 和 MCP，并支持按“角色”一键动态装载、切换与恢复能力组合。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 的任务看板插件：侧边栏入口 + 五列看板，任务经 DSH 会话真实执行，host 端持久化并跨设备实时同步。Task board plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的任务看板插件：侧边栏入口 + 五列看板，任务经 DSH 会话真实执行，host 端持久化并跨设备实时同步。Task board plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage recorder plugin: per-model hourly token usage (input/output/cache hits) with a stacked bar chart dashboard in the Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness usage recorder plugin: per-model hourly token usage (input/output/cache hits) with a stacked bar chart dashboard in the Web GUI.

description.en: Declarative deny-by-default tool policy plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Declarative deny-by-default tool policy plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: 这是一个用来存放个人搭建的MCP服务的仓库
description.zh: 这是一个用来存放个人搭建的MCP服务的仓库

description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。

description.en: A Git GUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: A Git GUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: 小白+AI开发，for小白的dsh小插件，解释AI吐出的“黑话”
description.zh: 小白+AI开发，for小白的dsh小插件，解释AI吐出的“黑话”

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: DSH 插件：对话区左缘轮次图标列，点击定位到每轮用户输入文本。A DSH plugin: left-edge turn rail, click to locate each turn's user message.
description.zh: DSH 插件：对话区左缘轮次图标列，点击定位到每轮用户输入文本。A DSH plugin: left-edge turn rail, click to locate each turn's user message.

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

description.en: Project documentation scaffolding skill: question-driven setup of project standards, AI-collaboration workflows, and memory discipline across DSH, Reasonix, Claude Code, and Codex.
description.zh: 项目文档体系初始化 skill：提问驱动落实文档规范、固化 AI 协作工作流，跨 DSH / Reasonix / Claude Code / Codex 可用。

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

description.en: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 git worktree —— 让并行工作各自隔离在自己的目录与分支里。自带快速模式（Fast mode）。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与 DSH。用户新建的所有终端支持与AI可视化协作。

description.en: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
description.zh: 停靠在对话旁的会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑/预览、选区 AI 改写、Diff 审核、撤销与草稿恢复。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud Workbench CLI plugin — lets DeepSeek Harness's Agent directly control remote ECS instances.
description.zh: Alibaba Cloud Workbench CLI plugin — lets DeepSeek Harness's Agent directly control remote ECS instances.

description.en: Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.
description.zh: Windows 极简模式 preset：单句 persona、三工具、无运行时上下文。

description.en: A client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds chat content width tiers with a floating picker button (bottom-right, above the composer): 标准 / 中等 / 宽 / 超宽 / 全宽 (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full).
description.zh: A client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds chat content width tiers with a floating picker button (bottom-right, above the composer): 标准 / 中等 / 宽 / 超宽 / 全宽 (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full).

description.en: Grounded web search for DeepSeek Harness on any OpenRouter-compatible gateway: the built-in web_search tool runs on the same endpoint and key as your chat models.
description.zh: Grounded web search for DeepSeek Harness on any OpenRouter-compatible gateway: the built-in web_search tool runs on the same endpoint and key as your chat models.

description.en: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）网络搜索提供方——把 web_search 的后端切换为独立的豆包搜索 API，密钥与计费独立（每月 500 次免费），并内置专用设置卡片，经凭据服务保存密钥。

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻），谷时省钱时段一目了然；今日消耗独立计费；设置面板提供 10 套沉稳配色预置与谷/峰色自定义、详细/极简样式与各项读数开关；全中文界面。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏版本芯片，显示当前运行版本、npm latest/next/alpha 通道、兼容性标识，以及仅复制的升级命令。

description.en: Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop（EAC）桌面壳的统一插件市场：聚合精选目录、GitHub dsh-plugin 生态与 npm registry 三源，提供来源白名单、冲突预检、试装安装验证、手动/批量/自动三档更新与功能包（.dshpack）管理。

description.en: Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.
description.zh: DSH 会话的树形视图：编辑一条旧消息即从那一刻分叉，所有版本住进同一棵树、侧栏始终只有一条，分支可以改名，也可以把某个分支提升为独立会话。

description.en: Tower plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-agent missions, worktree isolation, review-gated merges, human-owned Tower mode. Inspired by Kimi Code's Tower mode.
description.zh: Tower plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-agent missions, worktree isolation, review-gated merges, human-owned Tower mode. Inspired by Kimi Code's Tower mode.

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通用 LSP 工具面，提供语言服务器诊断、格式化、重命名、代码动作与符号导航。

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request; shapes every tool result through a deterministic output ladder that archives the original first (retrieve_spill reads it back); prices tool groups in tokens and can hide built-in groups per agent. Bridges to a standard-library Python router, so Python 3.9+ is required.
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按 agent 隐藏内置分组。桥接到纯标准库的 Python 路由器，需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 ast-grep 的语法级 AST 代码结构检索与大纲提取工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — tokensforce gateway integration: one-login onboarding, provider groups, and a usage dashboard tab
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — tokensforce gateway integration: one-login onboarding, provider groups, and a usage dashboard tab

description.en: DSH 插件：tokensave 语义图 cli 直连——自动索引 + 更新检测，让 AI 用语义查询代替暴力 grep/读文件，大幅省 token
description.zh: DSH 插件：tokensave 语义图 cli 直连——自动索引 + 更新检测，让 AI 用语义查询代替暴力 grep/读文件，大幅省 token

description.en: DeepSeek Harness模型定价插件 · 配置token价格并显示会话费用 | Token pricing plugin for DeepSeek Harness — per-model token rates with a live conversation cost readout
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness模型定价插件 · 配置token价格并显示会话费用 | Token pricing plugin for DeepSeek Harness — per-model token rates with a live conversation cost readout

description.en: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.
description.zh: 带血缘的决策与目标记忆：显式命令与模型工具确定性记录决策，状态卡跨压缩重锚定，无损事件流 + BM25 分词检索兜底，场景级保真回归集作发布门禁。

description.en: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI appearance kit: 32 preset themes, animated/static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone text depth, and a keyboard desktop pet.
description.zh: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI appearance kit: 32 preset themes, animated/static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone text depth, and a keyboard desktop pet.

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip naming the model and reasoning effort each Session runs on, a subagent dropdown marking which child carries its own route, and sidebar hover cards showing what each conversation did.
description.zh: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip naming the model and reasoning effort each Session runs on, a subagent dropdown marking which child carries its own route, and sidebar hover cards showing what each conversation did.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 子代理模型路由插件：subagent_model 工具 + model:"auto" 路由策略（任务档位/失败升级/可审计），子代理不再继承父模型。Model-routed subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 子代理模型路由插件：subagent_model 工具 + model:"auto" 路由策略（任务档位/失败升级/可审计），子代理不再继承父模型。Model-routed subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness web app
description.zh: Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness web app

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Import, validate, manage, and migrate Agent Skills for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents.
description.zh: Import, validate, manage, and migrate Agent Skills for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents.

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (dsh) models: built-in free/cheap VLM presets + multi-image batch analysis
description.zh: Plug-in vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (dsh) models: built-in free/cheap VLM presets + multi-image batch analysis

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: dsh plugin for scnet.cn
description.zh: dsh plugin for scnet.cn
