description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

description.en: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Multi-model roundtable debates for DeepSeek Harness — shared context, six-dimension AI judge, real cost ledger, Markdown/docx battle reports.
description.zh: Multi-model roundtable debates for DeepSeek Harness — shared context, six-dimension AI judge, real cost ledger, Markdown/docx battle reports.

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 peon-ping 声音通知 —— 忠实移植自 pi 插件 pi-peon-ping-win。当任务完成或异常终止时发出提示音。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 peon-ping 声音通知 —— 忠实移植自 pi 插件 pi-peon-ping-win。当任务完成或异常终止时发出提示音。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — /refine command + settings panel for the dsh-continual-harness self-refinement engine. npm: dsh-refine
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — /refine command + settings panel for the dsh-continual-harness self-refinement engine. npm: dsh-refine

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: DSV4.1 reasoning support for DeepSeek Harness: lean analysis, images and attachments, and bounded acceptance/repair loops that aim to retain minimal-mode reasoning in a full agent.
description.zh: DSV4.1 reasoning support for DeepSeek Harness: lean analysis, images and attachments, and bounded acceptance/repair loops that aim to retain minimal-mode reasoning in a full agent.

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

description.en: Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时灾害预警：日本地震（P2PQuake）与 JMA 紧急地震速报、海啸、气象电文，全球地震（EMSC/USGS）与 NOAA 海啸，中国大陆地震（CENC via Wolfx）及 nmc.cn 暴雨、地质灾害预警，美国 NWS 与加拿大 ECCC 的洪水、降雨、风暴潮预警——按你关注的地域与阈值匹配播报。

description.en: DSH web plugin: a sidebar-footer QR-code button that lets a phone scan and re-issue the current browser's authenticated launch URL.
description.zh: DSH web plugin: a sidebar-footer QR-code button that lets a phone scan and re-issue the current browser's authenticated launch URL.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks agent edits that weaken tests, such as .skip, deleted or watered-down assertions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks agent edits that weaken tests, such as .skip, deleted or watered-down assertions.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells them how to regenerate instead.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells them how to regenerate instead.

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; Tab accepts it, ↓ generates the next suggestion, ↑ returns to the previous one, and Esc dismisses it. Each assistant reply triggers an extra call to the session's model, carrying the most recent user and assistant text.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 采纳、↓ 生成下一条、↑ 回到上一条、Esc 忽略。每次助手回复后会额外调用一次会话所用的模型，带上最近的用户与助手文本。

description.en: Project board, task schedule (gantt) and project memory: sessions opened from a card auto-load the latest project STATE; persisting progress without losing facts needs python3 and is unavailable on Windows.
description.zh: 项目看板 + 任务日程（甘特图）+ 项目记忆：从卡片打开的会话自动带上项目最新记忆；一句话落盘不丢事实需要 python3，Windows 上不可用。

description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

description.en: Security gate for DeepSeek Harness plugins: npm advisory audit, static evidence, a call-time Allow once / Allow / Disable prompt, plugin-manager sync, and agent review.
description.zh: Security gate for DeepSeek Harness plugins: npm advisory audit, static evidence, a call-time Allow once / Allow / Disable prompt, plugin-manager sync, and agent review.

description.en: Deepseek harness plugin for reloading your deepseek harness plugin (e.g. mcp-client)
description.zh: Deepseek harness plugin for reloading your deepseek harness plugin (e.g. mcp-client)

description.en: DSH插件，以Observational Memory方式管理上下文
description.zh: DSH插件，以Observational Memory方式管理上下文

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Herdr control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): observe and drive Herdr — a terminal workspace manager for AI coding agents — from DSH sessions
description.zh: Herdr control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): observe and drive Herdr — a terminal workspace manager for AI coding agents — from DSH sessions

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.
description.zh: 插件中心：在设置页发现、安装与管理 DSH 插件。

description.en: deepseek harness background-image plugin, built by DS and GPT
description.zh: deepseek harness background-image plugin, built by DS and GPT

description.en: dsh Web UI 动态背景：WebGL2 流体 + 字符鲸鱼游动(循环接缝赛博朋克故障转场) + 发光鱼群 + 点线网格
description.zh: dsh Web UI 动态背景：WebGL2 流体 + 字符鲸鱼游动(循环接缝赛博朋克故障转场) + 发光鱼群 + 点线网格

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 状态灯插件：角色表情状态灯 + 聊天框气泡，完成任务/出错/提问时自动弹出（dsh-plugin）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 状态灯插件：角色表情状态灯 + 聊天框气泡，完成任务/出错/提问时自动弹出（dsh-plugin）

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.
description.zh: 零凭据 Outlook 自动化：13 个工具通过 COM 直接驱动本地桌面 Outlook 客户端——搜信/读信/草稿/回复转发/日历/通讯录/会议室/忙闲查询——外加侧边栏新邮件角标。无需 Graph API 注册、无需 SMTP 密码；任何外发动作都过三层人工审批门。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 原生全功能终端交互界面 · Claude Code-styled Terminal TUI & CLI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 原生全功能终端交互界面 · Claude Code-styled Terminal TUI & CLI for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: a ticket tool for agent
description.zh: a ticket tool for agent

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait — each with its own sound and popup text (up to three named templates per situation), three delivery modes, previews, and imported custom sounds. Clicking a toast raises the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，每个情况可单独选择音效与弹窗文本（每个情况最多 3 套命名模板），支持三种通知形式、预览效果与导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.
description.zh: 桌面与 webhook 通知：任务完成、出错或等待审批时提醒；零依赖，走系统自带的 osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast，并支持 Slack 兼容的 webhook，可配置最短回合时长。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Cross-platform DSH WebUI multimedia input and workspace attachments
description.zh: Cross-platform DSH WebUI multimedia input and workspace attachments

description.zh: WeChat Mini Program automated testing for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — selector-addressed actions, build-freshness gates, geometry-first assertions for text-only models, real screenshots on vision routes · 微信小程序自动化测试 dsh 插件

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上用真实引擎验证。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness client plugin: mic dictation button next to the Full access control

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
description.zh: 用户治理的跨会话记忆空间，提供独立的来源与使用关系、来源追踪、版本管理和发送前注入检查。

description.en: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
description.zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

description.en: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
description.zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

description.en: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.
description.zh: 双账本跨会话记忆：自动把对话中的长期事实提取进 MEMORY.md，并维护项目进度账本 PROGRESS.md，每个新会话自动召回两本账。

description.en: Competition math (IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME) solved with a pure-reasoning pass, an adversarial verifier in a fresh subagent context, and calibrated confidence output (high / medium / honest "no confident solution"); optional LaTeX-to-PDF rendering.
description.zh: 竞赛数学解题（IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME）：纯推理求解 + 新鲜上下文 subagent 对抗验证 + 校准信心输出（high / medium / 诚实「无把握解」）；可选 LaTeX 编译 PDF。

description.zh: openai models for login by chatgpt

description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.zh: 解析增值税电子发票 PDF（XML 附件优先、文本层正则兜底）为结构化 JSON + 金额勾稽校验，多张汇总生成报销单（Markdown / xlsx）。

description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.zh: 面向 DSH 的来源感知提示词注入防护：跟踪 Turn 中的不可信上下文，检测注入信号，评估敏感 Sink，并通过可解释审计日志阻断高风险工具调用。

description.zh: Multimodal plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): understand images and generate images via configurable OpenAI-compatible or DashScope endpoints.

description.en: Automatically retrieves time-of-use pricing data (with Beijing Time) and notifies users during peak periods to reduce costs.
description.zh: 自动获取分时电价数据（按北京时间），在高峰时段提醒用户，以降低用电成本。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: Git status pill in the session header — branch, dirty counts, ahead/behind, recent commits & changed files.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话审查标签页：工作区相对 HEAD 或任意两 ref 的变更，以可过滤文件树加双列差异呈现；泳道提交图带逐行追溯与单文件历史；三范围搜索；行内评论回写对话输入框；暂存、提交、分支、标签、贮藏与冲突操作全部设防。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 飞书通知插件：在需要用户操作或对话结束时发送飞书机器人提醒，并支持持久化配置。

description.zh: One-click Git commit plugin for DSH: the session model splits workspace changes into reviewed Conventional Commits batches, with built-in sensitive-file filtering.

description.en: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
description.zh: 同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次）时截停本次生成，已生成内容照常提交；截停后弹出通知，显示所属工作区、会话名称与重复的字符串。重复次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定，代码区域（围栏 / 行内 / 缩进）使用放宽的阈值。

description.zh: DSH 蒸馏主管：把一本书蒸馏成可执行 Agent 技能的判态制元技能（三闸判态·零🔴门禁）｜V4.9.3 发行自足：§21 强制门禁 gate_start/gate_stage/gate_checklist 与整套门禁套件（27 件）随包发行，发版闸 A/B/C/D/D-配套/E/F 六判据

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态（status.deepseek.com）| Live DeepSeek official service status in the DSH sidebar
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态（status.deepseek.com）| Live DeepSeek official service status in the DSH sidebar

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: DSH自定义主题：可自行修改背景图片，主题色，表情包与文案。基于[dsh-vesna-theme](https://github.com/Mahiru0427/dsh-vesna-theme)
description.zh: DSH自定义主题：可自行修改背景图片，主题色，表情包与文案。基于[dsh-vesna-theme](https://github.com/Mahiru0427/dsh-vesna-theme)

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: dsh-codex-approval插件：仿照Codex的AI自动审批，规则+AI三级风险评估自动放行/拒绝，让dsh沙箱审批自动化
description.zh: dsh-codex-approval插件：仿照Codex的AI自动审批，规则+AI三级风险评估自动放行/拒绝，让dsh沙箱审批自动化

description.en: A plugin for Deepseek Harness (well it may support other AI agent IDEs but I hadn't test it out yet) that checks for error when AI had finished writing the code.
description.zh: A plugin for Deepseek Harness (well it may support other AI agent IDEs but I hadn't test it out yet) that checks for error when AI had finished writing the code.

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
description.zh: 把推理强度下拉菜单换成可拖拽吸附的滑块，并提供 13 款 Canvas 动效，分属推进、流体、幻境、科技、质感五个家族；动效随推理档位分三阶递进解锁。客制动效可自由组合 10 种粒子形态与 8 种流动轨迹；9 款预设主题色与 Hex 拾色器让全部动效跟随变色，档位吸附音效支持两段语音、合成鸭子叫、机械微触感与本地音频文件。

description.en: WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness: QR-code login, two-way text, image and file messaging, slash commands in WeChat including /cwd and /skills, approval and question cards answered from the chat, and reply sending that splits over-long answers and backs off on rate limits instead of dropping them. Only the account that scanned the login is admitted by default; messages from anyone else are ignored.
description.zh: 把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的通道插件：扫码登录，双向收发文本、图片与文件，微信内可用 /cwd、/skills 等命令，审批卡与提问卡在聊天里回答；回复侧会切分超长正文、对限流退避重试，而不是直接丢弃。默认只放行扫码登录的那个微信号，其他人发来的消息一律忽略。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: Cat-themed DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin with three original themes and a calm interactive companion. Not an official DeepSeek product.
description.zh: Cat-themed DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin with three original themes and a calm interactive companion. Not an official DeepSeek product.

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that refuses edits where // ... existing code ... placeholders would delete real code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin that refuses edits where // ... existing code ... placeholders would delete real code.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from running shell commands that wait for input or never exit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from running shell commands that wait for input or never exit.

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Overleaf tab for DSH better-sidebar: direct-CDP login, project mirrors under <workspace>/overleaf/, git/API sync, sidebar file preview
description.zh: Overleaf tab for DSH better-sidebar: direct-CDP login, project mirrors under <workspace>/overleaf/, git/API sync, sidebar file preview

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: dsh-awake · 守夜人：在 agent 任务执行期间阻止操作系统休眠
description.zh: dsh-awake · 守夜人：在 agent 任务执行期间阻止操作系统休眠

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your session picks up where it left off, with a dead-loop guard that hands back control if the retry produces nothing.
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.
description.zh: 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续/交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。

description.en: dsh 提醒插件：别错过需要你的时刻
description.zh: dsh 提醒插件：别错过需要你的时刻

description.en: Apify plugin for the DeepSeek harness
description.zh: Apify plugin for the DeepSeek harness

description.en: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
description.zh: 读取每个第三方端点自己的模型列表，同步 llm-pi-ai 的逐模型 reasoningEfforts，让输入框提供模型真实支持的思考等级。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.
description.zh: 按工作区路径或会话 ID 分发 system prompt 人设（完全一致 / 前缀 / 包含 / 正则），可指定一条默认人设兜底；会话页有「人设」页签，能看到实际发出去的提示词；人设列表可导入导出；另有一个开关拒绝工具写入人设存储。

description.en: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你输入/批准时弹出 Windows 系统通知（浏览器 Notification API）：完成/提问/审批/计划审阅提醒，点击气泡直达会话，支持后台模式，设置页在官方设置 → 任务提示。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Stages exact DSH tool calls without dispatch, presents complete canonical arguments in a durable Batch Review Inbox, invalidates approvals after edits or restarts, and commits only a matching SHA-256 digest plus single-use nonce through the normal DSH tool pipeline.
description.zh: 暂存精确的 DSH 工具调用而不执行，在持久化批量审查收件箱中展示完整规范参数；编辑或重启后审批失效，仅允许携带匹配 SHA-256 摘要与一次性 nonce 的批次通过 DSH 正常工具管线提交。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、窗口截图和鼠标键盘操作 Windows 桌面软件，支持会话独立应用授权和操作审批。

description.en: Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.
description.zh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

description.en: A persistent DSH plugin for importing and exporting dynamic Cordis Plugins.
description.zh: A persistent DSH plugin for importing and exporting dynamic Cordis Plugins.

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness settings panel for Command Code: credits, usage windows, and model-catalog sync.
description.zh: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness settings panel for Command Code: credits, usage windows, and model-catalog sync.

description.en: OpenAI Codex OAuth for Deepseek Harness
description.zh: OpenAI Codex OAuth for Deepseek Harness

description.en: Death Stranding skin for DeepSeek Harness UI + live heartbeat feed that pulses on agent thinking/tool execution. Whale keeps brand blue.
description.zh: Death Stranding skin for DeepSeek Harness UI + live heartbeat feed that pulses on agent thinking/tool execution. Whale keeps brand blue.

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.
description.zh: 将命令提交为独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（可选沙箱），关闭 DSH 也不影响运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。当前仅支持Windows系统。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部和输入框上方显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话 token 及费用消耗，支持高峰/空闲峰谷计费与子代理消耗统计。

description.en: Purple-white desktop pet that docks to the screen edge and shows real-time CPU, RAM, GPU and NVMe temperatures with hardware info.
description.zh: 紫白桌宠悬浮球，贴边停靠实时显示 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息。

description.en: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
description.zh: 一键更新本地 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏按钮对比版本、拉取重建并自动重启，还可选择回退到任一历史版本，全程实时进度。

description.en: A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.
description.zh: 把 dsh web 界面封装成原生 Windows 桌面窗口，内置桌面客户端，带系统托盘、开机自启与协议文件分发。

description.en: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.
description.zh: 三套可切换的低刺激护眼配色（暖纸、豆绿、暖灰），每套都是完整的别名 token 层，含浅色与深色两副面貌。

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

description.en: Paper Design plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Paper Design plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: DSH 联网搜索私有化方案，代理 web_search/web_fetch 至 Wigolo，覆盖搜索/抓取/提取/深度研究/缓存/监控全链路，数据不出域，零查询成本。  Wigolo-powered DSH search plugin — self-hosted search/crawl/extract/research/cache/watch pipeline, fully replaces built-in web_search/web_fetch. Zero cost, full data privacy.
description.zh: DSH 联网搜索私有化方案，代理 web_search/web_fetch 至 Wigolo，覆盖搜索/抓取/提取/深度研究/缓存/监控全链路，数据不出域，零查询成本。  Wigolo-powered DSH search plugin — self-hosted search/crawl/extract/research/cache/watch pipeline, fully replaces built-in web_search/web_fetch. Zero cost, full data privacy.

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: one local bridge for ChatGPT Codex / Claude / ZCode (GLM) / Qwen subscription plans — settings status card, one-click provisioning, zero core changes. npm: @taylorswitiger/dsh-plan-bridge
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: one local bridge for ChatGPT Codex / Claude / ZCode (GLM) / Qwen subscription plans — settings status card, one-click provisioning, zero core changes. npm: @taylorswitiger/dsh-plan-bridge

description.en: File workbench library plugin for DSH, provide file processing capability.
description.zh: DSH 文件工作台库插件，提供文件处理相关能力。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.
description.zh: 内置 web_search 每次搜索都要在 DeepSeek 自己的端点上消耗一整轮模型调用；本插件改为在 OpenRouter 兼容网关上执行搜索，与对话走同一个账户，模型和价格都由你决定。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Persistent per-session task stack for DeepSeek Harness agents - focus_task / focus_complete / read_focus + /focus, zero prompt injection
description.zh: Persistent per-session task stack for DeepSeek Harness agents - focus_task / focus_complete / read_focus + /focus, zero prompt injection

description.en: 自动归档 DeepSeek Harness 对话记录
description.zh: 自动归档 DeepSeek Harness 对话记录

description.en: 基于 DSH 的有道风格划词翻译：划选即现「译」按钮，harness 自带大模型，零 API key / Youdao-style word-selection translation for DSH: select text, click 「译」, powered by the harness's own LLM, no API keys
description.zh: 基于 DSH 的有道风格划词翻译：划选即现「译」按钮，harness 自带大模型，零 API key / Youdao-style word-selection translation for DSH: select text, click 「译」, powered by the harness's own LLM, no API keys

description.en: dsh manger 远程工具对应使用的 dsh 插件，直接完成 dsh 远程访问
description.zh: dsh manger 远程工具对应使用的 dsh 插件，直接完成 dsh 远程访问

description.en: Global and per-session prompt templates in a right-side panel — insert into the draft or send now, edit, promote session templates to global, with SQLite persistence via the built-in node:sqlite.
description.zh: 右侧面板中的全局与会话级提示词模板——插入草稿或立即发送、编辑、会话模板提升为全局，SQLite 持久化走内置的 node:sqlite。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Codekin: a creature-collection and match-three RPG for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: Codekin: a creature-collection and match-three RPG for DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: Shows chat images as a thumbnail grid inside the message body instead of one collapsed icon, so several pictures are readable at a glance, with the column count adjustable from 1 to 12 (3 by default) and a hide-images switch. Clicking a thumbnail opens a lightbox that zooms by wheel or buttons, drags to pan, pages between images and downloads the original. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 把对话里的图片展开成正文内的缩略图网格，列数 1–12 可调（默认 3 列），多张图一眼看清，不再折叠成一个图标，并可一键隐藏。点开灯箱可滚轮或按钮放大、拖动平移、左右切换、下载原图。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端（dsh web）开发的插件：聊天区右侧的 Explorer 文件面板 + Preview 预览面板（FileManager 风格，Apache-2.0 参考实现非抄录），以及输入框 @ 引用项目文件（树形多选弹窗 + 输入框内胶囊 + 行号）
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端（dsh web）开发的插件：聊天区右侧的 Explorer 文件面板 + Preview 预览面板（FileManager 风格，Apache-2.0 参考实现非抄录），以及输入框 @ 引用项目文件（树形多选弹窗 + 输入框内胶囊 + 行号）

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Tauri 2 桌面应用：检测或自动安装全局 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包，启动 DSH Web 并嵌入自身窗口，支持系统托盘管理、登录自启、全局快捷键与桌面快捷方式。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: DSH Web Client 的 VSCode 风格文件树侧栏插件：虚拟化懒加载文件树，支持文本 / Markdown / 图片预览。
description.zh: DSH Web Client 的 VSCode 风格文件树侧栏插件：虚拟化懒加载文件树，支持文本 / Markdown / 图片预览。

description.en: Lightweight IDE-in-the-sidebar plugin for the dsh web GUI: workspace file tree, agent-change review (accept/reject + undo), full editing with diff and rendered markdown, plus an integrated terminal view.
description.zh: Lightweight IDE-in-the-sidebar plugin for the dsh web GUI: workspace file tree, agent-change review (accept/reject + undo), full editing with diff and rendered markdown, plus an integrated terminal view.

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

description.en: Safety-first five-agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with leases, scopes, checkpoints, validation, and recovery.
description.zh: Safety-first five-agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with leases, scopes, checkpoints, validation, and recovery.

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, load them on demand, and filter tools to reduce context usage.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器，按需加载并筛选工具以减少上下文占用。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Cost tracking plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — snapshot-anchored per-turn pricing, account balance, and live cost estimates.
description.zh: Cost tracking plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — snapshot-anchored per-turn pricing, account balance, and live cost estimates.

description.en: Invert selection in Deepseek Harness for when we are selecting models
description.zh: Invert selection in Deepseek Harness for when we are selecting models

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: Put a watch on a stream: background listeners that wake the DeepSeek Harness agent with new matching lines — and a daemon host so a watcher runs unattended for weeks, with no task and no browser. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
description.zh: Put a watch on a stream: background listeners that wake the DeepSeek Harness agent with new matching lines — and a daemon host so a watcher runs unattended for weeks, with no task and no browser. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

description.en: DSH plugin for switching conversation language between Chinese and English
description.zh: DSH plugin for switching conversation language between Chinese and English

description.en: 一个插件管理的小插件，功能逐步增加中...
description.zh: 一个插件管理的小插件，功能逐步增加中...

description.en: DSH插件市场，自动更新，热重载插件，多种排序方案，快速管理和安装插件
description.zh: DSH插件市场，自动更新，热重载插件，多种排序方案，快速管理和安装插件

description.en: Create, preview, and render Remotion videos through a verified DeepSeek Harness skill workflow.
description.zh: Create, preview, and render Remotion videos through a verified DeepSeek Harness skill workflow.

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

description.en: Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion: locks verifiable criteria, tracks task dependencies, and gates completion behind formal reviewer validation (18 MCP tools).
description.zh: 验收标准驱动的目标完成：锁定可验证的验收标准、跟踪任务依赖，以 reviewer 正式验收作为完成门禁（18 个 MCP 工具）。

description.en: A better approach to editing files in DSH.
description.zh: A better approach to editing files in DSH.

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化插件：无障碍优先的观察-动作回路（30 个标准工具，元素/坐标双目标与 auto/a11y/event 策略路由），写后作废与禁重放安全语义，持久急停开关，RuntimeId/矩形漂移防错位，对话卡片与悬浮面板（实况/画面/环境自检设置），面向低分辨率模型的分块识图，JSONL 审计与 pid 白名单。需 Windows 10+ 与 Python 3.9+，并安装 uiautomation 与 pillow（设置页可一键安装）。

description.en: A corner HUD for DeepSeek Harness that shows your session's token pressure, per-model cost, and daily/monthly usage at a glance, with an editable budget and balance that tracks spending for you. 右下角常驻的 Token 仪表盘：实时看会话压力、按模型估算花费。预算和余额点一下就能改，每天每月用了多少都有记录。
description.zh: A corner HUD for DeepSeek Harness that shows your session's token pressure, per-model cost, and daily/monthly usage at a glance, with an editable budget and balance that tracks spending for you. 右下角常驻的 Token 仪表盘：实时看会话压力、按模型估算花费。预算和余额点一下就能改，每天每月用了多少都有记录。

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

description.en: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

description.en: Native AnySearch /v1/search WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness with Web UI, credentials integration, and Web/Headless support.
description.zh: Native AnySearch /v1/search WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness with Web UI, credentials integration, and Web/Headless support.

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
description.zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 Agent 经验网络：从 trace 与实时 Manifest 蒸馏任务级经验，按 H0-H4 证据分级、按兼容性发现，经显式审阅后才晋升。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 MCP / Skill / 记忆管理工具：写入前先连接自检，连不上不写；从 Claude Code / Codex 一键迁移；可装成 dsh 插件，在 Web 里用 /mcp 命令和卡片操作。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 MCP / Skill / 记忆管理工具：写入前先连接自检，连不上不写；从 Claude Code / Codex 一键迁移；可装成 dsh 插件，在 Web 里用 /mcp 命令和卡片操作。

description.en: Run a DeepSeek Harness session against a WSL distro: ctx.shell, ctx.fs and the GUI terminal served from inside the distro, sandboxed with bubblewrap
description.zh: Run a DeepSeek Harness session against a WSL distro: ctx.shell, ctx.fs and the GUI terminal served from inside the distro, sandboxed with bubblewrap

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: Local image, PDF, data, audio/video and Office file conversion through agent tools and a drag-and-drop interface; v1.0.x targets DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5, with external tools required for some conversions.
description.zh: 通过 Agent 工具和拖拽界面在本地转换图片、PDF、数据、音视频及 Office 文件；v1.0.x 适配 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5，部分转换需要外部工具。

description.en: MCP 服务器管理面板：GUI 增删改 MCP 服务器配置（写入 cordis.patch.yml + HMR 实时挂载）+ 工具浏览 + agent 面 mcp_* 管理工具 | MCP server management panel: GUI add/edit/delete MCP server configs (writes cordis.patch.yml + HMR hot-mount) + tool browsing + agent-side mcp_* management tools
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理面板：GUI 增删改 MCP 服务器配置（写入 cordis.patch.yml + HMR 实时挂载）+ 工具浏览 + agent 面 mcp_* 管理工具 | MCP server management panel: GUI add/edit/delete MCP server configs (writes cordis.patch.yml + HMR hot-mount) + tool browsing + agent-side mcp_* management tools

description.en: 增强deepseek harness的工作区的多级目录功能
description.zh: 增强deepseek harness的工作区的多级目录功能

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼跳跃小游戏 / whale jump plugin
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼跳跃小游戏 / whale jump plugin

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: 一个插件把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口变成多个分屏，同时查看多个会话的状态。再也不用在会话列表里切来切去了。
description.zh: 一个插件把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口变成多个分屏，同时查看多个会话的状态。再也不用在会话列表里切来切去了。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution choice for complex work.
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: A local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Vector generation mode that supports local, LLM enhancement and external API integration. Support the import of text files, PDFs and Office files. Also support multi-user management, content encryption and access to MCP tools.
description.zh: A local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Vector generation mode that supports local, LLM enhancement and external API integration. Support the import of text files, PDFs and Office files. Also support multi-user management, content encryption and access to MCP tools.

description.en: Refuses Git inside a Jujutsu workspace and hands the model jj commands instead. Jujutsu-native VCS & version control for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Refuses Git inside a Jujutsu workspace and hands the model jj commands instead. Jujutsu-native VCS & version control for the DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Five skills for a reviewable engineering incident journal: record an event only when a counterfactual can be written, quiz yourself from the existing entries, audit the journal for decay, ingest outside material together with its provenance, and rename a layout directory while rewriting every reference to it.
description.zh: 五个技能维护一本可复习的工程事故日志：写不出反事实就不记，从已有条目出题自测，体检条目腐化，按出处收外部资料，并能在改目录名的同时改掉全库引用。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验 Git/MSYS2 安装的设置行。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Fail-closed three-mode approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Fail-closed three-mode approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.
description.zh: 迁移 DSH 配置：跨机器导出/导入 .dshmig 归档（同 OS、新建 profile、凭据脱敏、校验与回滚）。

description.en: OpenCode GO 套餐用量监控插件：账户三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 Token/金额统计，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 而生
description.zh: OpenCode GO 套餐用量监控插件：账户三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 Token/金额统计，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 而生

description.en: Automode for DeepSeek Harness: a fourth permission preset — full access with an LLM classifier as the only gate before every tool call.
description.zh: Automode for DeepSeek Harness: a fourth permission preset — full access with an LLM classifier as the only gate before every tool call.

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
description.zh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

description.en: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

description.en: 让模型通过 adb 操作安卓手机的 DSH 插件（截图、UI 树、点击、滑动、输入文本、按键、打开应用） | DSH plugin exposing adb-based tools that let the model operate an Android phone (screenshot, UI dump, tap, swipe, input text, press keys, open apps).
description.zh: 让模型通过 adb 操作安卓手机的 DSH 插件（截图、UI 树、点击、滑动、输入文本、按键、打开应用） | DSH plugin exposing adb-based tools that let the model operate an Android phone (screenshot, UI dump, tap, swipe, input text, press keys, open apps).

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: WeCom AI Bot channel for DeepSeek Harness — every chat runs a persistent, preset-backed agent with real tools.
description.zh: WeCom AI Bot channel for DeepSeek Harness — every chat runs a persistent, preset-backed agent with real tools.

description.en: Vertex Argon — Google Vertex AI & Gemini API dual-route Gemini 4 Argon plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native Low/Medium/High thinking levels, thought summaries, signed tool-call replay, and dedicated Settings UI.
description.zh: Vertex Argon — Google Vertex AI & Gemini API dual-route Gemini 4 Argon plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native Low/Medium/High thinking levels, thought summaries, signed tool-call replay, and dedicated Settings UI.

description.en: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

description.en: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

description.en: Garmin Connect 运动健康 AI 教练插件 for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Garmin Connect 运动健康 AI 教练插件 for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

description.en: SecurStack adapter for DeepSeek Harness: run repository security scans, policy gates, doctor diagnostics, and JSON CLI results from safe AI-agent tools.
description.zh: SecurStack adapter for DeepSeek Harness: run repository security scans, policy gates, doctor diagnostics, and JSON CLI results from safe AI-agent tools.

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。
